Therefore, the history of Western diplomacy during this period is a history of war and peace.

entries.2013IPCC報告指出人類活動” 極為可能的（extremely likely: The 2013 IPCC report pointed out that human activities are "extremely likely>95%" leading to global warming. It is estimated that the temperature will rise by 0.3 oC to 4.8 oC in 2100, and the sea level will rise by 26-81 cm. It may lead to drought, typhoons and other intensity enhancement, and the melting of the Arctic ice layer in summer. IPCC experts believe that the global rising temperature should be controlled within 2 degrees Celsius above before the industrial revolution in the 18th century. For this reason, global greenhouse gas emissions should be reduced by at least 50% in 2050, but developing countries should be reduced by 80%. In 2015 COP21, 195 countries adopted the Paris Agreement, which aims to strengthen the global threat to climate change by "controlling the global average temperature rise above the pre-industrial level and far below 2°C, and trying to limit the temperature rise to 1.5°C above the pre-industrial level". In 2021, more than 130 countries around the world have announced the goal of net zero emissions by 2050 to work together to combat global warming. China announced on 110.4.22 that "the 2050 net zero transformation is the goal of the whole world and Taiwan". This course aims to guide and discuss the evidence of global warming, the causes of global warming, the trend and prediction of global warming, the crisis of global warming, the impact of climate change on Taiwan, and the mitigation and adjustment of global climate change, so that students can understand that global climate change is a global and cross-generational science. At the same time, through the establishment of students' learning goals, the reading and viewing of climate change-related news media, the discussion of issues related to the climate change forum, and group reports and comprehensive reports on climate change issues, we will cultivate the necessary knowledge for citizens of the global village to maintain the earth's environment, in order to move towards the goal of sustainable development of the earth.

entries.2021-2030年是聯合國海洋永續發展的關鍵十年，本課程主要介紹遙感觀測海洋的: 2021-2030 is a key decade for the sustainable development of the United Nations oceans. This course mainly introduces the mechanism of remote sensing observation of the ocean and its application in oceanography. Ocean telemetry is one of the important tools for understanding the global ocean system. This course will use real marine phenomena to let students understand the principle of marine telemetry and the application of data. Students can understand marine phenomena and basic marine properties at the same time in the course. This course includes basic radiation physics, seawater surface temperature, infrared and visible light remote sensing, seawater surface salinity and microwave remote sensing, ocean currents and eddy currents, synthetic aperture radar and waves, sea surface wind field, planetary waves and large-scale marine dynamics, and large-scale marine phenomena influenced by human beings. Finally, this course has a three-week MATLAB practical course, which allows students to actually experience the processing and drawing of ocean satellite data.
entries.2021-2030年是聯合國海洋永續發展的關鍵十年，本課程將讓學生了解到基礎的海: 2021-2030 is a key decade for the sustainable development of the United Nations ocean. This course will enable students to understand the basic knowledge of marine physics and marine chemistry, so that students can fully understand the nature and characteristics of the global ocean. Oceanography is a science that focuses on explaining all the physical and biochemical processes of water in various parts of the earth. Descriptive oceanography describes the distribution and characteristics of water masses in the ocean and studies the movement of water in the ocean and the causes of its movement; chemical oceanography is responsible for studying the chemical composition of seawater and analyzing all the changes in the chemical composition of water generated by the discharge of human activities. The content of this course includes marine geography, marine circulation, marine data analysis and methods, atmospheric chemistry, marine nutrient salts and primary productivity, and detailed characteristics of water bodies in the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans. This course has four MATLAB practical studies with the course, so that students can actually get in touch with the basic properties of the ocean and the layered data of reanalysis data.

This course aims to (1) assist students in understanding the role of marketing in the organization and business environment; (2) let students familiarize themselves with the basic concepts of marketing management (e.g. marketing strategy, marketing research, consumer behavior, STP, etc.); (3) emphasize students' application of marketing strategies and marketing tactics; (4) cultivate students' ability to work as a team, analyze and solve marketing problems. The so-called "modern physics" refers to the revolutionary concepts and theories developed by physics in the early 20th century, including relativity and quantum mechanics. Modern physics has a wide range of applications, including nuclear science, materials science, electronics, laser optics, and quantum science/technology. The main course goal of ME3053 is to introduce the basic concepts of modern physics to students as the basis for future elective advanced courses in the fields of materials, semiconductors, electronics and quantum engineering.

entries.This seminar, joined by visiting profess: This seminar, joined by visiting professor Jason McGrath, is designed as a career retrospective study of the cinema of Hou Hsiao-hsien and an exploration of the broader phenomenon that he helped to inspire, variously known as “Asian minimalism,” “Asian slow cinema,” or, in this course, “Asian long-take cinema.” The seminar will trace the development of Hou's distinctive style from his early films through his classics of "Taiwan New Cinema" in the mid/late 1980s, and on to his later films when he had become an internationally celebrated auteur even after the Taiwan-specific movement he had been part of had died out. We will specifically focus on his use of long-take and long-shot cinematography and explore how that style has been theorized by film scholars and critics since the classical film theory of André Bazin.

entries.“ 《國際財經新聞》授課內容，對於商管學院高年級生具有3大價值、4大意義： 價: "The teaching content of International Financial News has three values and four meanings for senior students of the School of Commerce and Management: Value 1: The observation and analysis of the government's current financial policy is the scope of current affairs required for the examination of the research institute and the national examination. Value 2: The cultivation of the interpretation ability of experts in big data analysis, and the in-depth use of the multi-faceted value of news information. Value 3: Senior financial reporters lead students to study the enthusiastic debate of financial current affairs in an orderly manner in the classroom, and master the mature attitude of rational judgment. Meaning 1: Narrative discussion of financial news that links arithmetic formulas and economic theory; Meaning 2: From news clues to various databases and statistical data, master the tools for research and analysis; Meaning 3: Explore the faithful and innovative expression mode of new media; Meaning 4: Look at the global pulse from the Taiwan economy and cultivate international vision. News is intended to convey dynamic messages, and financial issues covering economy, finance, etc. not only have theoretical foundations, but also may affect the performance of results every day, quarter and year due to changes in generating factors, which meets the conditions for the formation of news. The international financial news course is based on the basis of economic sociology and international economy. Through the transit tools of mass media, according to different speeds and interpretation methods, printed publications, community media and online media are presented to us as the audience. However, the market is full of countless information every day. Which ones really affect the transaction? What are the keys to determining the trend? Which ones must be completely ignored? Robert J., winner of the 2013 Nobel Prize in Economics Shiller's latest journal paper published in AER made a clear discussion of the importance of this class. The financial news course in the first semester will select current affairs issues such as per capita income, prices, international trade, finance, monetary finance, industrial development, science and technology integration, etc., which are divided into three stages of learning: the first stage takes news and current affairs as the textbook reading material, which is explained by the teacher and extended by the students; the second stage is subject-based cognitive learning, which is collected and analyzed by students' groups; the third stage is statistical database heart practice, network essay and visual analysis, in-depth practice of narrative news, and then write reporting articles. Students' participation in classroom discussions and the writing of news rudiments will actually be reflected in the semester results.

entries.“一、課程目標：本課程旨在培養學生能恰當使用文字將個人之想法、認知表達出來，以期: "I. Course Objectives: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appropriately use words to express their personal ideas and cognition, so as to help daily interpersonal responses, further study, workplace, etc. From the basic text use, rhetorical skills, structural layout and semantic logic, it will gradually progress. Finally, it will be combined with example analysis and student exercises to train students to have the corresponding basic Chinese writing ability according to the needs of various occasions. The course is divided into six major areas according to actual needs: official documents, literature, planning, news, papers and self-narration. II. Overview of contents: Official documents: The so-called "official documents" generally refer to "documents dealing with official duties". According to the provisions of the "Regulations on Official Documents Procedures", the categories of official documents are: orders, submissions, consultations, letters, announcements and other six items. Originally, at least one party of the "official document" must be a government agency, but in order to take into account the needs of students who use it more often, this unit redefines "official document" as the meaning of "public document". Accordingly, the content of this unit is slightly revised, with the four categories of "letter", "letter" and "announcement" as its main content. Literature: Under the premise of application, literary writing still needs to exist. Literary writing has the possibility of creativity regardless of form, and avoids the trap of mechanized format writing. This part of the course hopes to develop the habit of self-thinking and training students through the mastery of various situations and the sense of language. Planning: divided into general planning and academic planning (tas an example of reading planning), and includes production briefing. Accurately grasp the key points of general planning, reading planning and briefing. Practical writing exercises for general planning, reading planning and briefing. By writing general plans, reading plans and briefings, students are trained in the ability to collect information, observe ideas, self-assessment and language expression. News: News writing usually has clear meaning and correct grammar, so as to quickly convey new knowledge, effectively share information, and successfully create issues. The purpose of this course is to guide students to accumulate writing experience after mastering the basic knowledge of news writing, and develop a more understanding and fluent language expression ability. At the same time, it can cultivate an objective and correct understanding of all issues of the country and society, and can also affirm, tolerate and respect people from all walks of life. Thesis: Let college students familiarize themselves with the key points of Chinese writing of academic works, and strengthen their Chinese expression ability of academic works through exercises and case studies. Self-report: Although modesty is a virtue, in modern society, whether it is learning or seeking knowledge, or even in general social activities, it is still necessary to let others know their strengths moderately. The content of "self-narration" is naturally the author's most familiar with himself, but it is because he has mastered a lot of detailed information that he often doesn't know where to write. In addition, such documents are often made because of "people's demands". Therefore, they can only give full play to the effectiveness of such documents by not only touting their own advantages, but also not being arrogant.

entries.“工程數學-複變”之主要課程內容為”複變函數分析”。複變函數為一種很特殊，亦很有: The main course content of "Engineering Mathematics - Complexity" is "complexity function analysis". The complex function is a very special and useful function. It has the duality of pure value function and vector value function, that is to say, complex functions can be regarded as pure quantities like real numbers, and can also be regarded as vectors like two-dimensional vectors. Therefore, after learning "real variable function analysis" and "analysis of vector functions", we must learn the analysis of complex variable functions, including their differentiation and integration. In many basic courses of electrical engineering, such as circuit science, electromagnetism, control system and communication system, all involve the application of complex functions. For example, complex functions can be used to easily represent AC voltage, current and frequency domain impedance, so as to reduce the complexity of problem analysis. Therefore, complex function analysis is an important foundation for students in the Department of Electrical Engineering.

entries.⼈⼯智慧（Artificial Intelligence, AI）已經是當代社會: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become an important issue that cannot be avoided in contemporary society, because our lifestyle is difficult to ignore the impact of AI. However, the development of AI is also accompanied by many ethical issues to be discussed. The so-called ethical problems here can be roughly divided into two types: first, it covers the normative applied ethics level, such as the moral controversy in business, medical care and privacy; second, it involves the defined post-ethical level, that is, the moral vacuum caused by the development of new technology, because there is no precedent to follow, so rethink what is the ethical discussion. AI ethics is conducive to the understanding of at least two directions: on the one hand, society needs to pay more attention to the sound of the interaction between technology and human nature, because to eliminate the contradiction between "huge data computing services" and "human rights to independent choice", we must have the ability to make observations and warnings; on the other hand, AI not only promotes the convenience of life, but also brings about many changes in ideas. In the face of high-speed social evolution, can we lead the development and application of research, policies and Ԣ industry in a pioneering role, so that human nature can get the benefits of huge data calculation to the greatest extent and avoid its disadvantages. This course will equip students with the following abilities: I. Be able to understand the basic concepts of artificial intelligence. II. Be able to understand the perspective of ethical observation. III. Be able to understand the interaction between science and technology and society. IV. Be able to grasp the controversial content of each major issue. V. Be able to rethink the dialectical relationship between artificial intelligence and ethics.

entries.⼼理學是探討⼈類⼼智與⾏為的科學。以⼤腦、⼼智、與⾏為間的交互作⽤為主軸，以實驗: Psychology is a science that explores human mind and behavior. Taking the interaction between the brain, mind and behavior as the main axis, it explores the performance of human behavior and mind and its intrinsic mechanism with experimental orientation. The course will review and sort out various psychological studies, and introduce the psychological theories based on the research results. This course is an introductory course in psychology for the Department of Psychology. The objectives include: (1) Introduction to knowledge: introducing the basic operation of the mind and its integration, so that trainees have general knowledge of psychology as a basis for further exploring various fields of psychology. (2) English ability: Cultivate students' English reading ability so that they can efficiently understand various psychological English works in the future. ( 3) Thinking training: Cultivate students to think academically and systematically express their opinions on social issues related to psychology, so as to increase their understanding of the application level of the psychology department and improve their interest in psychology and thinking ability.

entries.《史記》乃中國二十五史之首，歷來被視為正史系統的典範之作，因此對此書的解讀也就多: The Records of History is the first of China's twenty-five histories, and has always been regarded as a model work of the official history system. Therefore, the interpretation of this book is mostly carried out from the perspective of history books. But in this way, it ignored and even deviated from Sima Qian's position when he wrote this book. Since the Tang and Song Dynasties, the achievements of this book have been praised from the perspective of literature. I'm afraid this is only a surface, and I can't deeply understand Sima Qian's intention and ideas when he wrote this book. According to Sima Qian's personal statement, the "Records of History" was written after Confucius wrote "Spring and Autumn", which is to be "the words of a family". In other words, to understand the true essence of Sima Qian's "Records of History" more accurately, it must be understood from the perspective of scriptures and sub-books.

According to the classification of the EU Quantum Flagship, quantum technology can be roughly classified as: 1. Quantum computing; 2. Quantum simulation; 3. Quantum communication; 4. Quantum sensing. The physics and technology covered by these novel technologies will be quite different from conventional technologies, and in order to achieve these technologies, this field will include a considerable number of different sciences. In order to cultivate students' basic understanding of this emerging field, the "Introduction to Quantum Technology" course will introduce the key technologies and physics covered in quantum technology. At the physical level, its content includes quantum optical systems, nonlinear optics, atomic molecular optical physics and superconducting systems. In theory, quantum algorithms and topological optics will also play an important role in quantum technology. entries.中國現代文學史上的「左翼文學」，通常繫於1920年代中期和1930年代的文藝思潮: The "left-wing literature" in the history of modern Chinese literature usually refers to the literary trend of the mid-1920s and 1930s, which refers to the revolutionary literary movement between 1927 and 1937, or in a narrow sense refers to the literary creation and cultural movement from the founding of 1930 to the dissolution of 1936 of the Chinese Left-wing Writers Union, or in a broad sense, it generally refers to the "red literature" of the entire 20th century. Some commentators regard "left-wing literature" as another name for "revolutionary realist literature" in China in the 20th century, which refers to the literary creation and cultural movement related to the revolution of the Communist Party of China from 1920s to 1980s. In terms of concepts, "left-wing literature" and "revolutionary literature" are often generally interchanged, and there are overlaps and differences with the connotations of concepts such as "proletarian literature", "worker', peasant and soldier literature", "new people's literature" and "socialist literature". The development of left-wing literature is inextricably related to the modernist movement and socialist tradition. For example, the "companion" relationship between left-wing literature and the new sensational school, the entanglement with the modern school, and the complex involvement with the Communist International, Marxism, cosmopolitanism, Japanese leftists, etc., are all important topics for the research of left-wing literature, which also make the appearance of left-wing literature more rich and changeable.

The main purpose of this course is to introduce how to use the Scheme language to develop the foundation of algebraic geometry, which is divided into five parts: the definition and basic theory of Scheme: Sheaves: It provides a set of systematic methods to record local algebraic data of topological space Schemes: polynomial solutions in ar projective or projective space are called algebraic varieties, Schemes to promote algebraic varieties from three directions: allow ground fields to be arbitrary fields; do not rely on embedded space; consider reducibility and moltiplicity Important properties: integral, noetherian, separatedness, separateness, properness Coherent sheaves: the simplest basic Sheaves on Schemes, they can correspond to the modole theory on algebra Internal geometry: Linear system: They are important tools to explore embedded problems Picard groups: They are important intrinsic variable forms: They can inherit some differential Curve theory: Classification problem has always been an important topic in algebraic geometry. The most important thing in studying this problem is to define numerical invariants and continuous invariants. For the classification of curves, we first introduce the double rational classification. Using the double rational invariant of genus, we find that: ※ If the genus is zero, there is only one double rational equivalent class; ※ If the genus is a positive integer greater than zero, all the double rational equivalent classes will form a continuous family, and its parameter space is an algebraic variety (the variety of modoli of curves of genus g>0). Therefore, studying this variety can fully understand the double rational classification of curves. Secondly, we need to describe the smooth curve in a bi-rationable equivalent class, and finally discuss the classification of singularities on the curve, and the Riemman-Roch theorem, an important theorem that runs through the curve theory, will also be one of the focuses of our emphasis. Surface theory: We still focus on the classification of surfaces. We use the Kodaira dimension to classify surfaces. In the case that the Kodaira dimension is negative infinity, 0, 1 or 2, we carefully explore the styles of possible surfaces, and introduce the concept of the minimum model in the double rational equivalent class of the surface to determine the representative elements of the same class. Finally, we hope to use the minimal modal program that is currently under development to reinterpret the classification problem of the whole surface as a basic training for connecting the relevant minimum model theory research.

Most teaching principles courses and textbooks still aim to pass the teaching test, and pay less attention to the challenges and needs of teachers and students in the actual teaching site. entries.公共政策基本是指政府與公部門在解決公共問題或滿足民眾所提出的需求時，所做出的作為: Public policy basically refers to the decisions taken by the government and the public sector to do or do not act in solving public problems or meeting the needs of the people. In addition, various activities or acts related to the decision are also included. It can be seen that public policy occupies an extremely basic and crucial position in the practice and research of public administration. In order to enable students to fully grasp the connotation of public policy, this course will provide students with a more comprehensive knowledge framework through gradual and layered analysis through step-by-layer analysis, and through the intersection of multiple aspects such as theory, case and practice.

entries.公共管理以政府為核心，廣泛整合社會資源以強化治理能力，意圖提高政府績效與服務品質: Public management takes the government as the core and widely integrates social resources to strengthen governance capabilities, with the intention of improving government performance and service quality. As a discipline independent of public administration, its research object is transferred from organization to manager, paying attention to both internal organizational management and the response ability of the external environment. This course aims to introduce various concepts and applications involved in public management, reflect on the role and responsibilities of the government, and further improve the efficiency of the government.
entries.公共行政是一門研究公部門組織、運作、與行為的學科。其發展至今，已有超過一百年的歷: Public administration is a discipline that studies the organization, operation and behavior of the public sector. It has developed for more than a hundred years, and has built a fairly complete research scope, connotation and object. Even so, due to the increasing organization, function and operation of the contemporary government, it also makes it more difficult for us to master the administrative phenomenon. In view of this, this course will systematically sort out the model, stage, doctrine and basic perspective of public administration from the aspects of theory and practice, and try to bring students a panoramic bird's-eye view through the introduction of the course. In addition, since public administration is a discipline with practical orientation and practical connotations, this course will also guide students to analyze cases through specific cases, so as to think about the possibility of institutional change.

Its characteristics are to explore and explain life phenomena at the molecular level. Due to the common characteristics of the genetic composition and replication mechanism of various organisms, molecular biology has become the "microscopic common language" for explaining life phenomena in various biological fields. These "corporate citizens" integrate green and sustainable development into the company's long-term strategy with a positive attitude, requiring all decision-making levels and departments within the organization to implement it. In addition to traditional considerations such as competitiveness, shareholder rights and interests, market share and profits, they also began to carefully evaluate the impact of their economic activities on society and the environment, taking into account many aspects such as employee families, social welfare ethics, more stakeholders and future generations' rights and interests. entries.國際政治與國內政治有所不同，國內政治建基於主權概念，亦即有一國內最高、唯一且對外: International politics is different from domestic politics. Domestic politics is based on the concept of sovereignty, that is, there is a supreme, unique and equal authority in the country. The expression and exercise of sovereignty are mostly based on the norms of the Constitution, but international politics is in a state of no government, and there is no absolute and highest authority to issue orders, requiring all countries to absolutely comply and deal with them fairly. Therefore, international politics reflects the situation of how to compete, cooperate, interact and compromise power relations between two countries, countries and international organizations under the consideration of national autonomy and interests. Today's international community is more complex than in the past. The interaction of politics, military, economy, trade, culture, energy, environment and other issues can observe the position, values and strategies of each country from international politics. This course needs to understand the links and meanings of it, and also asks students to understand it. This course has an in-depth theoretical analysis compared with "Introduction to International Relations", so that students have a more complete vision structure.

From road paving, drainage facilities, surrounding environment of buildings, barrier-free space, campus walkways, slope stability, pipeline facilities to campus public space maintenance, they are all within the scope of civil engineering majors that can be observed, analyzed and improved. For freshmen who have entered the Department of Civil Engineering, service learning courses can be an important starting point for understanding civil engineering majors and building a sense of social responsibility. entries.在後全球化時代，族群和民族主義的流行似乎是一個全球現象，這幾年「美國優先」意識逐: In the post-globalization era, the popularity of ethnic groups and nationalism seems to be a global phenomenon. In recent years, the consciousness of "America First" has gradually risen, and it has become an official policy during the Trump era. "War Wolf Diplomacy" is not only used to describe China's official nationalism, but also the people's patriotic feelings and words and deeds are very high, and Taiwan's national identity is a long-term issue. This course aims to understand the basic concepts and theories of ethnic and national identity, analyze historical development and its performance in modern society, and focus on East Asian nationalism to explore the relationship between ethnic identity and national construction and its impact. Through a multi-faceted perspective, we can understand the formation process of ethnic groups and nationalities, dynamic changes and their impact on society and politics. The course will help students deepen their understanding of these topics and their ability to study independently through classic studies, discussions and case studies.

entries.在當今全球化與科技快速發展的時代，社會風險已不再是單一國家或區域性的問題。氣候變: In today's era of globalization and rapid development of science and technology, social risks are no longer a single country or a regional problem. Climate change, the widening gap between the rich and the poor, large-scale unemployment, social inequality and other risks affect our lives, which have a profound impact on politics, economy, culture and other levels, forming a complex risk network. However, although modern society has higher technical capabilities, it also faces more complex and unpredictable risks. Therefore, understanding the nature of risks and learning how to deal with these challenges effectively has become an important task in today's society.

In the field of AI, programming is a necessary ability to practice algorithms, train and optimize models, and efficiently process large-scale data sets. In the field of IC design and circuit computer-aided design (CAD), program design is used to develop simulation tools, automate design processes, and optimize the coordination of hardware and software. By mastering the C++ language widely used in high-performance computing, you will build a solid foundation to cope with computing-intensive tasks and develop tools for AI applications and chip design automation. These skills are crucial to maintain competitiveness in modern engineering careers.

entries.在資料洪流之中，我們不只觀看，更試圖理解。本課程以「人文AI」為核心，探索人工智: In the torrent of data, we not only watch, but also try to understand. With "Humanistic AI" as the core, this course explores how artificial intelligence can participate, rewrite and respond to human learning process. The course first clarifies the difference between large data and thick data: the former describes the scale and trend, while the latter goes deep into the situation and meaning, so that the data can change from a calm number to a warm narrative. Furthermore, the course focuses on the multiple aspects of learning analysis, covering cognition, emotion, behavior and social interaction, and reflects on the ethics and power structure behind the data. Students will use tools such as ChatGPT, DocuGIS and Sankey Diagram to develop thematic research by combining text, space and visual analysis. The ultimate goal of the course is not to predict learning, but to understand how people learn, choose and become in the AI era.

Major data and funding providers in this field (such as NASA) have recognized that open science is necessary for the development of scientific research, and have begun to promote and change our mode of scientific research to the community. This course invites you to join in exploring the practices and future visions of open science in the earth and environmental science community, and gain specific experience of open science through discussion, experience sharing and special results.

entries.幾何學是最古老的數學理論之一，其起源可追溯至古代人類測量土地與地貌的技術，後由歐: Geometry is one of the oldest mathematical theories. Its origin can be traced back to the ancient human technology of measuring land and landform, and later became plane geometry by Euclid. With the development of Cartesian analytical geometry, geometry gradually combined with algebra and calculus, and finally Gauss established a modern theory of the study of surface geometry. One of the most important breakthroughs is that the degree of curvature of the surface, that is, "curvature", can be completely determined by the measurement of the surface itself, without relying on observing the surface from external space. This view of "intrinsic geometry" profoundly influenced Riemann's development of high-dimensional geometry, which is called "Riemann geometry" today, and further became an important mathematical basis for Einstein's general theory of relativity.

entries.攝影是現代日常生活中無所不在的視覺媒介，它左右著人們對於自我的認知和對世界的理解: Photography is a ubiquitous visual medium in modern daily life. It influences people's self-awareness and understanding of the world, and is also a channel for establishing social relations. For news media, commodity advertisements, art exhibitions, personal photos, memorial albums and family photos, we can see the diverse purposes and methods of photography practice. We can explore the characteristics of the trend of the times, cultural memory and life customs from photography, and we can also find the intertwining link between photography, art creation and art history. Through the reading of classical theories and the observation of photography types, this course aims to understand the aesthetic characteristics and historical context of photography, and cultivate the literacy of reading and thinking about images. The focus of the course includes: the "authenticity" of photography, the time and historical significance of photography, the community link of photography, the aesthetics and artistic expression of photography, the tradition and transformation of family albums, the narrative potential of photography, the reproduction politics of documentary photography, photography and emotion, human photography and gender culture, the ethics of photography, etc. This semester's course also arranges to visit exhibitions to guide students to carry out the basic skills of photography research, curation or practice.

entries.數個世紀以來，英國女皇伊莉莎白一世一直是歷史學家熱切關注的對象；她的形象多元而富: For centuries, Queen Elizabeth I of England has been the focus of historians; her image is diverse and controversial: she is the daughter of Henry VIII and the "great whore" Anne Boleyn, the sister who loves her brother like her life, the rival of two religious enemies Mary Tudor and Mary Stuart, and the famous virgin queen. And the literary works formed around these images - from Philip Sidney, John Riley, to Shakespeare and Spencer - together witnessed the golden age of England in the 16th century. From a modern perspective, how should we understand the various mirrors of Elizabeth in literary works? How do these phenomena reveal the interaction between literature and Renaissance politics? From what aspects can we think of her as the most important media influencer in England in the 16th century? This course will take these core issues as the starting point and carefully read a series of literary works focusing on the political image of Elizabeth I. This course is taught in English throughout the whole process, which is suitable for students who are interested in the history, culture and literature of the early modern period. Those who have studied English I or Shakespeare-related courses are especially preferred, but it is not a necessary condition.

It is hoped that through a more comprehensive introduction to Chinese ancient paintings, students can learn to appreciate and study these special works of art.
entries.本課程不安排需繳交及計分的作業。每次考試前公告練習題池，考試包含基本定義、定理及: This course does not arrange homework that needs to be submitted and scored. The practice pool is announced before each exam. The exam contains basic definitions, theorems and the relevant contents of the question pool. The examination is tentatively scheduled for the 5th, 11th and 16th weeks, and the actual date and scope will be handled according to the classroom announcement.
entries.本課程不指定單一教科書。課堂投影片為自編教材，涵蓋全部授課內容；每一頁引用的論文: This course does not specify a single textbook. The classroom video is a self-compiled textbook, covering all the teaching content; each page of the cited paper is marked with the source and arXiv number, and a complete list of references is attached at the end of each lecture.
entries.本課程不接受旁聽。本課程強調自我學習，修課同學必須於學期內指定時間內繳交自我學習: This course does not accept audience. This course emphasizes self-study, and students must submit self-study evaluation within the specified time during the semester. The self-study assessment will be announced in the first class. This course also solicits two course content recording assistants, which will be decided in the first class in a voluntary way. In addition, because the course participates in the Ministry of Education's plan to obtain financial subsidies, the course elective students will sign a consent form in the first class, and agree to use the course performance as a necessary teaching plan analysis report. Please read this course description in detail before choosing a course.
entries.本課程並不以單純的歷史介紹方式進行，而是圍繞著現、當代藝術的若干核心概念，輔以關: This course is not conducted in a simple way of historical introduction, but focuses on a number of core concepts of modern and contemporary art, supplemented by key work cases and continuously updated exhibitions and current affairs discussions, and guides students to build vertical and horizontal critical reading skills. Through gradual course schedule planning, we will be able to have a clear grasp of the following basic concepts, such as: modernity/postmodernity, autonomy, consumer society, mass/daily culture, urban space, landscape, art mechanism, body, identity, gender, mimicry, global/local. Finally, through classroom discussion and impromptu writing at the end of the term, students can gradually establish their own knowledge reference structure from the reading process and sort out a clear problem consciousness vein.
entries.本課程中將採用多元教學方式，包括個案分析、團體討論、企業個案實務、團體報告、以及: This course will adopt multiple teaching methods, including case analysis, group discussion, corporate case practice, group report, and teaching, to encourage students to think about the design and impact of the remuneration system from multiple perspectives such as strategy, organization and motivation. Through the integration of theory and practice, cultivate students' ability to plan remuneration policies, interpret enterprise practices and make suggestions, so that students can lay a solid foundation in the field of enterprise human resources management, consulting practice or academic research in the future.
entries.本課程主旨在協助同學走出教室、離開電腦或手機螢幕，認識真正的台灣社會，並且為社會: The main purpose of this course is to help students get out of the classroom, leave the computer or mobile phone screen, understand the real Taiwanese society, and do their part for the society. Students will learn what a field survey is and how to conduct a field survey, and then choose the topics they are interested in, conduct the survey in groups, and present the survey results in the form of stories at the end of the semester. This course will be combined with the next semester's course, and students will be asked to conduct field surveys and field survey reports in a year. Before the end of the next semester, students will be asked to start physical curation and exhibitions according to the results of the survey, and share the results of the field survey with the society, as well as with the interviewed groups. Within the scope of the consent of the interviewed groups, let more people know their brilliant stories and understand their ideas and situations.
entries.本課程主旨在於讓學生了解線性代數基本概念，並且能熟練地進行矩陣運算。除此之外，我: The main purpose of this course is to let students understand the basic concepts of linear algebra and be proficient in matrix operations. In addition, we will introduce the common algorithms of linear algebra (such as main component analysis and singular value decomposition, etc.), and a set of free numerical analysis software (Octave), so that students can learn how to use Octave to execute relevant algorithms.
entries.本課程主要介紹一些關於影像處理問題的數學研究。 它的兩個主要目標是：: This course mainly introduces some mathematical research on image processing problems. Its two main goals are:
entries.本課程主要介紹光學、雷射及輻射度學與光度學等基本原理，以及顯示器、LED、太陽光: This course mainly introduces the basic principles of optics, lasers, radiometry and photometry, as well as an overview of photoelectric applications such as displays, LEDs, solar energy and optical fiber communication. Through the study of this course, students will have a preliminary understanding of the basic principles and application overview of optical and optical application technology, and hope to apply the basic optical principles they have learned in their future work or life, so as to improve their workplace competitiveness or innovative application ability.
entries.本課程主要介紹功率半導體元件之基本原理、操作機制與功率電子應用，並探討其於新興綠: This course mainly introduces the basic principle, operating mechanism and application of power semiconductor components, and explores their important role in emerging green energy systems (such as electric vehicles, solar energy and wind power generation). The course content covers the basic introduction of power components, the principle of component crash voltage, the structure and operation principle of core power components such as Schottky diode, MOSFET and IGBT, and its application in high-efficiency power conversion circuits. In addition, the course will also introduce the new generation of power semiconductor technology and future development trends to establish students' complete basic concepts of modern power electronic components and systems.
entries.本課程主要介紹平面與三維歐氏空間中的曲線與曲面理論。第一部分將討論平面與空間中的: This course mainly introduces the theory of curves and surfaces in plane and three-dimensional Eucedean space. The first part will discuss the curves in the plane and space, and use the Frenet frame to analyze the local geometric properties of curves, such as curvature, torque and their geometric meaning. The second part will introduce the two-dimensional surfaces in three-dimensional space. The course will start from the basic definition of surfaces, discuss the tangent plane, the first basic type and the inner product on the surface, and then study the changes of normal vectors and the second basic type. Next, topics such as average curvature, Gaussian curvature, differentials and connections on curved surfaces, and geodesic equations will be introduced. Finally, the course will summarize the Gauss-Bonnes specific theory to explain how the local bending properties of a surface are deeply related to its overall topological structure.
entries.本課程主要介紹有限群 representation theory 的基本概念、工: This course mainly introduces the basic concepts, tools and important examples of finite group representation theory. The content includes basic tools such as irreducible representations, characters, character tables, restriction, induction, etc., and will discuss the representation theory of symmetric groups, dihedral groups and other small finite groups. The course will guide students to understand the core ideas and applications of finite group performance theory through the calculation and comparison of specific examples.
entries.本課程主要介紹資料結構之基本概念和理論，訓練學生熟悉以下之資料結構，如：陣列、矩: This course mainly introduces the basic concepts and theories of data structure, and trains students to be familiar with the following data structures, such as arrays, matrices, stacks, queues, sequences, trees, graphics, sorting, search and other algorithms.
entries.本課程主要介紹醫學影像檢查項目，包含一般Ｘ光、超音波、電腦斷層、磁振造影等檢查及: This course mainly introduces medical imaging examination items, including general X-ray, ultrasound, computer tomography, magnetic resonance imaging and other examinations, and the examination of different medical images with actual image processing algorithms. The goal of this course is to let students understand the principle of medical imaging and the basis of its characteristics, and through the practical application and operation of digital image processing technology, so that students can understand the importance of medical image processing in clinical medical diagnosis assistance, and provide a foundation for future further research, or entering the industry and other application fields.
entries.本課程主要介紹量子物理與統計物理的理論方法及其應用。課程首先建立必要的數學與物理: This course mainly introduces the theoretical methods and applications of quantum physics and statistical physics. The course first establishes the necessary mathematical and physical foundation, and then explores a number of important quantum and statistical physics problems to cultivate students' ability to analyze practical physical systems.
entries.本課程主要以動力學觀點探討車輛的動態操控性能與穩定性能，該二種性能決定了汽車的安: This course mainly discusses the dynamic control performance and stability performance of vehicles from the perspective of dynamics, which determine the safety and commerciality of automobiles. First, the automobile chassis system, the control performance index of the vehicle and their physical significance are introduced, and then the relationship between the characteristics of each chassis system and these performance indicators is introduced, and the dynamic model is used to link various performance indicators to gain an in-depth understanding of the theoretical basis of these indicators. Finally, the objective evaluation test and analysis methods of control performance and stability performance will be introduced.
entries.本課程主要以專題演講形式進行，邀請不同領域之講者分享其研究成果、技術發展、產業經: This course is mainly conducted in the form of special speeches, inviting speakers from different fields to share their research results, technological development, industry experience or career experience. The topic of the speech will cover various aspects related to information engineering, such as artificial intelligence, data science, systems and networks, information security, software and hardware integration, semiconductors and storage systems, software engineering, cloud computing, and other emerging technologies and applications. The course will also arrange students to participate in questions, discussions or writing experiences to promote the understanding and reflection of the content of the speech.
entries.本課程主要分成底下的四個單元講授，涵蓋基本土壤學與地下水水文學、土壤及地下水污染: This course is mainly divided into the following four units, covering basic soil science and groundwater hydrology, soil and groundwater pollution remediation methods, soil and groundwater pollution sources, types of soil and groundwater pollutants, types of soil and groundwater pollution, transmission characteristics of soil and groundwater pollutants, biogeological and chemical characteristics of soil and groundwater, investigation and identification, improvement and rehabilitation, underground storage tank cases, etc.
entries.本課程主要分為三部分：一是教授金文學的基礎知識；二是導讀商周金文材料；三是結合金: This course is mainly divided into three parts: first, to teach the basic knowledge of Jin literature; second, to guide the materials of Shang Zhou Jinwen; third, to combine the study of Jinwen and traditional literature to understand the culture and social system of two weeks. This course hopes that students can basically master the construction system and content style of Jinwen, and understand the political, military, economic, official system, book and other social systems from Shang to the two-week period. At the same time, improve students' methodological training, and cultivate the ability and interest in using ancient text materials to study and treat traditional classics.
entries.本課程主要協助學生研擬碩士論文題目、確認研究問題與論文方向，並引導學生進行相關文: This course mainly assists students in the preparation of master's thesis topics, confirms research questions and thesis directions, and guides students to collect relevant literature, research structure planning and preliminary analysis.
entries.本課程主要在加強英文的口說和寫作技巧 故將這兩部分每週穿插授課與練習: This course is mainly to strengthen English speaking and writing skills, so these two parts are interspersed with teaching and practice every week.
entries.本課程主要對原子尺度下模擬之方法，亦可稱為分子動力學，作一介紹。: This course mainly introduces the method of simulation at the atomic scale, also known as molecular dynamics.
entries.本課程主要從交流史的觀點來介紹亞洲藝術，分成「佛教美術在亞洲」、「中國美術的傳播: This course mainly introduces Asian art from the perspective of the history of exchange, and is divided into four themes: "Buddhist Art in Asia", "Dissemination of Chinese Art", "Contact with the West" and "Taiwan in Asia". Under each theme, select representative groups of works to explain the phenomenon of learning and reinterpretation of art in various parts of Asia under the mutual exchange. Not only that, this course also extends its perspective beyond Asia, exploring the collision and interaction between Asian art and Western art, mainly in Europe.
entries.本課程主要於本校黑盒子劇場授課，全學期將邀請七～八位不同領域專業講師，進行十七次: This course is mainly taught in the black box theater of our school. Seven to eight professional lecturers from different fields will be invited throughout the semester to conduct 17 professional lectures (including performance, directing, lighting, sound, stage supervision, etc., and there are also intensive stage installation and rehearsal courses before the end of the term presentation); students who are interested in drama production can learn the professional and complete creation and production process of theater works. This course also plans students' independent rehearsal time; 2025/12/12~12/215 is the theater week, and the stage installation, performance, stage disassembly and other work presented at the end of the term will be carried out; if you can't attend the whole process, please do not choose. This course emphasizes teamwork. Except for bereavement leave and sick leave with diagnosis certificate, all other leaves are not allowed; those who are absent will not be subject to the final grades. The progress of the detailed course is continuously updated. If you are interested in taking the course, please pay special attention to arranging the time in advance.
entries.本課程主要於本校黑盒子劇場授課，全學期將邀請七～八位不同領域專業講師，進行十六次: This course is mainly taught in the black box theater of our school. Seven to eight professional lecturers in different fields will be invited throughout the semester to conduct 16 professional lectures (including performance, directing, lighting, sound, stage supervision, etc., and there are also intensive stage and rehearsal courses before the end of the presentation; students who are interested in drama production can learn the professional and complete creation and production process of theater works. This course also plans students' independent rehearsal time; 2026/12/16~12/21 is the theater week, and the final stage installation, performance, stage disassembly and other work will be carried out; if you can't attend the whole process, please do not choose. This course emphasizes teamwork. Except for bereavement leave and sick leave with diagnosis certificate, all other leaves are not allowed; those who are absent will not be subject to the final grades. The progress of the detailed course is continuously updated. If you are interested in taking the course, please pay special attention to arranging the time in advance.
entries.本課程主要涵蓋下面主題 :: This course mainly covers the following topics:
entries.本課程主要涵蓋力學、流體力學與熱力學等主題，課程內容將以教材第 1 至第 21: This course mainly covers topics such as mechanics, fluid mechanics and thermodynamics. The course content will be mainly based on Chapters 1 to 21 of the textbook.
entries.本課程主要為電機系大一新生設計，與其他電機系課程有密切關聯。請預期需要花費大量時: This course is mainly designed for freshmen in the Department of Electrical Engineering, and is closely related to other courses in the Department of Electrical Engineering. Please expect to spend a lot of time practicing code and reading supplementary materials. It is strongly recommended to choose the "Introduction to Computer Practice" course at the same time. The exercises of this course will directly assist the program work of this course. Students who are not in the Department of Electrical Engineering should carefully consider whether to take the course. This course is heavy, and you may need to supplement the basic knowledge of the relevant electrical field by yourself.
entries.本課程主要目標是建立基本統計知識，建立基本能力發展更複雜統計概念與應用。: The main goal of this course is to establish basic statistical knowledge and establish basic ability to develop more complex statistical concepts and applications.
entries.本課程主要目的在培養英文學術寫作所需之分析與論證技巧，以傳達清晰、精簡與有說服力: The main purpose of this course is to cultivate the analysis and argumentation skills required for English academic writing, with the goal of conveying clear, concise and persuasive writing.
entries.本課程主要目的在增進同學們對測驗與評量之基礎知識，並培養同學運用課室評量之能力，: The main purpose of this course is to improve students' basic knowledge of testing and assessment, and to cultivate students' ability to use classroom assessment, so as to meet the expectations of the 12-year national education for teachers. The course topics include teaching and evaluation plans, the design of classroom evaluation, important concepts related to classical test theory, and evaluation result reports. At the same time, students will strengthen their skills in the development of evaluation tools by writing and analyzing test questions, so as to lay the foundation for students' professional intelligence to use learning evaluation in teaching in the future.
entries.本課程主要目的在增進地科系大一新生對系上各教師專業領域的認識，除了增強學生對本系: The main purpose of this course is to enhance the freshmen of the Department of Geosciences' understanding of the professional fields of teachers in the department. In addition to enhancing students' sense of identity with the department, it also helps them find relevant interests and plan their learning direction for the next four years in advance. In addition, this course also invites teachers from two schools of applied geology and hydrology and oceanography to participate in order to enhance students' understanding and opportunities for interdisciplinary learning.
entries.本課程主要目的在於介紹壽險公司的投資與管理實務，包括商品設計、資金運用、投資管理: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the investment and management practices of life insurance companies, including commodity design, capital use, investment management, the application of financial technology in life insurance management and marketing, as well as the prospects and supervision management of the life insurance industry. Through the teacher's overview, news analysis report, and inviting the manager of Xinguang Life to cooperate and explain, students can gain an in-depth understanding of the role of the life insurance industry in the financial industry and the relevant practical operation, and finally publish the results through groups.
entries.本課程主要目的在於強化學生華語作為二語教學之專業知能。修習完畢並通過學期成績評量: The main purpose of this course is to strengthen students' professional knowledge of Chinese as a second language teaching. Students who have completed the study and passed the semester performance evaluation should be able to:
entries.本課程主要目的是介紹專案管理知識中的「專案採購管理」專業知識，透過專案採購管理所: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the professional knowledge of "project procurement management" in project management knowledge. Through the basic knowledge required for project procurement management, the domestic government procurement law, and the analysis of actual procurement cases (engineering, property and labor), students can master the procurement management knowledge that should be available in the process of project implementation. In addition, in order to increase the application of students' learning of procurement knowledge, this course familiarizes students with the operation and practical knowledge of bidding and bidding through the simulation of procurement bidding and bidding.
entries.本課程主要目的是教導學生學習BIM(Building Information M: The main purpose of this course is to teach students to learn about BIM (Building Information Modeling) knowledge and technology, and to be familiar with Project Management software and technology. Through practical exercises, students can understand the practical application of BIM and computer technology in construction management, and improve students' computer application ability.
entries.本課程主要目的是要介紹資料探勘技術在電子商務的應用，基於此目的，本課程首先介紹資: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the application of data mining technology in e-commerce. Based on this purpose, this course first introduces the definition and importance of data mining, and then introduces the main technologies of data mining, including prediction and classification technology, grouping technology, association rules, etc. Next, we will discuss the application of data mining technology in business practice.
entries.本課程主要目的是讓學生瞭解如何進行學位論文之寫作與其成果之發表，課程內容除介紹學: The main purpose of this course is to let students understand how to write the thesis and publish its results. In addition to introducing the necessary components of the thesis, the course content will also introduce different forms of publication channels and skills such as seminar papers and journal papers, so that students can be familiar with how to publish the research results of the thesis in writing and orally, so as to improve their ability to write and publish, and thus improve the readability and value of the research results.
entries.本課程主要目的是讓學生瞭解研究進行的完整過程，藉由研究問題分析、研究計畫規劃、資: The main purpose of this course is to let students understand the complete process of research. Through the analysis of research problems, research planning, introduction of data collection tools, introduction of research methods, writing and presentation of research results reports and other topics, students can understand how to plan and carry out future research. In addition, this course will assist students in establishing and completing the theme and plan of future thesis through the introduction of past research results and methods, as well as future research topics, through teachers or invited speakers.
entries.本課程主要目的為將遙測影像處理與分析常用的原理及技巧系統性地介紹給學生，以培養學: The main purpose of this course is to systematically introduce the principles and techniques commonly used in telemetry image processing and analysis to students, so as to cultivate students' ability to use various telemetry data for various applications in the future. The course content includes the introduction of telemetry image characteristics and formats, image correction, display enhancement, conversion, and analysis of various image feature extraction and classification.

The main purpose of this course is to systematically introduce the principles and techniques commonly used in telemetry image processing and analysis to students, so as to cultivate students' ability to use various telemetry data for various applications in the future. The course content includes the introduction of telemetry image characteristics and formats, image correction, enhancement, conversion, and analysis of various image feature extraction and classification. entries.本課程主要目的除教授生產管理基礎知識，更介紹生產與作業管理研究脈絡與演進。於拓展: The main purpose of this course is not only to teach the basic knowledge of production management, but also to introduce the research context and evolution of production and operation management. In order to expand the basic learning goal of expanding the boundaries of production and operation management research, students need to study relevant journal papers, improve their ability to independently study and publish papers, and at the same time reflect the learning results of this course.
entries.本課程主要透過文本的研讀及相關圖像資料的賞析，以評介現當代法國文學與社會文化發展: This course mainly evaluates several aspects of contemporary French literature and social and cultural development through the study of texts and the appreciation of relevant image materials. In addition to guiding students to appreciate the principle method of form and theme, it also further observes and understands the context of the relevant times from the texts of different media.
entries.本課程乃以激發同學自學精神而習得新知方法進行，授課時間共計十六週。進度是學期前十: This course is conducted to stimulate students' self-study spirit and learn new knowledge methods. The teaching time is 16 weeks in total. The progress is to take the teaching and explanation method in the first ten weeks of the semester to establish the foundation for students. Starting from the eleventh week, the Flipped Class Model will be adopted, that is, the reading materials will be designated, and the elective students will explain and discuss in the classroom, share reading knowledge, and then the teacher will comment and summarize. Note: There is no homework in this course, but there is classwork. Flipping teaching implementation process: designated reading materials -- class report -- scoring. Summary of the class mode of flipped teaching: * The first ten weeks: traditional teaching - classroom explanation - laying the foundation of learning, grouping assignment of reading SCI thesis ability * Scheduled flipping teaching - classroom presentation implementation method time: 11/09/2026.
entries.本課程之主要目標在提供學習者有關公共管理的系統性知識，包括公共管理的基本概念、發: The main goal of this course is to provide learners with systematic knowledge of public management, including the basic concepts of public management, development trends, theoretical systems, management strategies, etc., so that learners can understand the trend of government innovation and administrative innovation, and have the basic literacy of modern public sector managers.
entries.本課程之主要目標是學習解大型線性系統與特徵值問題的數值方法，並藉由學習這些數值方: The main goal of this course is to learn numerical methods for solving large linear systems and eigenvalue problems, and to deepen the understanding of the important contents related to applications in linear algebra through the process of learning these numerical methods. At the same time, students must learn how to solve problems related to linear algebra with the help of computers.
entries.本課程之學習願景，在於培養兼具 科學素養、表達能力、社會關懷與公民責任 的大一學: The learning vision of this course is to cultivate freshmen with scientific literacy, expression ability, social care and civic responsibility, so that they can become seed talents for the promotion of space science knowledge and public participation in the future. The main learning objectives are as follows:
entries.本課程之教學內容主要是對於平面顯示器製程與常用之材料製造方法和原理為學生進行教學: The teaching content of this course is mainly to teach students about the process of flat panel display and the manufacturing methods and principles of commonly used materials.
