entries.本課程之期末評量分為兩種，修課同學可視自身意願自由選擇：期末考與行動參與。期末考: The final evaluation of this course is divided into two types. Students can freely choose according to their own wishes: final examination and action participation. The final exam is a thesis question, focusing on the absorption and critical thinking of the course content; the action participation will work as a class assistant of the Taoyuan Branch of the Zhixinlu Foundation, and write experiences after the course.
entries.本課程之目標希望經由初步的文獻閱讀與討論，帶領同學認識與思考「客家文化」在不同時: The goal of this course is to lead students to understand and think about the diverse appearance of "Hakka culture" under the interaction of different periods, different regions and different ethnic groups through preliminary literature reading and discussion.
entries.本課程之目標為引導學生將上學期於模擬軟體中所建立之理論模型與設計成果進一步實際化: The goal of this course is to guide students to further practicalize and systematize the theoretical models and design results established in the simulation software last semester, and cultivate students' ability to integrate from virtual simulation to physical construction through the practical process. The course content focuses on the design, assembly, testing and verification of the actual system, so that students can understand the differences and limitations between the theoretical model and the real system, and learn the ability of problem analysis, system integration, experimental operation and engineering improvement. Through practical thematic production and system construction training, students' ability in engineering practical application, teamwork and independent problem solving can be improved, so as to strengthen their foundation for relevant research or engineering practice in the future.
entries.本課程之目的乃對於航空工程技術及原理作廣泛、深入而淺出的介紹，以期學生能瞭解航太: The purpose of this course is to make an extensive, in-depth and shallow introduction to the technology and principles of aviation engineering, so that students can have a basic understanding of the field classification, development history, technical status, working principle, types of flight vehicles, aircraft components, aviation engineering system integration and future direction of aerospace engineering, and have a basic understanding of the relevant technologies of aerospace engineering. This course will be based on classroom teaching, teaching students aviation engineering technology, flight-related principles, propulsion system technology and civil aviation and other related knowledge. The basic subject knowledge of this course includes basic mathematics, engineering mechanics, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics. The subject content will include the basic theory of heat flow and engineering practice.
entries.本課程之目的乃對於電化學能源系統及檢測方式作系統性、深入而淺出的介紹，以期學生能: The purpose of this course is to provide a systematic, in-depth and shallow introduction to electrochemical energy systems and detection methods, so that students can have a basic understanding of the existing types, application fields, technical status, working principles, system composition, analysis methods and theoretical foundations of electrochemical energy systems, and have a basic understanding of the relevant technologies of electrochemical energy systems. This course will be mainly taught in the classroom, supplemented by experimental and experiential learning. At the same time, with classroom discussion, it will teach students basic electrochemical knowledge, various electrochemical energy systems, electrochemical analysis methods of electrochemical energy systems and other related knowledge. The basic subject knowledge of this course includes basic chemistry, thermodynamics, electrode dynamics and electrochemistry. The types of electrochemical energy taught include secondary batteries, fuel cells, electrogas conversion technology, electrochemical pumps, etc. The electrochemical analysis methods taught include potential step, scanning potential, cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical resistance, etc.
entries.本課程之目的在使同學對1949年之後的戲曲有更全面的認識，並對培養同學針對相關主: The purpose of this course is to give students a more comprehensive understanding of opera after 1949, and to cultivate students' ability to conduct in-depth research on relevant topics.
entries.本課程之目的在協助學生理解與學習於人工智慧以及機械學習領域之中的數學基礎，進而獲: The purpose of this course is to help students understand and learn the mathematical foundations in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning, so as to gain the ability of data analysis, modeling and grouping.
entries.本課程之目的是希望學生學習光的基本傳播現象，並以幾何光學來探討光在透明介質中傳播: The purpose of this course is to hope that students will learn the basic propagation phenomenon of light, and use geometric optics to explore the physical phenomenon of light propagation in transparent media and optical design software. It is expected that students can understand the basic phenomena of light, use Gaussian geometric optics to theoretically calculate and analyze basic optical systems, and be able to recognize optical design software and perform simple operations.
entries.本課程也會特別強調海洋與大氣遙測，包括海表溫度、海色、葉綠素濃度、懸浮物、海面高: This course will also emphasize the scientific significance and application value of ocean and atmospheric telemetry, including the scientific significance and application value of observation data such as sea surface temperature, sea color, chlorophyll concentration, suspended matter, sea surface height, sea surface wind field, rainfall, clouds, gas glue and typhoons. At the same time, the course will introduce the latest satellite missions and telemetry technology developments, such as high-resolution optical satellites, synthetic aperture radars, ocean watercolor satellites, meteorological satellites, cubic satellites and artificial intelligence-assisted telemetry image analysis, so that students can understand the important role of telemetry technology in climate change, marine environment, natural disasters, land monitoring and sustainable development.
entries.本課程介紹 Python 程式設計的基本概念、語法與實作技巧，培養學生的運算思維: This course introduces the basic concepts, grammar and practical skills of Python programming, and cultivates students' computational thinking, program design and problem-solving ability. The course guides students to transform problems into executable code through code implementation and application. After studying this course, students will have the ability to read, write and modify basic Python code, and lay the foundation for subsequent data analysis and finance-related courses.
This course introduces the concept of using Python programming language, and leads students to write code related to management issues. The course will briefly describe the concepts of statistics, data visualization, measurement regression and machine learning, and equip students with the ability of basic program design, data collection and data analysis.
entries.本課程介紹各式材料分析儀器在化工與材料科學上之應用發展及其基本結構，期使學生獲得: This course introduces the application development and basic structure of various material analysis instruments in chemical and materials science, so that students can acquire the principle of material analysis instruments and cultivate students' understanding of the technology and application ability of operating analysis instruments.
entries.本課程介紹基本的總體經濟理論與應用，希望修習者能理解台灣及世界重要的總體經濟現象: This course introduces the basic overall economic theory and application, hoping that the students can understand the important overall economic phenomena in Taiwan and the world, and the overall economic policy effects of the government, and lay the foundation for the study of advanced overall economics in the future. In order to achieve these goals, in addition to introducing theories, this course will also introduce topics related to Taiwan's overall economic performance, including: Taiwan's substantial salary trend, Taiwan's unemployment, Taiwan's annual growth rate of money supply, GDP flattening index annual growth rate and money circulation rate, etc., hoping that students can have a deep understanding of the overall economic theory and Taiwan's overall economic phenomenon.
entries.本課程介紹學生應用地質各領域常使用的數學方法，學生從中可學習相關數學方法的概念、: This course introduces students' application of mathematical methods commonly used in various fields of geology, from which students can learn the concepts, theories, mathematical derivation and explanatory examples of relevant mathematical methods.
entries.本課程介紹宋明理學重要的思想家學說，藉由重要文獻的選讀，理解宋代學者如何承接中唐: This course introduces the doctrine of important thinkers in the Song and Ming Dynasties. Through the selection of important literature, it understands how the scholars of the Song Dynasty undertook the revival of Confucianism and the thought of the Middle and Tang Dynasties, and gradually carried forward the ideas of Confucianism itself, especially in the theory of the universe and the theory of the mind, from the theory of the mind to the theory of the mind. The development of the theory of the mind in the Ming Dynasty was particularly detailed. The greater the tension of the Confucianism and the discussion of Buddhism, the deeper the negotiation, and the deeper the issues of the heart. Through the discussion of the ideological literature of various schools, it is expected that it can train students' ability of logical reasoning and literature interpretation, and at the same time have a more accurate grasp of the context of science in the Song and Ming Dynasties.
entries.本課程介紹戰後女作家及其作品，文類以小說和散文為主，進一步研討當前學者對女作家群: This course introduces post-war female writers and their works. The literary category is mainly novels and prose, and further studies the current scholars' research on female writers. In addition, the exploration of various topics in recent years, including women, gender, maternal employment, history, national writing, etc. In addition to the works of contemporary female writers, it also refers to relevant Western discussions. Through joint discussions, personal reports and paper writing, we can sort out the writing style of female writers of different generations after the war and understand the issues that female writers are concerned about today.
entries.本課程介紹攝影測量的理論及數位處理方式，包含成像幾何、攝影測量方位求解、空中三角: This course introduces the theory and digital processing methods of photogrammetry, including imaging geometry, photogrammetry azimmetry solution, aerial triangulation, image matching, and satellite image geometry correction, etc. Students also need to gain experience in realizing digital photogrammetry methods through homework.
entries.本課程介紹機率論的基本概念及其在實際問題中的應用。內容包括組合分析、機率公理、條: This course introduces the basic concepts of probability theory and its application in practical problems. The content includes the introduction of combination analysis, probability axiom, conditional probability, random variable, expected value, common probability distribution, limit theorem, and stochastic processes. This course emphasizes problem-solving ability and critical thinking.
entries.本課程介紹歷史人類學的相關理念，主要以華南研究爲參考架構。並以田野與社區為個案，: This course introduces the relevant concepts of historical anthropology, mainly taking South China research as a reference framework. And take the field and the community as a case, cultivate the ability to participate in observation and analysis, and dialogue with literature and historical materials. I hope that students can combine the theories used in the classroom, return to their own research topics, and deepen their theoretical thinking ability and application. The main contents are tentatively tentatively as follows:
entries.本課程介紹狹義相對論的基本原理，並建立四維時空的數學描述。學生將學習洛倫茲變換、: This course introduces the basic principles of special relativity and establishes a mathematical description of four-dimensional space-time. Students will learn Lorentz transformation, four-dimensional vectors, relativity representation of energy and momentum, and the covariant form of electromagnetic field, and understand how Einstein unified mechanics and electromagnetism in the same space-time framework.
entries.本課程介紹現代微分幾何的基礎理論，重點在於介紹光滑流形（smooth manif: This course introduces the basic theory of modern differential geometry, focusing on the basics of smooth manifolds. Starting from the basic concepts of smooth mapping, tangent space and vector field, the course establishes a theoretical framework for describing geometric structures in a coordinate-independent way. The main contents include manifory and sub-manity, smooth mapping and immersion and embedding, cut bundles and cotantant bundles, differential form and external differentiation, unit decomposition (partitions of unity), and integral theory on manifics. The course focuses on rigorous mathematical reasoning and analysis of examples, and explores the relationship between local coordinate representation and overall geometric properties. After completing this course, students will have the basic knowledge and tools needed to further study differential geometry, topology, mathematical physics and related fields. Students who have taded advanced calculus or introduction to analysis in their juniors and seniors are welcome to electives.
entries.本課程介紹現代網際網路的基本架構、協定分層與主要運作機制，採用由上而下的教學方式: This course introduces the basic structure, protocol layering and main operating mechanism of the modern Internet. It adopts a top-down teaching method. Starting from the network applications that students are familiar with, it gradually explains how the underlying communication technology supports various network services. The course content includes application layer agreements and services such as Web, Email, DNS, audio and video streaming, transmission layer mechanisms such as UDP/TCP, reliable data transmission, traffic control and congestion control, network layer topics such as IP, router, packet transfer, routing algorithm and network control plane, as well as link layers and connection network technologies such as Ethernet, switch, wireless network and mobile network. The course will also introduce the basic concepts and common security mechanisms of network security, so that students can understand the overall operation of network systems from application to basic transmission architecture.
entries.本課程介紹相關的程式設計技術，透過這些學習使學生具有解決較大型問題和複雜問題的能: This course introduces relevant programming techniques, through which students have the ability to solve large and complex problems.
entries.本課程介紹財務管理的意涵及基本觀念, 協助同學理解企業中財務管理的重要性及實際操: This course introduces the implications and basic concepts of financial management, and helps students understand the importance and practical operation of financial management in enterprises. The course will cover financial report analysis, securities evaluation, capital market and capital budget and capital structure of enterprises. It is expected that students will be able to recognize and propose solutions to the financial management issues of enterprises at the end of the course. This course will be arranged by the Information Office, Capital Security Office and Digital Finance Office of Changhua Bank. The theme is the information system architecture of the financial industry, the application of emerging technology, digital transformation and information security, in order to enable students to have a deeper understanding of the application scope of information in the financial industry and how to integrate information into the financial industry.
entries.本課程介紹迴歸分析的理論與發展。目標讓學生理解理論背景，並學習使用統計方法處理各: This course introduces the theory and development of regression analysis. The goal is to enable students to understand the theoretical background and learn to use statistical methods to deal with various practical problems.
entries.本課程介紹防災領域常用之資訊分析工具，包括地理資訊系統（GIS）、Microso: This course introduces the information analysis tools commonly used in the field of disaster prevention, including geographic information system (GIS), Microsoft Excel and other information analysis software, and explains the collection, integration and analysis methods of disaster potential data, exposure data, socio-economic data and spatial data. The course will discuss the application of various information tools in disaster risk assessment, spatial analysis, disaster prevention planning and decision support, and introduce the application of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in disaster prevention data analysis. In addition to theoretical lectures, it also focuses on case analysis and software practice to cultivate students' ability of disaster prevention information analysis and practical application.
entries.本課程介紹雲端基礎知識與雲端平台，以Amazon AWS為示範性的雲端平台，帶領: This course introduces the basic knowledge of the cloud and the cloud platform. With Amazon AWS as a model cloud platform, it leads students to carry out practical operations in the cloud, so that students can better understand the process of setting up cloud applications. In addition, this course will also encourage students to take certificates related to Amazon/Microsoft/Google cloud platform. In order to more closely combine theory and practice, this course requires students to form a team of 1 to 3 people and work together to complete a final special production of customized topics and functions.
entries.本課程介紹電化學加工原理及其應用，針對各式材料加工領域，特別是電化學反應理論、製: This course introduces the principle of electrochemical processing and its application. For various material processing fields, especially electrochemical reaction theory, electric field and flow field design analysis in the process, key parameter characteristics, processing equipment system, surface characteristics after processing, etc., through designated homework and reports, students can understand the relevant doctrines and application knowledge of electrochemical processing. It also allows students to learn through laboratory visits and demonstrations. Students can learn how to solve the processing problems of metal and non-metallic materials that are difficult to process in engineering with the theory of electrochemistry, and the unique technical characteristics of electrochemistry can be applied to the semiconductor industry, national defense aviation industry, medical equipment industry, vehicle and other industrial work.
entries.本課程介紹電極–溶液界面的基本結構、電荷分布及反應機制，涵蓋電雙層理論、表面吸附: This course introduces the basic structure, charge distribution and reaction mechanism of the electrode-solution interface, covering important topics such as electric double layer theory, surface adsorption, metal electrodeposition, electrocatalytic reaction and interface dynamics. The course also combines modern surface analysis technology and in-situ electrochemical measurement methods to explore the relationship between atomic-scale interface structure and electrochemical properties, and cultivate students' ability to understand electrochemical interface phenomena and analyze experimental data.
entries.本課程以 Peng Ding 著作 A First Course in Caus: This course takes Peng Ding's A First Course in Causal Inference as the main textbook, and with the teacher-designated journal papers and supplementary handouts as auxiliary textbooks to extend the introduction of Bayesian causal inference, Bayesian nonparametric causal inference, and related theories and application development. The main reference papers include Li, Ding and Mealli (2023), Bayesian causal inference: a critical review; Shams and Beierholm (2022), Bayesian causal inference: A unifying neuroscience theory; Linero and Antonelli (2023), The how and why of Bayesian nonparametric causal inference.
entries.本課程以 Tropp 講義第 1–15 章的核心內容為主線，採 16 週安排：4: This course takes the core content of Chapters 1–15 of the Tropp handout as the main line, with a 16-week schedule: 4 weeks of measure theory, 5 weeks of probability foundation, 4 weeks of independent sum and large number law, and another 3 weeks of examination. The star number extension, technical appendix and longer construction certificate of each chapter should be selected according to the progress of the class.
entries.本課程以⼈⽂、社會等學院學⽣為主，資訊理⼯學⽣為輔所設計，針對社會財富議題進⾏教: This course is mainly designed for students of humanities, social and other colleges, supplemented by students of information science and technology. It teaches on social wealth issues, and conducts data mining, analysis and visualization with databases such as economy and domestic affairs. Through the application of several software, it improves students' data software application ability.
entries.本課程以《Introduction to Solid State Physics: This course takes Chapters 1 to 6 of Introduction to Solid State Physics as the core content, and introduces the basic concepts and theoretical foundations of solid state physics. The course will build students' understanding of crystal structure, inverted lattice, eversion theory, lattice vibration, free electron model and energy band theory, and cultivate students' ability to analyze the structure, thermal properties and electronic properties of solid materials.
entries.本課程以「21 世紀種子教師訓練營」的形式進行，透過研究、釐清、應用與反思四個核: This course is conducted in the form of "21st Century Seed Teacher Training Camp". Through the four core processes of research, clarification, application and reflection, it will lead you to deeply master four key teaching methods (direct teaching method, inquiry learning, cooperative learning, flipping classroom). You will learn how to design learning activities, plan teaching materials, and develop the professional perspective of "learning experience designer". The core task of "Learning Experience Designer" is to teach students how to think and how to learn. In order to achieve this goal, you need to fully master every aspect of learning, including lesson plan design, learning activities, textbook arrangement, the role of students and teachers, etc. This course will help you cultivate these abilities through theoretical discussion of four teaching methods, lesson plan design, course observation and discussion, practical reflection, etc., and finally become an innovative teacher who can shape the learning environment and learning experience.
entries.本課程以「城市、全球史與AI敘事」為核心，透過歷史、藝術與哲學的跨域整合，引導學: This course takes "city, global history and AI narrative" as the core. Through the cross-domain integration of history, art and philosophy, it guides students to understand that history is not only the memory of events and eras, but also the analysis and interpretation of the flow of human society, space, objects and knowledge. The course takes Nuremberg as a case to train students to observe historical changes from the perspective of global history, learn to use cities, images and material culture as research objects, and build historical reading, problem awareness formation and historical narrative ability. At the same time, AI tools are introduced in historical material collation, comparative analysis and narrative generation, so as to cultivate students' humanistic literacy and critical thinking ability in the digital age, so that they have the basic ability of cross-domain learning, historical reflection and independent research. After completing the course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程以「太空科學知識轉譯、公共溝通與社會參與」為核心，規劃大一學生透過太空科學: With "space science knowledge translation, public communication and social participation" as the core, this course plans for freshmen to transform the originally more professional space science knowledge into content suitable for campus, community, primary and secondary school students or the general public through the study, sorting, promotion and service practice of space science themes. The curriculum not only attaches importance to the establishment of students' basic knowledge of space science, but also emphasizes their public responsibility and social care as university citizens, and cultivates their ability to link their professional knowledge with social needs. This course needs to design a one-day science camp activity, which will be held on the weekend around the 12th week, and will be completed in a team-team mode.
entries.本課程以「完成一份可執行的教育研究計畫」為主軸，每週課程內容均對應期末研究計畫的: This course is based on "completing an executable educational research plan", and the weekly course content corresponds to a part of the final research plan. Students will start from the idea of the research topic, gradually complete the research questions, literature review, research structure, research design, research tools and data analysis planning, and finally complete the revision of the research plan through oral presentation and peer feedback.
entries.本課程以「工程科技應用於地方社會實踐」為核心，結合智慧防災、能源與減碳及永續環境: This course takes "the application of engineering science and technology to local social practice" as the core, combines the themes of intelligent disaster prevention, energy, carbon reduction and sustainable environment, and guides students to understand how engineering science and technology can respond to local needs and sustainable development issues through theory and practice.
entries.本課程以「從服務中學習、從參與中反思」為核心，透過線上志工服務、校園公共活動參與: This course takes "learning from service and reflection from participation" as the core. Through online volunteer service, participation in campus public activities and personal reflection, it guides students to understand the relationship between information technology and social services, and cultivates civic responsibility, information literacy, teamwork and humanistic care ability.
entries.本課程以「產業問題轉化為可執行專題」為核心，訓練學生將實際產業需求拆解為工程問題: This course takes "industrial problems into executable topics" as the core, trains students to disassemble actual industrial needs into engineering problems, and gradually put forward actionable solutions through system planning, technology integration, prototype implementation and test verification.
entries.本課程以「科技賦權」為核心，培育大學生教育團隊透過零收費公益資電營隊，服務桃竹苗: With "Science and Technology Empowerment" as the core, this course cultivates college student education teams to serve disadvantaged groups in local or remote villages through zero-fee public welfare capital and electricity camps, and to implement the university social responsibility of "information empowerment and social restoration".
entries.本課程以「自我探索、團隊合作、社會關懷、實踐反思與永續行動」為核心，透過藝術紓壓: With "self-exploration, teamwork, social care, practical reflection and sustainable action" as the core, this course guides freshmen of the Department of Mechanical Engineering to gradually extend from "knowing themselves" to "understanding others", "understanding society" and "responding to social needs" through diversified learning activities such as artistic pressure, concentration training, enterprise visits, experience sharing and off-campus services.
entries.本課程以「認識社會、拓展視野、實踐參與」為核心，透過多元講座、校園資源探索、專業: This course takes "understanding society, broadening horizons, and practical participation" as the core. Through diversified lectures, campus resource exploration, professional and international forum internships, and cross-cultural exchanges and services, it guides students to get out of the traditional classroom, understand society, explore themselves from actual participation, observation and interaction, and expand their understanding of professional fields, industrial development and international environment. The course emphasizes the learning process of "doing middle school and thinking in learning". It is expected that students will extend what they have learned in the classroom to real life and social situations, cultivate a sense of responsibility, empathy and initiative in the process of service, communication and practice, and gradually establish a spirit of service and citizenship. The objectives of the course are as follows:
entries.本課程以二十世紀法國小說為內容範圍。課程進行方式除教師講授帶領，亦重視課堂討論與: This course covers French novels in the 20th century. In addition to the guidance of teachers, the course also attaches importance to classroom discussion and dialogue.
entries.本課程以人工智慧框架-PyTorch為深度學習建模工具，以實際案例一步步帶領學生: This course takes the artificial intelligence framework - PyTorch as a deep learning modeling tool, and leads students to create deep learning projects step by step with actual cases. A complete model is made from the data set, pre-training setting and initialization. Then carry out the training and verification of the model, evaluate the performance of the model, and use the evaluation indicators and data amplification to improve the training effect. Students who want to take the elective study need to initially have the basic concept of artificial intelligence/deep learning and the basic design ability of C++ and Python programs. After learning through the course, students will be able to independently design a complete in-depth learning project.
entries.本課程以北宋父子詞人晏殊和晏幾道的詞為範疇，透過內容的詮釋、技巧的分析、意境的融: This course takes the words of Yan Shu and Yan Jidao, the father and son lyricists of the Northern Song Dynasty, as the category. Through the interpretation of content, the analysis of skills, and the integration of artistic mood, students can recognize and understand the unique aesthetic characteristics of the words, as well as the different styles caused by the different personalities and opportunities of the lyricists.
entries.本課程以台灣社會經濟發展的重要課題為講授單元，包括地方開發、土地水利、農業、工業: This course takes important topics of Taiwan's socio-economic development as the teaching unit, including local development, land water conservancy, agriculture, industry, commercial trade, transportation, society and class, environmental change, etc. Taking the times as the history and the theme as the way, from the views of important classic works at different stages and the supporting evidence of historical materials, the discussion is intertwined, so that students can understand the continuity and changes of Taiwan's economic development. In addition to teachers' lectures, the class also focuses on students' reading of historical literature, training their observation and thinking skills, so as to understand the ins and outs of today's society and economy.
entries.本課程以大一同學為優先: This course is given priority to freshman students.
entries.本課程以大學社會責任（USR）與地方永續發展為核心，結合本校 mbhoyaw「復: This course takes university social responsibility (USR) and local sustainable development as the core, and combines the practical experience of smart disaster prevention, energy and carbon reduction and sustainable environment promoted by our school's mbhoyaw "revival" USR in the revival area, to guide students to apply engineering science and technology knowledge to real field problems.
entries.本課程以大氣科學相關產業議題為核心，透過課程討論、文獻閱讀與回顧、資料分析及專題: This course takes atmospheric science-related industrial issues as the core. Through course discussion, literature reading and review, data analysis and special research, it guides students to explore the application of atmospheric science in meteorology, air quality, environmental monitoring, disaster prevention and other fields. The course will cultivate students' ability of research problem analysis, data processing and interpretation, literature integration and scientific communication, and strengthen students' ability to apply atmospheric science expertise to practical industrial problems through special achievement reports.
entries.本課程以專題演講與互動討論為主要授課方式，預計邀請多位來自產業界、政府部門及學術: This course takes special speeches and interactive discussions as the main teaching methods. It is expected that many speakers from the industry, government departments and academic circles will be invited, and each speaker will share the topic for about two hours. The topic of the speech covers important issues related to enterprise management, including but not limited to strategic management, marketing management, organization and human resources management, financial and decision-making analysis, innovation and entrepreneurship, digital transformation, science and technology management, artificial intelligence and big data analysis, sustainable development, ESG, and other emerging management topics. Students will understand the theoretical development, practical challenges and research opportunities in different fields through pre-class preparation, special speeches, Q&A exchanges and after-class reflection, and cultivate the ability to analyze enterprise and management issues from multiple perspectives.
entries.本課程以工程實務問題為主軸，並結合七大課群的核心，邀請業界專家出題，針對永續、淨: This course takes engineering practical problems as the main axis, and combines the core of the seven major course groups. Industry experts are invited to ask questions, and different practical questions are designed for issues such as persistence and net zero, so as to echo the core concepts of each theme course group. And through students' problem-solving, the ability of students's teamwork is emphasized, so that students can unify the professional skills they have learned in the past, apply the knowledge and ability acquired in the course, so that students can learn how to solve complex engineering problems, and show the learning results and accept the learning results through the results presentation.
entries.本課程以德國 Festo 智慧工廠 CP-Factory 為實作平台，透過四學期: This course takes the German Festo intelligent factory CP-Factory as the practice platform, and cultivates students' intelligent manufacturing and production system integration ability through gradual special practice in the four semesters. CP-Factory is a reduced version of the real production system. Students can integrate mechanisms, electromechanical control and system software in a situation close to the actual industrial environment, and master the operation mode of the intelligent production system through virtual and real integration. The objectives of the course are as follows:
entries.本課程以文藝復興至19世紀中葉西方藝術的發展為範疇，主要依時代順序討論藝術的產製: This course takes the development of Western art from the Renaissance to the mid-19th century as the category. It mainly discusses the production of art, the characteristics of works and its relationship with religion, politics, society, economy and culture in the order of the times. It explores the evolution of art forms, style, technology and concepts. At the same time, it also explores the relationship between "art" and other fields, and reflects on the cognitive process of modern Western art today.
entries.本課程以服務實作與反思學習為核心，內容包括服務學習理念介紹、服務倫理與溝通技巧、: This course takes service implementation and reflective learning as the core, including the introduction of service learning concepts, service ethics and communication skills, service activity planning and implementation, teamwork, service record writing and achievement reflection. Students will participate in designated service activities according to the curriculum arrangement, which may include campus services, community services, public welfare activity support, disadvantaged care, environmental maintenance or other service projects related to public interests. During the course, students need to record their service experience regularly and review their learning, challenges and growth in the service process through discussion and reflection reports.
entries.本課程以梅洛龐蒂《眼與心》第二至五章為核心，引領學生從笛卡兒的工具理性視覺，轉向: This course takes the second to fifth chapters of Melloponti's Eyes and Heart as the core, leading students to shift from Descartes' instrumental rational vision to the ontology of existence revealed by modern art. The first half of the course focuses on the criticism of the Descartes visual concept, analyzing how it simplifies vision into a mechanical logic like "cane touch", which leads to the flattening of depth into geometric dimensions and causes the rupture of physical behavior and reflective thought. The second half discusses the recapture of the dimension of existence in modern painting. We will analyze how depth acts as an "explosion of existence", and how the line is detached from the outline of the object and incarnates into the "axis of creation". By studying the "self-shaping" of painting and the "sensory logic (Logos)" between color and form, students will understand that visual essence is the "splitting of existence", so that the subject can synchronize with the world in self-absence.
entries.本課程以法語發音訓練為核心，透過循序漸進的教學方式，培養學生正確的語音觀念與基礎: This course takes French pronunciation training as the core, and cultivates students' correct phonetic concepts and basic oral expression skills through gradual teaching methods. The course content covers important pronunciation rules such as French vowels, consonants and semi-mowels, and helps students establish good pronunciation habits through various phonetic discrimination and reading exercises.
entries.本課程以測度論為基礎，建立研究所層級機率論的嚴謹入門框架。主要教材為 Joel: Based on the theory of measurement, this course establishes a rigorous introductory framework for the hierarchical probability theory of the institute. The main textbook is Joel A. Tropp's CMS/ACM 117: Probability Theory & Computational Mathematics handout, which covers Part I (Measure Theory), Part II (Probability Foundations), and Part III's independent and large number rules, up to Chapter 15.
entries.本課程以漢譯佛典閱讀為核心，討論佛教經典中諸多思想的形成，如苦、緣起、無明、空性: This course takes the Chinese translation of Buddhist scriptures as the core, and discusses the formation of many ideas in Buddhist classics, such as suffering, fate, ignorance, emptiness, etc., how to form a special view of the world, and the possibility of relief. The course starts from the study of Ahan, gradually enters the chapters of Prajna, Zhongguan, Vimo, Langyan, Fahua, Huayan and Zen classics, and observes how Buddhist thought analyzes the world of experience step by step. The first half of the course focuses on suffering, obsession and selflessness; the middle part discusses name, Prajna and emptiness; the second half further deals with issues such as viewing, senses, language and understanding. The course attaches importance to the careful reading of the original text and text analysis, and discusses how Buddhism leads us to see the reality of the world in combination with Chinese thought and literary context.
entries.本課程以社會調查實務與問卷資料分析為核心，培養學生從社會現象觀察、研究問題形成、: With social survey practice and questionnaire data analysis as the core, this course cultivates students' complete ability from social phenomenon observation, research problem formation, questionnaire design, sampling and data collection, to statistical analysis and expression of research results. The course combines Hakka family groups, language, culture and local social issues to guide students to understand Hakka social phenomena with actual survey data.
entries.本課程以程式為主，應用的內容包含遊戲與機器人，搭配程式作業與期末計畫。期末計劃學: This course is mainly programs, and the content of the application includes games and robots, combined with code homework and final plans. At the end of the term, students need to design programs, and the applications can be games, robots or other applications. ( The end-of-term plan is up to a group of 2 people)
entries.本課程以系館公共空間之環境整理與清潔維護為主要服務內容，引導學生從日常校園生活中: This course takes the environmental arrangement and cleaning and maintenance of the public space of the department as the main service content, and guides students to recognize from daily campus life that the public environment is not the responsibility of a few people, but requires the joint participation and maintenance of all users. Through practical service, students will learn to observe the environmental needs of the department, plan the work content, carry out team division of labor, and cultivate responsibility discipline, communication and coordination, teamwork and problem-solving ability in the service process. In addition to paying attention to the actual completion of cleaning work, the course also hopes that students understand the importance of a good environment to the quality of teaching, research and daily life, and establish an attitude of respecting public space, cherishing common resources and actively participating in public affairs. Through continuous service and reflection, students can gradually transform from passively completing tasks into members of the department who can actively find problems, propose improvement methods and jointly maintain the environment.
entries.本課程以翻譯實作為核心，結合不同類型的文化文本，透過討論、合作學習與創作活動，培: This course takes translation practice as the core, combines different types of cultural texts, and cultivates students' Chinese-French translation ability and cross-cultural understanding through discussion, cooperative learning and creative activities.
entries.本課程以能源系統與儲能技術為核心，結合微電網、智慧電網、能源管理及IoT應用，透: This course takes energy system and energy storage technology as the core, combined with micro-grids, smart grids, energy management and IoT applications. Through the teaching of industry experts and the introduction of practical cases, it trains students to master the practical operation of energy engineering and future industry trends, and strengthens employment and research and development strength.
entries.本課程以臺灣史為經，電影史為緯，呈現戰後臺灣電影產業的發展歷程。臺灣電影的發展，: This course presents the development process of Taiwan's film industry after the war, taking the history of Taiwan and the history of film as the background. The development of Taiwanese cinema is closely related to political influence, social issues, economic growth, international situation and other factors. While presenting the main focus of contemporary care, it also left an obvious record for the Taiwanese society at that time.
entries.本課程以英語授課（EMI），帶領大二至大四學生認識資訊工程的核心領域，並動手實作: This course is taught in English (EMI), leading sophomores to seniors to understand the core areas of information engineering and practice the modern information engineering tool chain. Each course is divided into two parts:
entries.本課程以輕鬆淺顯的⽅式，帶領學⽣們認識西洋古典⾳樂中的鋼琴經典作品，透過了解鍵盤: This course leads students to understand the classical piano works in Western classical music in a relaxed and simple way. By understanding the evolution of keyboard instruments, the stories of composers, and the aesthetics and artistic views of different eras, students can understand the style characteristics and changes of piano music in different periods. Through listening to music, students can strengthen their aesthetic experience and humanistic literacy, and thus improve their enthusiasm for active learning and exploring new tracks.
entries.本課程以遙測科學之基本原理與應用為核心，內容包括電磁波與地表、大氣、海洋之交互作: This course takes the basic principles and applications of telemetry science as the core, including the interaction between electromagnetic waves and the surface, atmosphere and ocean, satellite observation systems, sensor characteristics, image data interpretation, and the introduction of active and passive telemetry methods. The course will cover different telemetry technologies such as optics, thermal infrared, microwave, radar, etc., and focus on their application in ocean, atmosphere, environmental monitoring and disaster observation.
entries.本課程企圖透過戲曲,展現社會文化的複雜與深度。傳統折子與新編戲曲,在時間軸上構成: This course attempts to show the complexity and depth of social culture through opera. Traditional origations and new operas constitute the two endpoints of the social and cultural spectrum on the timeline. Through the interactive examination of the two endpoints, we can see the dialogue between tradition and modernity, that is, all new operas have the roots of tradition; all traditions left in modern times are the result of the process of abandoning modern people.
entries.本課程使用《新版實用視聽華語一》此一教材。希望學生透過此課程培養基本的聽說能力，: This course uses the textbook "New Edition of Practical Audiovisual Chinese I". It is hoped that students can cultivate basic listening and speaking skills through this course, understand basic daily conversations, and communicate with Taiwanese in relatively natural Chinese. This course will also teach students the basic structure and strokes of Chinese characters, so that students can write basic Chinese characters. Finally, I also hope that students can learn more about Taiwan's culture through this course.
entries.本課程依循《Organizational Theory and Design》教: Following the structure of the textbook "Organizational Theory and Design", this course explores different strategic patterns and organizational alignment methods from the basic concepts of organizational design and structure, and further analyzes the impact of external environment, institutional factors and organizational culture on operation. The course also focuses on the life cycle of the organization, innovation and change, scientific and technological process design, as well as decision-making and power dynamics, helping students understand how organizations continue to evolve between external challenges and internal needs. Through such a process, students will be able to fully grasp the core ideas of organizational theory and learn how to apply them in real situations.
entries.本課程依衍生性商品之類別分兩大主題：期貨及選擇權，隨課程將循序漸進加以引導學生能: This course is divided into two major themes according to the categories of derivative goods: futures and options. The course will gradually guide students to systematically learn the essence of derivative goods.
entries.本課程係特別針對EMBA學生所設計，主要目的在於協助企業經理人瞭解企業面對的經濟: This course is specially designed for EMBA students. The main purpose is to assist enterprise managers to understand the economic environment faced by enterprises, and then use the knowledge and thinking of economics to plan various long-term and short-term strategies.
entries.本課程係由本系專任教師介紹各種當代的資訊管理課題。內容涵蓋電子商務管理與技術、企: This course is introduced by the full-time teachers of the department to introduce various contemporary information management topics. The content covers e-commerce management and technology, enterprise resource planning system and management, data warehousing and mining, flexible computing and business intelligence, network management and information security, software engineering, mobile commerce, network marketing and customer relationship management, etc.
entries.本課程假設同學具備 Python 程式設計、線性代數與機率統計的基礎，並曾修習過: This course assumes that students have the basics of Python programming, linear algebra and probability statistics, and have studied machine learning or deep learning-related courses. The basic content such as word bag model, n-gram language model, word vector, etc. is provided in pre-recorded videos and checked in the third week. All class time is used for content after 2020.
entries.本課程優先開放給天文所碩博生，其他系所學生請優先選修 “PH3045-天文觀測: This course is primarily open to master's and doctoral students of the Institute of Astronomy. Students of other departments are preferred to take "PH3045-Astronomical Observation I". This course is taught in English.
entries.本課程內容主要包含幾個領域：資料探勘、文字探勘、深度學習。本課程假設同學們都已熟: The content of this course mainly includes several areas: data mining, text mining, and deep learning. This course assumes that students are familiar with the basic theory of databases and information patterns. On this basis, we will make more in-depth introductions and discussions on how to use enterprise big data to create competitive niches for enterprises, and help students make great progress in both breadth and depth, and have the ability to carry out in-depth practical applications and academic research in this field.
entries.本課程內容包括研究實習、資料調查與蒐集、統計分析、研究模組建立、理論架構建構、資: The content of this course includes research practice, data investigation and collection, statistical analysis, research module establishment, theoretical framework construction, data collection and marking, interview record collation, and other learning activities related to research program implementation, academic research training and research assistant work.
entries.本課程內容包括碩士論文題目之研擬、研究方向之討論、研究問題之釐清、相關文獻蒐集與: The content of this course includes the research and formulation of master's thesis topics, discussion of research directions, clarification of research issues, collection and collation of relevant literature, research structure planning and preliminary data analysis. During the course, we will regularly discuss the progress of the thesis with students to assist them in revising the research content and arranging the follow-up writing process.
entries.本課程內容將介紹光學顯微鏡的原理及各種礦物的光學特性。藉由搭配系統性操作觀察與實: This course will introduce the principle of optical microscope and the optical properties of various minerals. Through systematic operation observation and practical introduction, students can understand the optical characteristics of various minerals and cultivate the ability to identify minerals. ( Bilingual teaching)
entries.本課程內容將分兩大主題：(一)電子商務系統規劃、分析與設計，(二)系統發展管理。: The content of this course will be divided into two major themes: (1) E-commerce system planning, analysis and design, and (2) System development management. The first topic will introduce UML (Universal Modeling Language) and let students use this tool for systematic planning. The second theme is to focus on the knowledge system of systematic development of project management to practice these management knowledge. The knowledge system of project management is specially designed for the ten knowledge systems of project management in theory (PMBOK) and the methodology currently adopted in practice, such as Agile development and eXtreme programming, to specifically bring out the technical and management methods of software projects in the process of brewing, planning, execution, monitoring and conclusion. This course also introduces the role and assistance of artificial intelligence (AI) in system development and management today. In addition to the teacher's video, the teaching content of the course also includes the case of enterprise counseling to seek practical integration with theory.
entries.本課程內容將包括勞資關系理論，並且進一步探討在勞資關係實作上，如何建立一個以信任: The content of this course will include the theory of labor-capital relations, and further explore how to establish a trust-based corporate culture in the practice of labor-capital relations. It includes labor consultation and communication, trade union and employee participation system, corporate social responsibility, labor dispute handling mechanism and system, labor and capital participation partnership, and the strategic choice of employee/labor relations of enterprises, etc.
entries.本課程內容採專題取向。本學期的專題為「現代城市的生活經驗」，歷史時段以十九世紀下: The content of this course is thematic orientation. The topic of this semester is "Life Experience in Modern Cities". The historical period focuses on the development of modern and contemporary French literature and social culture from the second half of the 19th century to the present.
entries.本課程內容旨在使同學認識並從各角度含理論欣賞、分析客家民間文學，包含神話、傳說、: The content of this course aims to enable students to understand and analyze Hakka folk literature from all angles, including myths, legends, historical biographies, stories, proverbs, ballads, jokes, riddles, legends, etc. In addition to understanding the culture, folk interest and aesthetics of Hakka folk literature, they also know how to apply Hakka folk literature to creation or teaching. This course conducts different discussions, homework exercises or group reports according to the characteristics of each lesson. The sub-questions of the content unit include: 1. Understanding of Hakka folk literature and field investigation; 2. Reading and analysis of Hakka folk literature texts; 3. The application of Hakka folk literature.
entries.本課程內容涵蓋該領域的相關實務、理論、研究方法和實證發現。此外，課程還將探討會計: The content of this course covers relevant practical, theoretical, research methods and empirical findings in this field. In addition, the course will also explore the role and impact of accounting information on accounting practice and capital market development.
entries.本課程內容理論與實務並重，每章節之首均舉代表性案例作為導引，以深入淺出的方式體系: The content of this course is both theoretical and practical. At the beginning of each chapter, representative cases are given as a guide, and the important concepts, principles, basic theories and various doctrinal disputes of the "General Provisions of Criminal Law" are systematically explained in an in-depth and shallow way, and the relevant practical judgments and precedents of Chinese courts are introduced as the object of theoretical verification and discussion.
entries.本課程內容適合已完成大一微積分、化學和物理課程的大學生修習。授課期間共計十六週。: The content of this course is suitable for college students who have completed the courses of calculus, chemistry and physics in their freshman years. The teaching period is 16 weeks in total. Course description: Introduction: Expected benefits from this course, determining the elements of material structure: chemical bonding and materials science, Chapter 1 Materials and bonding, factors affecting material characteristics: structure, defects, diffusion; Chapter 2 Crystal structure; Chapter 3 Crystal defects; Chapter 4 Solid thermal activation and diffusion; Chapter 5 Equilibrium phase diagram; Chapter 6 Determination mechanism of differential arrangement and plastic deformation material strength; Chapter 7 Phase change

The content of this course is suitable for college students who have completed the courses of calculus, chemistry and physics in their freshman years. The teaching period is 16 weeks in total. Course description: Introduction: The expected benefits from this course determine the elements of material structure: chemical bonding and material science, Chapter 1 Materials and bonding, factors affecting material characteristics: structure, defects, diffusion; Chapter 2 Crystal Structure; Chapter 3 Crystal Defects; Chapter 4 Solid Thermal Activation and Diffusion; Chapter 5 Equilibrium Phase Diagram; Chapter 6 Determination Mechanism of Differential and Plastic Deformation Material Strength; Chapter 7 Phase Change; Chapter 8 Heat Treatment
entries.本課程全面介紹地球表層主要的海洋過程，並探討其與整體地球系統之間的交互作用，特別: This course comprehensively introduces the main marine processes of the earth's surface and explores their interaction with the overall earth system, especially in the context of climate change and global environmental change.
entries.本課程全面介紹無人航空載具（UAV）於現代測量與地理空間資料收集中的應用。學生將: This course comprehensively introduces the application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in modern surveying and geospatial data collection. Students will learn the basic concepts, techniques and practical applications of drone measurement, including flight mission planning, data acquisition, photographic measurement and three-dimensional modeling. The course content combines theoretical lectures, practical exercises and outdoor field operations, so that students have the ability to safely operate drones, obtain high-quality aerial photography data and use commonly used software in the industry for data processing. The course also discusses legal, ethical and environmental issues related to the use of drones. You don't need to have experience in drone operation, but the basic knowledge of map making or geographic information system (GIS) will help you learn.
entries.本課程兼顧書法鑑賞與習作，期待修課者能在書法習作中，體會書寫的各種技巧及境界，並: This course takes into account both calligraphy appreciation and writing. It is expected that the students can experience various skills and realms of writing in calligraphy lessons, and have a certain understanding of the history of calligraphy, important stele posts, and the four treasures of the study, and have good appreciation ability. At the same time, it is also expected that the writer can use this to cultivate emotional character and learn the calmness, calmness and peace of mind.
entries.本課程分上、下兩學期，兩學期皆採理論與實作並重方式進行課程。: This course is divided into the first and second semesters, and both semesters take the same emphasis on theory and practice.
entries.本課程分上下兩學期，上學期主要是介紹構成生物分子的化學物質。主要是 胺基酸 蛋白: This course is divided into two semesters. The last semester mainly introduces the chemicals that make up biological molecules. It is mainly amino acids, proteins, glycosides and other properties. And such chemical molecules are involved in the composition of biological structure and enzymes. Therefore, the focus of last semester's study will also focus on protein structure and protein activity, which functions proteins participate in the body, and so on. The second half of last semester mainly talked about the metabolic process of the body. How can living things effectively convert the ingested glycosides into the energy ATP used by living things through the action of enzymes, which requires a series of chemical reactions to achieve!
entries.本課程分上下學期，前半將以先秦經典《四書》及《管子》文獻為核心進行分析討論各經典: This course is divided into the first and second semesters. The first half will take the pre-Qin classics "Four Books" and "Tube" as the core to analyze and discuss the hidden and quiet words in each classic, and connect the intrinsic link between each classic through the restoration of the thinking structure. The second half will take the words of the four sons of the Northern Song and Ming Dynasties and the words of Zhu Zi, Wang Yangming and Liu Zongzhou as the core to restore the genealogy of the Song and Ming Dynasties. So as to present the complete picture of the meditation work of Chinese philosophy.
entries.本課程分數的計算的依據⽅式有三，其⽐例分別是：: There are three ways to calculate the score of this course, and the proportions are:
entries.本課程分為兩個主要部分。: This course is divided into two main parts.
entries.本課程分為流派研究和個案研究兩部分。文學流派研究聚焦於中國左翼文學的七月派（19: This course is divided into two parts: genre research and case study. The study of literary schools focuses on the July School of Chinese left-wing literature (1940s-1950s), and the case study focuses on Xu Qianyu, the pioneer of the rise of Chinese modern and contemporary literature in the overseas Sinology, and his writings (1960s-1970s). Whether it is the literary and artistic ideas and creative exploration of the July School, or Xu Kaiyu's eclectic compilation and translation, it shows the colorfulness of left-wing literature, providing us with methods and visions and perspectives for re-exploring Chinese modern and contemporary literature-politics. This course hopes that while delving into the knowledge and ideas related to left-wing literature, we can also delve into different research paths, and students must cooperate with the course, complete the relevant assessment requirements, and actively participate in the discussion.
entries.本課程前半部將介紹公司理財的基本概念以及其運用，同時介紹財務新知Real Opt: The first half of this course will introduce the basic concepts of corporate financial management and their application. At the same time, we will introduce the application of Real Options and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in corporate financial management, and deepen the breadth and depth of learning with relevant case teaching.
entries.本課程包含三大主題：智慧機器人、先進載具、光機電設備。各主題將包含先進技術之介紹: This course includes three major topics: intelligent robots, advanced vehicles, and optical, mechanical and electrical equipment. Each topic will include an introduction to advanced technology and an overview of basic principles. In order to enable freshmen students of opto-electromechanical engineering to have a basic understanding of opto-electromechanical engineering technology and systems, and to provide students with future evaluation and reference in terms of courses, selected specialty fields and career planning.
entries.本課程包含以下主題:: This course includes the following topics:
entries.本課程包含以下主題：系統分析設計介紹、專案管理概論、需求擷取、系統的商務流程塑模: This course includes the following topics: introduction to system analysis design, introduction to project management, demand interception, system business process molding, system structure analysis, system behavior molding, system logic architecture design, system content design (categories and methods), data layer design, human-computer interaction design, entity architecture design, code programming, installation and online. In the first half of the course, students will learn to use UML to build system analysis design content, and use tests (midterm exam) to evaluate the professional knowledge students have learned. In the second half of the semester, students will use program language (Java) in a group way to cooperate in development and analyze the design content in practice.
entries.本課程包含兩部分:地形學的介紹與描繪工具(UAV)。第一部分介紹因地球外營力與內: This course consists of two parts: Introduction to Topography and Drawing Tools (UAV). The first part introduces the direct or indirect impact of landform evolution caused by the action of external forces and internal forces of the earth. By exploring the process and mechanism of landform evolution, students can have a general understanding of the evolution of seabed and surface landforms and their influencing factors (such as landform structure, erosion, weathering, climate). The second part shows the tools (UAV) used to depict the terrain and the information that requires students to use UAV to obtain the terrain. The purpose of the course is to hope that students can acquire relevant knowledge of topography and the methods and abilities of measuring and studying terrain.
entries.本課程包含原理介紹與資料實作。詳細講授內容包括衛星測高、重力測量、全球導航系統等: This course includes principle introduction and data practice. The detailed lecture content includes satellite elevation measurement, gravity measurement, global navigation system and other satellite architecture and measurement methods, and its observation data is applied to geophysics, sea level and gravity abnormal detection. Through practice and theory in parallel, it processes real-time data, statistical analysis, flat deviation calculation and links scientific applications.
entries.本課程協助同學認識社會、參與社會，以合作互惠的方式，建立與受訪團體的互動，尊重不: This course assists students to understand and participate in society, establish interaction with the interviewed groups in a cooperative and mutually beneficial way, respect different life experiences and diverse values, serve the interviewed groups by telling stories, curating exhibitions, etc., and promote the things that the interviewed groups care about.
entries.本課程協助學生建立統計推論的基礎: This course assists students to build the foundation of statistical inference.
entries.本課程協助對質性研究有興趣的研究生發展質性研究的基本理解，透過案例解析了解敘事研: This course assists graduate students who are interested in qualitative research in developing a basic understanding of qualitative research, understands the commonly used qualitative research methods such as narrative research, rooting theory, ethnography, case study, etc. through case analysis, and tries to write the third chapter of the research plan - research methods. The main learning unit activities begin with designated article reading, abstract writing (in the FB community), classroom discussion and research reflection, so that students can deepen the basic epistemology and methodology of qualitative research through this process.
entries.本課程可以了解各領域之專題研究諸多理論，並且有能力運用各理論來分析邏輯推理: This course can understand many theories of special research in various fields, and have the ability to apply various theories to analyze logical reasoning.
entries.本課程可以了解各領域之專題研究諸多理論，並且有能力運用各理論來分析邏輯推理。: In this course, you can understand many theories of special research in various fields, and have the ability to use various theories to analyze logical reasoning.
entries.本課程同時設計用來提供並強化學生掌握現代分析與商業決策所需的最新技術。其目標是縮: This course is also designed to provide and enhance students with the latest technologies needed to master modern analysis and business decision-making. The goal is to shorten the gap between students' knowledge in business, finance and economics and real world and market data. After the review of statistical concepts in the previous few weeks, the course will cover optimization, sampling, regression design, qualitative response model, time series, and some newly developed method tools, and focus on their methodological value and practical application through business case studies. Each model, technology or method will be matched with at least one formal data analysis application.
entries.本課程回顧大氣環流的觀測特徵，並闡述其成因和維持的基本機制。課程分為兩部分。第一: This course reviews the observed characteristics of atmospheric circulation and explains its causes and basic maintenance mechanisms. The course is divided into two parts. The first part is a lecture, including the time-average characteristics of atmospheric circulation and the conservation laws of angular momentum, mass, kinetic energy, water vapor and total energy. The second part requires each student to conduct 1 to 2 critical reviews based on the research literature and report to all class participants.
entries.本課程因應人工智慧（AI）技術快速演進與跨領域學生之學習需求，採行以下彈性教學與: In response to the rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) technology and the learning needs of cross-field students, this course adopts the following flexible teaching and diversified learning strategies:

This course also assists students in understanding basic accounting theory and related accounting research topics.
entries.本課程在於讓學生具有公共行政研究的「認知地圖」，瞭解行政與政策學者主要論著及其間: This course is to let students have a "cognitive map" of public administration research and understand the main thesis of administrative and policy scholars and the relationship between them. In the process of learning, gradually develop your critical ability and form your own views.

entries.本課程將介紹 Bayesian causal inference 的基本架構，從: This course will introduce the basic structure of Bayesian causal inference. Starting from the potential result model, causal effect definition and identifiable conditions, Bayesian inference will explain how to deal with complex situations such as counterfactual results, tendency scores, sensitivity analysis, and disposal of tool variables and time changes. At the same time, it will extend to Bayesian nonparametric causal inference, introduce modern methods such as Gaussian process, BART and high-dimensional adjustment, and discuss its theoretical role in neuroscience as explaining perception integration and causal judgment in neuroscience. Through theoretical introduction and literature introduction, it helps students master the core concepts, method development and interdisciplinary application of Bayesian causal inference.
entries.本課程將介紹傳統照明與前瞻光源相關知識，並讓同學們習得光源與系統分析的技巧。Th: This course will introduce the knowledge related to traditional lighting and forward-looking light sources, and let students learn the skills of light sources and system analysis. This course introduces fundamental knowledge of conventional lighting and advanced light sources, while providing students with the skills for analyzing light sources and lighting systems.
entries.本課程將介紹分析我國保險法規的要點、重要實務案例、以及國外的狀況，以研討方式進行: This course will introduce and analyze the key points of China's insurance regulations, important practical cases, and foreign situations. It will be conducted in a discussion way, so as to make students' understanding of insurance law more comprehensive and international.
entries.本課程將介紹可穿戴健康監測技術的最新進展，解釋其得以提高醫學診斷準確性和可靠性的: This course will introduce the latest progress of wearable health monitoring technology and explain the basic principles for improving the accuracy and reliability of medical diagnosis. At the same time, it will explain how these technologies combined with personalized electronic devices can help achieve closed-loop personalized medical management, so that patients can pay attention to their own health and the impact of real lifestyles and patterns on health through effective feedback.

The purpose is to learn how to: (1) model: establish a trial table model for decision-making problems and its corresponding algebraic model; (2) solve: use the optimization tool software - plan to find out the answer to the problem; (3) interpretation and analysis: interpret the result report and sensitivity report and perform the case analysis; (4) suggestion and implementation: suggest feasible solutions and assist in the implementation of decision-making. We will use Microsoft's Excel to demonstrate the management decision-making model in this course. The important topics of the case study include fixed costs, supply chain management, and portfolio optimization.
entries.本課程將介紹構成現代數學的基本概念，並協助學生熟悉數學證明的操作。: This course will introduce the basic concepts that make up modern mathematics and help students familiarize themselves with the operation of mathematical proof.

entries.本課程將介紹目前在生醫研究及臨床應用上最重要的影像技術，包括投影式造影、X光電腦: This course will introduce the most important imaging technologies in biomedical research and clinical applications at present, including projection contrast, X-ray computed tomography, nuclear medical imaging, ultrasound, magnetic resonance imaging, and optical imaging. For each imaging technology, the basic principles of imaging, instrument design, image characteristics and analysis, basic research and clinical application, application limitations, and the latest research results will be introduced.
entries.本課程將介紹行為科學理論、方法和工具，並提供使用和應用它們解決工作和職業生涯中遇: This course will introduce the theories, methods and tools of behavioral science, and provide the use and application of them to solve problems encountered in work and career. Behavioral methods include general knowledge about human behavior and behavior in the working environment, providing a set of systematic techniques and research methods to understand human behavior. The scope of this course will cover the analytical skills needed for communication, teamwork, negotiation, conflict resolution, leadership and organization to play an effective role in a modern workplace. The goal of the course is to lead students to: (a) learn some management psychology, (b) learn more, and (c) understand the process of behavior research.
entries.本課程將介紹資訊經濟的意涵與課題，並且討論如何應用經濟分析方法來研究網路技術、電: This course will introduce the implications and topics of information economy, and discuss how to apply economic analysis methods to study the development of various emerging business models under network technology, e-commerce, and the Internet of Things. The course content will introduce game theory, Agent-based model, and Reinforcement learning method, and link the course content by reading Wall Street Journal cases.
