entries.本課程將介紹雷達設計的權衡取捨、天線、發射機與相干接收機。課程核心包含將雷達訊號: This course will introduce the trade-offs, antennas, transmitters and coherent receivers in radar design. The core of the course includes the analysis of radar signals as stochastic processes interfered by noise, and focuses on the digital signal processing technology of Doppler spectrum and Moment estimation.
entries.本課程將以 Green City Blues（GCB）論證桌遊為評量的核心，讓你: This course will take Green City Blues (GCB) demonstration board games as the core of the evaluation, allowing you to design a lesson plan at the beginning and end of the course, that is, "2 tests". The initial lesson plan design shows your current teaching ability, and the final lesson plan design shows your growth and learning achievements after course training. This will be a challenging and rewarding learning journey!
entries.本課程將以個案深入探討此規劃問題，分享專業的財務顧問處理個案成功的經驗，期許學生: This course will explore this planning issue in depth by case-by-case, share the successful experience of professional financial consultants in handling cases, and promise that students will be able to analyze the financial situation of customers (income, assets, liabilities), provide tailor-made investment allocation, retirement planning, tax planning, risk management and inheritance inheritance and other "consultancy" services to assist customers in achieving financial goals at all stages of life.
entries.本課程將以太史公所自承，以子書的角度來進行解讀，從他所說本書的重點：「察古今之變: This course will be interpreted from the perspective of the book from the perspective of the book. From the point of what he said, the key point of the book: "Inspecting the changes of ancient and modern times, and investigating the time of heaven and man", it will trace the ideas, insights and concepts contained in the book, so that we can be expected to get its essence.
entries.本課程將使用教科書、管理文獻、實務個案等教材授課，並配合學生報告、課堂研討及實作: This course will be taught using textbooks, management literature, practical cases and other teaching materials, and will be carried out in cooperation with student reports, classroom discussions and practical exercises. The teaching content includes the introduction to homework/supply chain management, supply network design, and the planning, coordination, operation and control of related homework activities. At the same time, it also discusses the strategic implications of enterprise operation, so as to achieve the following course goals: (1) Students will understand the relevant activities of the supply chain, including the operational, tactical and strategic aspects of operation and management. (2) Students will use basic information, software or analysis tools (analytic tools) to solve problems related to homework/supply chain management. (3) Students will have a forward-looking and global perspective to deal with issues such as corporate social responsibility (CSR) and sustainable management derived from the supply chain.
entries.本課程將分析國際貿易的成因與後果。我們將探討各國進行貿易的原因、貿易產業特性，以: This course will analyze the causes and consequences of international trade. We will explore the reasons why countries trade, the characteristics of the trade industry, and who can benefit from trade. Then, we will analyze the policies and motives of the state to control international trade, and study the impact of international trade and trade policies on economic welfare. This course will focus on the empirical research at the individual level of enterprises.
entries.本課程將取徑「流派」視野，通過研讀具代表性之詩人作品，引領同學深入1920-19: This course will take the "school" vision and lead students to delve into modern Chinese poetry in the 1920s and 1940s by studying the works of representative poets. Through the reading of poetry texts, on the one hand, the research views of important poets are introduced, and on the other hand, the development of poetry theory and related cultural issues are explored, combined with "history" and "theory", in order to gradually explore the cultural context of poetry production and the repeated vein of the artistic center of gravity while grasping the outline of the history of new Chinese poetry during this period. Specifically, it will introduce the genre characteristics and poetry ideas of the New Moon School, July School and other groups, and elaborate on the stylistic revolution of important poems and the social connotations. It will not only pay attention to the characteristics of the general school, but also focus on the unique poetic performance and creative personality of individual poets, and deepen the understanding of modern poetry through the mutual reference of different schools and individual poets' poems.
entries.本課程將帶領學生了解軟體資訊系統在開發之前的規劃、分析、設計與實作，已及開發過程: This course will lead students to understand the planning, analysis, design and practice of software information systems before development, and the project management in the development process. This course also focuses on the analysis and design of the UML letter system. After finishing this course, students will have a complete system development concept and the ability to correspond the analysis design content to the actual code content.
entries.本課程將幫助學生學習到架構大綱、開展寫作、自我評估和反思自身寫作的技巧。學期結束: This course will help students learn the skills of architecture outline, writing, self-assessment and reflection on their own writing. At the end of the semester, students should be able to better modify their research papers according to the writing structure and academic writing skills introduced in this course, and improve the publication level of the paper.
entries.本課程將延續本系所開設之「流體力學」（課號ME3081A/B/C），進一步針對經: This course will continue the "Fluid Mechanics" (course number ME3081A/B/C) offered by this department, and further discuss the classic fluid mechanics issues in depth. The course content includes topics such as in-tubular flow, flat boundary layer development, external flow field characteristics and basic compressible flow, to help students master the basic principles and analysis methods of fluid behavior, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent advanced courses such as turbulent flow theory, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or related research and application.
entries.本課程將延續經濟學中關於消費者與廠商決策的分析架構與模型，並進一步探討在不確定性: This course will continue the analytical structure and model of consumer and manufacturer decision-making in economics, and further explore the impact of consumer behavior in uncertain and irrational situations, as well as the impact of various market competition patterns on manufacturer behavior. It also covers issues related to the role of the government in the market and social welfare. The main goal of the course is to guide students to understand how to use simple mathematical models to analyze individual economic behavior, including economic decision-making, including individuals, manufacturers and the government, and to understand the economic implications from it, and then to deeply understand economic phenomena and problems in the real world.
entries.本課程將引導學生認識“地方“的途徑，講解有關地方的知識，地方與權力的關連，並從生: This course will guide students to understand the way of "local", explain the knowledge about locality, the relationship between locality and power, and think about how people and locality have emotional connections from the experience of life, how to identify, remember and imagine localities, and how to exclude certain elements from entering "our" places, and think about whether "local characteristics" have disappeared due to globalization. This course will lead students to start from exploring places, find the meaning of self-experience and the framework of knowledge care, and then transform them into social learning and action forces. In addition to explaining issues and case sharing related to local knowledge, and supplemented by recording video viewing and lecture comments, we can further explain the basic concepts and cultivate students' independent thinking and critical care ability.
entries.本課程將從「自由民主憲政秩序」角度解析憲法本質及架構；將特別針對基本權利之保障與: This course will analyze the essence and structure of the Constitution from the perspective of "free, democratic and constitutional order". It will focus on the protection of fundamental rights and the independence of the trial, deepen the theory, and supplemented by the interpretation of the justice of the Supreme Court and the constitutional ruling, and build students' fundamental awareness of "constitutional enforcement" and "constitutional protection" to consolidate democracy and the rule of law.
entries.本課程將從不同時期、不同國籍的音樂家思想與背景出發，進而了解各自音樂創作理念的發: This course will start from the thoughts and backgrounds of musicians of different periods and nationalities, and then understand the development direction of their respective musical creation concepts and the evolution of musical aesthetic concepts.
entries.本課程將從不同角度培養學生對永續領導力的理解與應用能力。本課程融合人力資源管理、: This course will cultivate students' understanding and application ability of sustainable leadership from different perspectives. This course integrates the views of human resources management, strategic management, social enterprise, corporate ethics and supply chain management. The specific learning objectives are as follows:
entries.本課程將從古典密碼學開始介紹，接著介紹現代密碼學，內容涵蓋常見的加解密技術與數位: This course will start with classical cryptography, followed by modern cryptography, covering common encryption techniques and digital signature mechanisms. In addition, considering the potential threats posed by the development of quantum computing to existing cryptographic technologies, this course will also cover post-quantum cryptography and explain new technologies that can resist quantum attacks.
entries.本課程將從外部業師角度以全方位的探討企業溫室氣體排放與碳足跡的來源，並從企業角度: This course will discuss the source of greenhouse gas emissions and carbon footprint of enterprises in an all-round way from the perspective of external practitioners, and how to reduce carbon from the perspective of enterprises from the perspective of scientific implementation, internal carbon pricing, green power procurement and supply chain carbon reduction. In addition, from the perspective of the carbon emission of raw materials in the product life cycle, how to apply the material selection strategy method developed by Michael F. Ashby, an honorary professor of the Engineering Design Center of Cambridge University, start from the economic and low-carbon material selection strategy, more deeply explore the material selection of enterprises, and then select suitable materials according to the conditions of material use.
entries.本課程將從日常生活接觸到的產品以及材料來介紹各類物質對於人類的便利性及生活習慣所: This course will introduce the improvements (changes) caused by various substances to the convenience and living habits of human beings from the products and materials encountered in daily life. At the same time, the introduction will introduce the basic concepts and important principles of materials science, including the structure, properties, classification, and application of materials, as well as important milestones in the development of materials.
entries.本課程將循序漸進地探討DELF B1考試的主題與核心能力，協助學習者掌握有效的學: This course will gradually explore the themes and core competencies of the DELF B1 exam, help learners master effective learning and organizational methods, and provide comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading and writing. The course will also provide diversified resources and strategies to help learners cultivate the ability of independent learning. Through the mock test, learners will be familiar with the test format and scoring criteria, and improve their confidence in taking the test.

entries.本課程將採取「共同研讀、集體注釋」方式進行，由課程參與者共同逐條研讀《四庫全書總: This course will be conducted in the form of "joint study and collective annotation", and the participants of the course will study the summary of the four books of the "General Book of the Four Librarys" article by article.
entries.本課程將探索關於日常生活中有關的活動，包括工作與休閒，電視，爵士樂，賭博與蒐集。: This course will explore activities related to daily life, including work and leisure, television, jazz, gambling and gathering. Although Krakaul, Adorno and Banyamin were concerned with emerging cultural activities after the 1920s at that time, their research methods and theories are still applicable today.
entries.本課程將探討在供應鏈架構下之營運、工業4.0、智慧製造等先進技術相關管理議題，使: This course will discuss management topics related to advanced technologies such as operation, industry 4.0, and intelligent manufacturing under the supply chain structure. The teaching materials will include a variety of teaching materials such as management literature, practical cases, videos, etc., and cooperate with student reports, classroom discussions, experience writing and practical exercises. The teaching content includes related issues of operation/intelligent manufacturing/supply chain and sustainable management and the planning, coordination, operation and control of production activities. At the same time, it also discusses the strategic implications of enterprise operation to achieve the following course objectives: (1) Students will understand the relevant activities of operation/intelligent manufacturing/supply chain/perpetual and social responsibility, including operational, tactical and strategic management implications. (2) Students will use basic information, software, AI or analytical tools (analytic tools) to solve intelligent manufacturing, SCM and persistence-related operation problems. (3) Students will deal with contemporary management topics such as corporate social responsibility
entries.本課程將提供學習者對勞資關係與勞資協商之基本認識，瞭解影響勞資關係中之主要因素，: This course will provide learners with a basic understanding of labor relations and labor-management negotiation, understand the main factors affecting labor relations, as well as the role-playing of employers or managers, employees and trade unions, and understand the concepts of employee relations/labor relations and collective bargaining and the management of group agreements. And learn how to deal with employee complaints, face labor disputes, and be familiar with the system and process of handling labor disputes. In addition to collective bargaining, the tools to balance labor relations can also include mechanisms such as labor participation and social dialogue, as well as strategic human resources management measures in the enterprise. From the perspective of human resources management, contemporary labor-management relationship has involved a more strategic level of corporate governance issues. On the one hand, it is the requirement of corporate social responsibility of the supply chain system, and on the other hand, it is the recognition of the goal of corporate governance (ESG) for sustainable development of capital market operation. Especially after the global outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, the link attribute between employees and enterprises has been strongly tested. Enterprises are beginning to recognize the needs of employees for work-life balance, so how to establish a balanced employee/labor-management relationship has become a major challenge in today's management.
entries.本課程將提供非線性最佳化理論和相關演算法的基礎，它將展示來自不同應用科學領域的各: This course will provide the basis of nonlinear optimization theory and related algorithms, and it will show various applications from different fields of applied science. This course combines the three pillars of optimization: theory and algorithm foundation, familiarity with various applications, and the ability to apply theory and algorithm to solve practical problems.
