entries.本課程將涵蓋以下主題:: This course will cover the following topics:
entries.本課程將涵蓋組織理論中的一系列關鍵理論觀點，包含以下主題：什麼是組織理論、企業行: This course will cover a series of key theoretical views in organizational theory, including the following topics: what is organizational theory, enterprise behavior theory, resource-based views, learning and knowledge-based views, time-based views, corporate governance, agency theory, high-level theory, organizational change, competitive dynamics, etc.
entries.本課程將聚焦20世紀下半葉的視覺藝術發展與文化思潮，以 1960年代藝術實驗及跨: This course will focus on the development of visual art and cultural thought in the second half of the 20th century. Starting from the critical moment of art experiments and cross-field thinking in the 1960s, it will lead students to gradually explore important concepts such as low-limitism, conceptual art, specific field art, behavioral performance and mechanism criticism, and expand the research topics of video art, postmodernism, and contemporary visual culture in the 1980s and 1990s, so that students can further have a basic understanding of the development of modern and contemporary art, as well as the context of related issues.
entries.本課程將著重電離層資料同化最主要的三個基礎知識，電離層模式、衛星觀測資料、以及資: This course will focus on the three main basic knowledge of ionosphere data assimilation, ionosphere mode, satellite observation data, and data assimilation methods. The course will first introduce the basic knowledge of relevant satellite data and data processing methods, and introduce the relevant ionosphere mode and operation mode, then introduce various data assimilation methods, and finally introduce how to use assimilation methods to assimilate satellite data into the ionosphere mode. In addition to oral teaching content, this course also includes computer programs to practice operating the ionosphere mode, processing satellite observation data, and learning the use of assimilation methods. Group research will be carried out in the middle of the semester, and group reports will be carried out at the end of the semester.
entries.本課程將討論主題包含：(i) 向量分析；(ii) 常微分方程；(iii) 偏微分: This course will discuss topics including: (i) vector analysis; (ii) ordinary differential equations; (iii) partial differential equations; (iv) variation method and so on.
entries.本課程將討論科學計算與資料科學中衍生的兩大課題：大型線性方程組求解與特徵值問題。: This course will discuss two major topics derived from scientific computing and data science: the solution of large linear equations and the problem of eigenvalues. The basic course will include: the definition of conditional numbers, the concept of stability, error estimation with vector and matrix modules, the introduction of the problem of inverse and reverse error analysis by solving the system of linear equations, the direct and iterative eigenvalue algorithm, the least level method, etc. In this course, students need to write programs to conduct numerical experiments to test the theoretical analysis of various numerical methods and discuss their advantages and disadvantages. For each topic, we will also conduct group practical case study and analysis. Suggested progress: 1. Solving linear systems by iterative method: introduction to the norm of matrices and vectors, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, Jacobian iteration method, Gausss. Seidel iteration method, SOR, conjugation gradient method. Two. Approximation theory: least level method and orthogonal polynomials. 3. Approximation of eigenvalues: power method, singular value decomposition. 4. Solve linear systems by direct method: LU decomposition and Cholesky decomposition.
entries.本課程將評估外人直接投資（foreign direct investment,: This course will evaluate the role of foreign direct investment (FDI) in the global economy and explore the political, economic, cultural and legal aspects of inflow and outflow FDI. Topics covering include FDI and international enterprise theory, the causes and impact of FDI, and the model strategy of entering the international market.
entries.本課程將講授與研討德意志哲學：其一為文化脈絡，尤其是其哲學生成發展史，其二為義理: This course will teach and discuss German philosophy: the first is the cultural context, especially the history of its philosophical generation and development, the second is the righteous context, especially from its problem awareness to the construction of its philosophical system, and the third is the original vein, especially the reading and interpretation of classic texts. In terms of these three points, this course will study the following topics: first, German eczy theory, especially Meister Eckhart and Cusanus; second, modern German philosophy, especially Leibniz and Kant; third, German conceptual theory, especially Hegel; fourth, post-Hegelian philosophy, especially its Kykgo and Nitsce, and contemporary philosophy, especially Heidegger, the United States and Habermas. In addition to introducing the ideas and even systems of these philosophers, this course will also select the most basic or classic texts, so that students can enter the temple of German philosophy and delve into the German spiritual movement.
entries.本課程將透過上述主題培養學生的抽象思考能力，並奠定後續修習高等數學課程所需的基礎: This course will cultivate students' abstract thinking ability through the above topics, and lay the foundation needed for the subsequent study of higher mathematics courses.
entries.本課程將透過閱讀作品，教師示範寫作方法，實際帶領同學練習寫作實務，包括：履歷表、: This course will be through reading works, teachers will demonstrate writing methods, and actually lead students to practice writing practice, including: resumes, project books, abstracts and keywords, book reviews, etc., and read and analyze the writing skills of contemporary literary works.
entries.本課程將通過閱讀、報告和討論相關主題的過去和當前學術論文和新聞，向學生介紹心理學: This course will introduce the application of psychology in human resources management to students by reading, reporting and discussing past and current academic papers and news on relevant topics.
entries.本課程將邀請不同領域的專家學者進行專題演講，讓學生了解各學術領域及目前物理研究的: This course will invite experts and scholars in different fields to give special speeches, so that students can understand various academic fields and the cutting-edge development of current physics research.
entries.本課程將針對領域理論探索方法來理解如何提升績效(以學習領域為學習績效)。此目標為: This course will explore the field theory to understand how to improve performance (tas the learning field as the learning performance). This goal is to enable students to understand process analysis, intervention selection, domain and performance-related attribute analysis, intervention and information technology introduction, attribute and performance monitoring, numerical evidence of causal relationship of performance improvement, experimental design, human research and design methods, result reports, and thesis writing.
entries.本課程將閱讀一系列影響英國早期文學正典形成的重要文本，並將其置於大英帝國初期興起: This course will read a series of important texts that influenced the formation of the early British literary canonicals, and discuss them in the historical context of the early rise of the British Empire. We will cover many important literary genres from the 14th to the 17th centuries - including frame narratives, romance, satirical fables, drama, sonnets and metaphysical poetry - and read the representative works of classic writers from Chaucer to Shakespeare. By reading these texts, students can not only understand the changing appearance of "Britishness" more comprehensively and diversely, but also learn how to read texts critically and their historical context. This course is taught in English throughout the whole process.
entries.本課程將需要你具備統計學和程式設計的必要知識。可以先閱讀此網頁：https://: This course will require you to have the necessary knowledge of statistics and programming. You can read this web page first: https://scikit-learn.org/1.4/tutorial/statistical_inference/supervised_learning.html. If English is the main obstacle, you can use Google Translate or similar browser plug-ins. If you can understand most of the content and steps in a reasonable reading time, then this course should be quite suitable for you!
entries.本課程專為人力資源管理研究所的學生設計，旨在提供理解和應用研究方法的基本知識與技: This course is specially designed for students of the Institute of Human Resources Management, aiming to provide basic knowledge and skills to understand and apply research methods. Through this course, students will learn how to design, implement and evaluate scientific research, and be able to effectively analyze data and interpret research results. This course emphasizes the combination of theory and practice to help students build a rigorous foundation for academic research, especially in the fields of management and human resources, and be familiar with SPSS, JASP and Mplus statistical software.
entries.本課程專為博士班學生規劃，旨在協助博士班學生就學期間建立教學基礎，培養有效的知識: This course is specially designed for doctoral students. It aims to assist doctoral students to establish a teaching foundation during their studies and cultivate effective knowledge communication ability and professional ethics. The curriculum design combines practice and theory. In addition to arranging doctoral students to serve as course assistants and accumulate practical teaching experience, it also covers topics such as teaching methods, problem design, positive psychology, critical thinking, and curriculum adjustment under the influence of AI through teaching energy-enhancing workshops. In addition, bilingual teaching training (EMI) is specially incorporated to improve its flexibility and adaptability in a multicultural environment. The overall plan not only enables doctoral students to grasp the teaching goals, strategies and evaluation methods from a macro perspective, but also to put what they have learned into practice in the classroom, cultivate a good attitude and ability in advance, and lay a solid foundation for their future educational career.
entries.本課程專為大二學生設計，選讀法國經典 « Que sais-je ? » 百科系: This course is specially designed for sophomores. Choose to read the French classic « Que sais-je? » Encyclopedia series. We will outline an interdisciplinary knowledge map in the classroom, from rich topics covering symbol research, imagination, social mediation, shy psychology to fashion aesthetics, etc., according to the students' interests to decide the fields to explore.
entries.本課程專為研究生設計，旨在介紹學習科學領域。在課程中，將選擇學習科學中的重要理論: This course is specially designed for graduate students and aims to introduce the field of learning science. In the course, the important theoretical foundations and empirical research in learning science will be selected as the topics of classroom discussion. Students who choose this course will be asked to complete a comment on a topic in learning science. In addition, students also need to complete a research plan at the end of the semester.
entries.本課程專為資訊管理背景的研究生設計，旨在幫助他們獲得行銷管理的專業知識和實踐經驗: This course is specially designed for graduate students with information management backgrounds. It aims to help them gain professional knowledge and practical experience in marketing management, and combine information management expertise to improve their comprehensive ability. Students will understand the basic concepts, theories and strategies of marketing through in-depth study of marketing theory and practice, and apply them flexibly to actual business situations. The course will emphasize learning the integration and application of modern digital marketing tools and information management core technologies to improve competitiveness in the modern marketing environment. Through case studies and practical activities, students' innovative ability and critical thinking are cultivated, so that they can come up with innovative solutions in the face of challenges.
entries.本課程專為需要對AI做出重大決策的高階主管與企業領導者設計。在12週的學習中，您: This course is specially designed for senior leaders and enterprise leaders who need to make major decisions about AI. In the 12-week study, you will cultivate the judgment of evaluating AI technology, the analytical ability to challenge the statements of manufacturers, and the practical experience of learning to judge the effectiveness of AI introduction.
entries.本課程對於研究涉及以下方面的學生尤其重要：: This course is especially important for students whose research involves the following aspects:
entries.本課程屬於進階與跨域專業課程，課程內容以「學習科學」基礎理論及「學習科技設計」為: This course is an advanced and cross-domain professional course. The content of the course is based on the basic theory of "learning science" and "learning science and technology design", and is further applied in the field of science education. Therefore, this course will involve three majors, including: "learning science", "learning science and technology design" and "learning theory and research related to science education". This course includes two parts: theory and practice. The theoretical part will first explore important learning scientific theories such as cognitive master-apprentice system, knowledge renovation theory, and eagle frame theory, and further read the application of these important theories in science education. In addition, this course will also deconstruct the current application of learning technology in science education from the important theoretical foundations of learning technology such as the essence of tools, the theory of distributed cognition and Learner-Centered Design (LCD). Finally, this course will design a learning technology applied to science education with generative AI as the core in groups based on the above theories.
entries.本課程希望培養的學生能力有：: The student abilities that this course hopes to cultivate are:
entries.本課程希望幫助學生更自在、更有自信地使用英語與他人溝通，並培養英語口語表達與簡報: This course hopes to help students communicate with others in English more freely and confidently, and cultivate English oral expression and presentation skills. In the course, students will learn how to express their ideas clearly, communicate and cooperate with others, and conduct individual and group presentations in English through various interesting and interactive activities, such as group discussions, oral exercises, theme sharing and briefing activities.
entries.本課程希望讓學生對明清傳奇與崑劇有整體認識，因此，本課程重視「閱讀理解」與「表演: This course hopes that students can have an overall understanding of the legends of the Ming and Qing Dynasties and Kun operas. Therefore, this course attaches importance to "reading comprehension" and "performance interpretation", and hopes that students can understand the close relationship between classical opera scripts and performance. This course focuses on pre-class reading and video appreciation, and in accordance with the progress of the class, it is appreciated and discussed from the "overall play" and "important subject". The discussion content includes: the background of the creation of the legendary script, the structure of the drama, and the appreciation of the existing orizi opera performance. The narrative of the legendary script focuses on the focus from the "full" to the "fold"; the appreciation of the folding play is based on the principle of two to three folds of each work. In the process of appreciation, the performance focus is put forward at any time, and the interpretations of at least two or three groups of different performers are compared.
entries.本課程幫助學生了解能源使用、科技發展與環境永續之間的關係。課程提供有關不同能源來: This course helps students understand the relationship between energy use, scientific and technological development and environmental persistence. The course provides important knowledge about different energy sources, including fossil fuels, nuclear energy and renewable energy, and explores their environmental impact on air, water resources, climate and ecosystems. Through this course, students can understand the current global energy challenges from a scientific perspective, such as climate change, pollution and resource depletion. The course also encourages students to think critically about energy conservation, sustainable development and future energy policies. In addition, this course helps students realize the importance of achieving a balance between economic growth and environmental protection. By learning these concepts, students can better understand their responsibilities as global citizens and future professionals, and have the ability to contribute to cleaner, safer and more sustainable energy solutions for social development.
entries.本課程延續力學與電磁學對波動現象的探討，提供各種波動現象的統一物理圖像與數學框架: This course continues the discussion of fluctuation phenomena in mechanics and electromagnetism, and provides a unified physical image and mathematical framework for various fluctuation phenomena.
entries.本課程強調「學以致用」。從游泳技術的個人化前/後測，到期末的水上構造物設計競賽，: This course emphasizes "learning to use". From the personalized pre/post-test of swimming skills to the final water structure design competition, students must go through the complete process from data collection, theoretical analysis to the presentation of the final work. This not only trains students' logical analysis ability, but also cultivates their competitiveness in solving practical engineering problems and teamwork.
entries.本課程強調具體計算、引導證明與構造方法。修課學生將學習辨認定理的適用條件、推導基: This course emphasizes specific calculations, guided proofs and construction methods. Students will learn to identify the applicable conditions of the theory, derive the basic operators' identity, and regard the quantum state, measurement and channel as mathematical objects that can be accurately analyzed, so as to establish the foundation for the subsequent reading of quantum information, quantum channel and open quantum system-related literature.
entries.本課程後續將銜接「跨領域社會參與學分學程」之社會議題專案，專案小組成果網頁 (本: This course will follow up with the social issue project of "cross-field social participation credits". The project team's results web page (continuing results of this course) are as follows
entries.本課程從世界茶文化開始說明，後往臺灣茶樹栽培與製茶技術講述，將搭配勞動部丙級製茶: This course starts from the world's tea culture, and then talks about Taiwan's tea tree cultivation and tea-making technology. It will be taught in combination with the C-level tea-making technician certificate standard of the Ministry of Labor, and train students to have the basic concept of tea-making technician and the ability to take the certificate.
entries.本課程從台灣電影史為起點，分別針對「台灣」、「電影」、「歷史」三個關鍵詞進行核心: Starting from the history of Taiwanese cinema, this course asks core questions about the three keywords of "Taiwan", "film" and "history" respectively:
entries.本課程從數學觀點介紹量子資訊理論的基本結構，以有限維複內積空間為主要討論場域。課: This course introduces the basic structure of quantum information theory from a mathematical point of view, with finite-dimensional complex index space as the main discussion field. In the first half of the course, we will establish common languages for quantum states, density operators, composite systems, entanglement, purification and measurement, and cooperate with linear algebra tools such as accompanying operators, square roots of positive operators, Hilbert-Schmidt inner product, singular value decomposition, equidistant mapping and pole decomposition, to understand the mathematical basis of relevant concepts and theorems.
entries.本課程從日文的發音開始學習，假名．單字．句子．會話，循序漸進，並適時的加入土木工: This course starts from the pronunciation of Japanese, kana. Single word. Sentence. Conversation, step by step, and add the relevant words and performance of civil engineering in a timely manner, so that students can achieve the goal of simple communication in Japanese.
entries.本課程從飲食文化出發，討論食材與料理、人與人的關係、文化等環繞在食物周遭的議題。: Starting from the food culture, this course discusses the topics surrounding food, such as ingredients and dishes, people-to-people relationships, and culture.
entries.本課程所需的先備知識為線性代數，歡迎已修習線性代數的同學選修。: The prerequisiary knowledge required for this course is linear algebra. Students who have studied linear algebra are welcome to take it.
entries.本課程承接電路學I之理論基礎，接續探討包含電感與電容元件之RLC二階時域電路分析: This course undertakes the theoretical basis of circuit science I, and continues to discuss the analysis of RLC second-order time domain circuits including inductance and capacitance components. Then it introduces the second unit to discuss the analysis of AC circuits. First, it introduces the basic concepts required for the analysis of alternating current circuits such as sine wave, phase, impedance, inductance and frequency domains. Then it teaches the theories of steady-state analysis and AC power analysis, and then introduces the analysis of three-phase circuits and magnetic coupling circuits. Finally, it ends with the frequency response analysis that will occur when the frequency of the AC power supply changes.
entries.本課程指在銜接普化課程，以無機化學，固態化學及奈米材料化學為主。: This course refers to the generalization course, focusing on inorganic chemistry, solid-state chemistry and nanomaterial chemistry.
entries.本課程採「專題導向學習 (PBL)」與「敏捷疊代開發」模式，要求修課學生必須具備: This course adopts the models of "topic-oriented learning (PBL)" and "agile stacking development", which requires students to have basic Python and MATLAB programming skills. The course is no longer taught chapter by chapter according to traditional textbooks, but fully integrates the theory into the three core technical modules, and the final output is applied to the customized AI project system in the fields of biomedicine, industry and environment:
entries.本課程採取「思考-成對-比較」(think-pair-comparison)思維: This course adopts the "think-pair-comparison" thinking method, and the research methods include statistics, innovative thinking and generative artificial intelligence-assisted thinking and experimental methods.
entries.本課程採取邀請特邀演講者（Guest Speakers）的動態模式，內容緊扣現代: This course adopts the dynamic mode of inviting Guest Speakers, and the content is closely in the core area of modern cognitive neuroscience. Compared with fixed textbook units, this series of seminars revolves around the following major core topics, and makes dynamic adjustments in the professional fields of visiting experts:
entries.本課程採專題講授方式，課前指定研讀文章，採講演、討論與學生讀書報告方式進行。本課: This course adopts the method of special lectures. It is designated to study articles before class, and it is conducted in the form of lectures, discussions and students' reading reports. This course takes the important topics of Taiwan's economic development as the teaching unit, including land and water conservancy, agriculture, industry, trade, finance, transportation, commerce, economy and environment, etc. Taking the times as the history and the theme as the way, from the views of important classic works at different stages and the supporting evidence of historical materials, the discussion is intertwined, so that students can understand the continuity and changes of Taiwan's economic development. In addition to teachers' lectures, the class also focuses on students' collection and interpretation of historical materials, analysis, discussion and training of special writing ability.
entries.本課程採用演講、作業和學期研究計畫報告相結合的方式進行。: This course is conducted in a combination of speech, homework and semester research plan report.
entries.本課程採用生動有趣的情境個案，透過角色扮演的方式來引導學生實際體驗協商的過程，並: This course uses vivid and interesting situational cases to guide students to actually experience the process of negotiation through role-playing, and teach the negotiation skills and strategic analysis required in various business environments. The experiential learning environment can deepen the absorption of theoretical knowledge and cultivate the negotiation ability needed for future life and workplace.
entries.本課程採用由上而下的教學方式，從 Web、Email、DNS、影音串流等常見網路: This course adopts a top-down teaching method. Starting from common network applications such as Web, Email, DNS, audio and video streaming, etc., it explains the basic concepts and service requirements of the Internet, and gradually explores the core communication mechanisms and supporting technologies such as transmission layer, network layer, link layer, wireless network and network security.
entries.本課程採非同步遠距教學，學生可在上課時段跟老師遠端討論: This course adopts asynchronous distance teaching, and students can discuss with teachers remotely during class.
entries.本課程探討人類編碼、保留與提取訊息的認知歷程及神經機制，以及記憶在何種情況下會失: This course explores the cognitive process and neural mechanism of human coding, retention and extraction of information, and under what circumstances memory will fail. Based on the theory of behavior level, we will evaluate the evidence of neuropsychology, electrophysiology and neuroimaging research, and explore how these research paths provide a basis for the theoretical interpretation of human memory, and how to define the scope and limitations of these interpretations.
entries.本課程探討台灣產業的演進與發展趨勢。從傳統製造業、高科技產業到綠色經濟，學生將深: This course discusses the evolution and development trend of Taiwan's industry. From traditional manufacturing, high-tech industries to green economy, students will have an in-depth understanding of the development vein of Taiwan's industry and the positioning of the industry in the global supply chain under the influence of policies. In response to the development of internationalization, the demand for international talents in Taiwan's industry is increasing day by day. For this reason, the course specially arranges practical courses such as interview skills and resume analysis to assist students in exploring and planning their career development. The course includes industry lectures, case studies, policy analysis, industry insights, enterprise visits, career exploration, job search practical courses and employment sharing, helping students master Taiwan's role in the global economy, as well as their ability to cope and innovate in the context of digital transformation, sustainable development, geopolitics and transnational cooperation.
entries.本課程探討地方治理與文化脈絡間的交織互動，檢視制度、政策與社區實踐如何形塑日常生: This course explores the intertwining and interaction between local governance and cultural context, examines how systems, policies and community practices shape daily life, and how local culture affects political participation and local democracy. This course will go into the urban and rural scene of Taiwan, analyze the real challenges of "localities" through case studies, reveal the power structure and cultural factors behind it, and guide students to understand the interaction between the discussion of public affairs and political decision-making under democratic governance. This course explains the topics related to local political culture, and further explains the basic concepts of the course by recording video viewing and lecture review. Students, choose a relevant topic to conduct a case analysis and class report on "local political culture".
entries.本課程探討強震地動現象之原因、觀測及分析。內容包括:1.強震地動學簡介2.彈性力: This course discusses the causes, observations and analysis of earthquakes. The content includes: 1. Introduction to the dynamics of strong earthquakes 2. Basic principles of elastic mechanics 3. The effect of the epicenter on the vibration 4. The influence of shock wave path on vibration 5. The impact of regional sites on seismats 6. Strong ground motion simulation
entries.本課程探討投資相關的理論與實證議題。: This course discusses the theoretical and empirical issues related to investment.
entries.本課程提供一種經驗式的學習環境，讓學生可以整合過去所學的商管知識，系統分析與設計: This course provides an empirical learning environment, so that students can integrate the knowledge of business management, system analysis and design, programming language, database and other knowledge and technologies learned in the past, and learn teamwork to effectively achieve the task of system development through interaction with team members or customers.
entries.本課程提供基礎與進階財務管理內容，使學生獲得必要財務管理知識和學習相關計算，於未: This course provides basic and advanced financial management content, so that students can acquire the necessary financial management knowledge and learn relevant calculations, and apply it to solve practical problems in the future. The basic course content includes: introduction to financial management, financial statement analysis, time value of money, discounted cash flow evaluation, net present value method and other investment criteria; advanced course content includes: capital investment decision-making.
entries.本課程提供基礎財務管理內容，使學生獲得必要財務管理知識和學習相關計算，於未來應用: This course provides basic financial management content, so that students can acquire the necessary financial management knowledge and learn relevant calculations, which can be applied to solve practical problems in the future. The course content includes: introduction to financial management, analysis of financial statements, time value of money, discounted cash flow evaluation, net present value method and other investment criteria.
entries.本課程提供學生展示學習成果的舞台，目的在於整合學生的專業知識，強化學生解決問題能: This course provides a stage for students to show their learning outcomes. The purpose is to integrate students' professional knowledge, strengthen students' problem-solving ability and creative thinking ability, and link students' past learning experience to effectively assist students in integrating professional knowledge and ability. Students will acquire relevant knowledge with engineering practical problems as the main axis. With the TIPs (Theory-Integrating with Practices) practical courses at various stages, students can also explore the abilities of various problem-solving skills in more depth, including: simulation, drawing, experiments, etc.
entries.本課程提供工程數學所需要的預備知識，第一學期包含解常微分方程以及特殊函數介紹，第: This course provides the preparatory knowledge required for engineering mathematics. The first semester includes the introduction of solving ordinary differential equations and special functions. The second semester includes Laplace transform & Fourier transform and the analysis of partial differential equations. It is necessary to prepare basic function differentiation and integral skills and linear algebra. The relevant basic mathematical knowledge is applied to engineering and science-related fields.
entries.本課程提供財金系在職專班學生公司理財的知識。: This course provides the knowledge of corporate financial management for students in the in-service special class of the Department of Finance.
entries.本課程擬以人類學的基本假設與思考架構、人類學的歷史發展與比較觀點為基本課程架構，: This course intends to take the basic assumptions and thinking structure of anthropology, the historical development and comparative views of anthropology as the basic curriculum structure, and then combine with the key concepts of cultural anthropology (culture, knowledge) and research methods, theory and the main research topics of contemporary anthropology. Students can understand the views of anthropology, pay attention to the commonality and differences of human culture, and be able to observe, find, feel and reflect on some phenomena that were originally considered "natural" in daily life, so as to have a view of the world, their own and others, and can face and affirm the existence of cultural diversity.
entries.本課程擬引導學生深入瞭解今本《周易》之內容，思考卦爻辭中的人生哲理，探求卜筮的意: This course intends to guide students to have an in-depth understanding of the content of this book "Zhou Yi", think about the philosophy of life in the divination, and explore the meaning and value of divination. The flow and change of all things in heaven and earth in the "Yi Zhuan" is the important root of the unity of heaven and man in Chinese thought. This course also intends to discuss this topic in depth, which can improve students' thinking ability and provide different thinking aspects for the development and choice of life.
entries.本課程教學內容主要著重在指導學生運用敏捷發展法、特別是Scrum來完成系統的開發: The teaching content of this course mainly focuses on guiding students to use agile development methods, especially Scrum, to complete the development of the system.
entries.本課程教學分為五大部分，第一部份是介紹國際關係的基本理論，其包括現實主義與理想主: The teaching of this course is divided into five major parts. The first part is to introduce the basic theory of international relations, including realism and idealism, as well as the level of research and analysis of international relations, including the international system, domestic and personal levels. The second part explains the international status of Taiwan, its situation, the interaction between the United States and China, and the diplomatic strategy that should be adopted. The third part explains the significance, needs and types of international peacekeeping operations (PKO). The fourth part discusses the issues of international cooperation, international organizations and globalization, and introduces important international organizations, including the International Monetary Fund, the World Trade Organization, the World Bank and the European Union. The fifth part explores the topic of globalization, the definition, formation and current dilemma of globalization, and explains the causes of the current international financial tsunami and its impact on the current global pattern. The content includes the promise of globalization, the causes and subsequent development of the financial tsunami attack, the loss of globalization, the new global pattern and the development of Taiwan.

The teaching of this course is divided into five major parts. The first part is to introduce the basic theory of international relations, including realism and idealism, as well as the level of research and analysis of international relations, including the international system, domestic and personal levels. The second part is to explain Taiwan's international status, situation, the interaction between the United States and China, as well as the doctrine of Taiwan's independence, the signing of ECFA, and Taiwan-China relations in the post-ECFA period. The third part explains the significance, needs and types of international peacekeeping operations (PKO). The fourth part discusses the issues of international cooperation, international organizations and globalization, and introduces important international organizations, including the International Monetary Fund, the World Trade Organization, the World Bank and the European Union. The fifth part explores the issue of globalization, the definition, formation and current difficulties of globalization, and explains the causes of the international financial tsunami and its impact on the current global pattern, including the promise of globalization, the causes of the financial tsunami attack, the loss of globalization, the new global pattern and the development of Taiwan.
entries.本課程教學可分為四大部分，第一部份是說明公民社會的意義、在中西方的歷史發展以及與: The teaching of this course can be divided into four parts. The first part is to explain the meaning of civil society, the historical development of China and the West, and the relationship with democratic politics. The second part is to explain the characteristics of state organization and power, and its possible impact on the development of civil society. This course is based on our country, including the president, the administration and the legislation. The third part is to explain the contribution of the Supreme Court Council and the interpretation of the Constitution to the development of civil society, and to illustrate the impact of cases. The fourth part explores the relationship between citizens and the state. The fifth part introduces the operation of citizens' associations, including the types and operations of citizens' associations, civil organizations supervised by the government, community autonomy and development associations, labor organizations and movements in China.
entries.本課程教學目標主要在使學生可以瞭解機構主要的運動基本原理、與組件之間彼此的運動狀: The teaching goal of this course is mainly to enable students to understand the basic principles of the main movement of the institution, the movement situation between the components, and the common structure of the mechanism.
entries.本課程教學目標主要在於訓練學生解決工程相關問題的數學能力，讓學生能夠從較實務性的: The teaching goal of this course is mainly to train students' mathematical ability to solve engineering-related problems, so that students can understand their mathematical relevance from more practical engineering-related problems and physical problems. With the mathematical ability learned in this course, to solve engineering-related problems. Students can develop the following abilities through this course:
entries.本課程教導 Python 程式設計的基礎知識、概念和技術。本課程的主要目標是賦予: This course teaches the basics, concepts and techniques of Python programming. The main goal of this course is to give students the skills to analyze and interpret data through program design and make appropriate decisions.
entries.本課程教導音樂與聽覺相關認知實驗的原則和方法，並介紹同學在音樂認知神經領域中一些: This course teaches the principles and methods of cognitive experiments related to music and hearing, and introduces some commonly used research methods and results in the field of music cognitive neurology. It aims to provide students with the experimental process design commonly used in music and hearing, and combine the operation of program software to teach students how to present and process various types of music and auditory signals with program software, such as pure tone, harmonic, chord, AM, FM signal, etc. This course focuses on participating in experimental exercises and actually carrying out experiments related to music manipulation and hearing.
entries.本課程教授學生在軟體開發中設計和評估資料結構。本課程的目標是學習資料結構在軟體開: This course teaches students to design and evaluate data structures in software development. The goal of this course is to learn the role of data structure in software development.
entries.本課程教授對象主要為地球科學及環境工程相關科系大學部三、四年級以上之學生，課程內: This course is mainly for students above the third and fourth grades of the Department of Earth Science and Environmental Engineering. The course content includes basic hydrological statistical methods, design rainstorm analysis methods, hydrological model (GWLF, SWMM) principles and applications, combined with R/python language analysis data and display results. The purpose is to enable students to understand hydrology-related statistics, frequency analysis, design of rainstorms, hydrological simulation methods, and the use of program language tools, cultivate talents with hydrological analysis ability, and improve students' competitiveness in practical application in the field of hydrology.
entries.本課程教授戰後地緣政治和東亞國際關係的變化，除了幫助學習者熟悉西方國際關係政治理: This course teaches post-war geopolitics and changes in East Asian international relations. In addition to helping learners become familiar with the political theory, analysis methods and structure of Western international relations, it also focuses on East Asian geopolitics and international order. The triggers left after World War II: the cross-strait issue, the South Korean issue and the Middle East issue, most of which are concentrated in Northeast Asia. In this regard, this course tries to explore the geopolitical and international relations of Northeast Asia in the new century. The Ukrainian-Russian war in 2022, the North Korean missile test launch, and the heated Sino-American antatation, etc., all highlight the continuing communist factors left over from the Cold War, and expand to social, economic, scientific and technological levels. In terms of geopolitics, Taiwan is located in a strategic hub. How to keep a distance from China and maintain friendly relations with surrounding countries are important issues.
entries.本課程教授沈積學與地層學。課程內容包括沈積物的成因、搬運、沈積岩的物理性質、組成: This course teaches sedimentology and stratology. The content of the course includes the morphology, handling, physical properties, composition, classification and rock formation of sediments. Sedimentary environment, stratigraphy and basin analysis are also one of the teaching contents. This course also includes 2 days of field geological training.
entries.本課程整合教學設計、學習心理學與教學實務，帶領學生建構對「學習與教學」的系統性認: This course integrates teaching design, learning psychology and teaching practice, and leads students to build a systematic understanding of "learning and teaching". Starting from the overall structure of the teaching design model, we will gradually explore the theoretical variants of learning psychology, and finally implement the practical exercises of specific teaching methods.
entries.本課程於每一項評量中，「分析與量測的誠實程度」與「系統效能」至少等重。一份指出自: In each evaluation of this course, the "honesty of analysis and measurement" and "system performance" are at least equally important. A report that points out the limitations of its own method and provides appropriate statistical tests and control groups will have a higher score than a report that only shows a higher score but does not measure. The use of generative AI tools is not restricted, but the method of use must be clearly stated in one line in the report; conclusions that are not produced by one's own judgment must not be submitted.
entries.本課程旨在介紹先進銲接、表面處理及先進電腦輔助製造及3D積層製造等，使學生進一步: This course aims to introduce advanced junction, surface treatment, advanced computer-aided manufacturing and 3D layer manufacturing, etc., so that students can further understand the technology and knowledge of precision machinery manufacturing. The course will focus on the future trend development of modern common welding principles, material surface treatment and hardening methods, computer integrated manufacturing technology and 3D layered manufacturing, and deeply analyze the basic principles, operation modes and application characteristics behind them. Through these contents, students will be able to master relevant precision manufacturing technology and cultivate the ability of engineering analysis and problem-solving as talents related to machinery and electromechanical in the future.
entries.本課程旨在介紹兩相流與相變熱傳之基本理論、物理現象及工程應用。學生將了解液–氣兩: This course aims to introduce the basic theory, physical phenomena and engineering applications of two-phase flow and phase change heat transfer. Students will learn about the flow spectrum changes, boiling and condensation heat transfer mechanism, two-phase pressure drop in liquid-gas two-phase flow, and further explore applications such as micro-flow channels, cold plates and high heat flux electronic heat dissipation.
entries.本課程旨在介紹具備不同背景（如生醫工程、生命科學及相關領域）之學生，了解深度學習: This course aims to introduce students with different backgrounds (such as biomedical engineering, life science and related fields) to understand the basic principles and applications of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence models in the field of biomedicine. This course also echoes the goal of the Institute of Biomedical Science and Technology to cultivate interdisciplinary talents to promote the development of biomedical innovation and medical application.
entries.本課程旨在介紹半導體元件之基本物理原理與操作機制，內容涵蓋半導體中的能帶與載子行: This course aims to introduce the basic physical principles and operating mechanisms of semiconductor components, covering the energy band and carrier behavior in semiconductors, electrical analysis of uniform and non-uniform semiconductors, pn junction components, MOSFET and bipolar junction transistors (BJT) and other core components. Through theoretical derivation and component characteristic analysis, students can establish the basic concept of solid-state electronic components, and have the ability to analyze and understand the operating principle of modern semiconductor components and their applications.
entries.本課程旨在介紹現代證券交易理論，並協助學生理解資訊在不同交易市場機制中所扮演的角: This course aims to introduce modern securities trading theory and help students understand the role of information in different trading market mechanisms. After taking this course, students will be able to master the core concepts of market microstructure and understand how information affects transaction behavior, price formation and market efficiency. The course topics include rational expectation equilibrium, order-driven market, and quotation-driven market.
entries.本課程旨在介紹目前用於探勘這些地外星體的地球物理探勘技術，以及已經執行或計畫中的: This course aims to introduce the geophysical exploration techniques currently used to explore these extraterrestrial bodies, as well as the exploration tasks that have been carried out or are in the process. At the same time, it will also explore the developing or mature geophysical exploration technologies on Earth, as well as the potential of these technologies and methods to be applied in space missions.
entries.本課程旨在介紹糾錯編碼（Error-Correcting Codes）的數學基礎: This course aims to introduce the mathematical foundation and basic principles of Error-Correcting Codes. The course focuses on guiding students to use algebra tools such as "linear algebra" and "finite body" to construct, analyze and practice linear codes. Students will master how to detect and correct data in the face of noise interference in communication, and lay a rigorous theoretical foundation for the subsequent in-depth study of advanced coding theory or communication engineering.
entries.本課程旨在介紹聽覺認知與腦功能之基本概念，並探討腦損傷患者在語言、音樂、聲音知覺: This course aims to introduce the basic concepts of auditory cognition and brain function, and explore the changes in language, music, sound perception and cognitive function in patients with brain injury. The course will also cultivate students' ability to read and sort out cognitive neuroscience literature, train their basic research ability to develop research problems, design experiments and analyze data, and enhance students' understanding of auditory cognition and brain science research through independent research plans.
entries.本課程旨在介紹視覺注意領域的最新研究成果，並深入探討這些議題。數十年來，研究人員: This course aims to introduce the latest research results in the field of visual attention and explore these issues in depth. For decades, researchers have used a variety of methods to explore visual attention. This course focuses on the neural mechanism of visual attention. The course content includes: brain structure and visual areas, neurophysiology of visual attention, spatial attention and visual search, time allocation of visual attention, pre-attention processing, neglect and Balint's syndromes. I hope the graduate students will actively participate in the classroom discussion.
entries.本課程旨在介紹解析函數的理論基礎與複變函數的基本性質，使學生具備應用相關工具解決: This course aims to introduce the theoretical basis of analytical functions and the basic nature of complex functions, so that students have the ability to apply relevant tools to solve practical problems in mathematics and other fields, and lay a theoretical foundation for further study.
entries.本課程旨在介紹鐵基及非鐵基金屬材料之熱處理原理與相變化。學生將學習各種合金於熱處: This course aims to introduce the heat treatment principle and phase change of iron-based and non-ferrous-based metal materials. Students will learn the microstructure evolution and strengthening mechanism of various alloys in the heat treatment process, understand how to regulate the properties of materials through appropriate processes to meet the needs of different engineering applications, and cultivate the ability to analyze and evaluate the effect of heat treatment, so as to lay the foundation for future employment or further study.
entries.本課程旨在介紹離岸風電開發所涉及之關鍵技術、環境條件與工程評估方法，內容涵蓋離岸: This course aims to introduce the key technologies, environmental conditions and engineering evaluation methods involved in offshore wind power development. The content covers the introduction of offshore wind power industry, project certification and domestic and foreign design specifications, regional geological characteristics of Taiwan, geological and geophysical investigation technology, seismic hazard analysis, basic design concepts of supporting structures and wind turbines, as well as marine meteorological observation and model analysis and other topics. At the same time, the course also explores the environmental impact assessment, social environment and sustainable development issues in the process of offshore wind power development, and cultivates students' cross-field integration ability of offshore wind power engineering. The course schedule includes mid-term and end-of-term special reports. Through case analysis and publication of results, students' ability to practical application and problem analysis will be strengthened, and relevant off-campus visits will be arranged according to the course progress and actual situation to enhance students' understanding of offshore wind power industry and engineering practice.
entries.本課程旨在介紹黏性流體力學之基本理論與物理機制，培養學生建立與解析流體數學模型之: This course aims to introduce the basic theory and physical mechanism of viscous fluid mechanics, cultivate students' ability to establish and analyze fluid mathematical models, and then have the basic ability to deal with fluid mechanics problems in engineering applications and academic research. After completing the course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程旨在以企業國際化的觀點介紹全球運籌體系的規劃與建置，期使同學能具有由產業特: This course aims to introduce the planning and construction of the global operation planning system from the perspective of enterprise internationalization, so that students can have the ability to design the operation mechanism and information scheme planning of the enterprise's operation and supply chain system by applying the structure of "layout-operation-IT" to the characteristics of the enterprise from the characteristics of the industry and individual enterprises.
entries.本課程旨在使修課學生熟悉管理學之基本原理與內涵，並透過生活中的實例，瞭解管理學與: This course aims to make students familiar with the basic principles and connotations of management, and understand the inseparable relationship between management and things in life through examples in life, and then learn to apply the theories and technologies taught in life.
entries.本課程旨在使大學生具備使用 Python 撰寫程式的基礎能力，透過學習基本語法、: This course aims to equip college students with the basic ability to write code using Python, and cultivate logical thinking and problem-solving ability by learning basic grammar, process control, data structure and common modules. At the same time, the course emphasizes how to make good use of AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) to assist code development and improve learning efficiency and development quality. Students will be able to apply what they have learned, write simple and practical Python code, and lay a good foundation for subsequent advanced applications such as data analysis, artificial intelligence and web development.
entries.本課程旨在使學生全面了解植物荷爾蒙在植物生長發育與環境應答中的調控機制。透過系統: This course aims to enable students to fully understand the regulatory mechanism of plant hormones in plant growth and development and environmental response. Through the systematic introduction of the biosynthesis, transport and signal transmission pathways of various plant hormones, it cultivates students' overall understanding of the plant physiological regulation network.
entries.本課程旨在使學生建立分子基因體學之基礎知識與整合性觀念，了解基因、染色體及基因體: This course aims to enable students to establish the basic knowledge and integrity of molecular genology, understand the structure, function and regulation mechanism of genes, chromosomes and genomes, and understand relevant molecular biology technologies and their applications in biomedical research. After completing this course, students should be able to: 1. Explain the basic structure, composition and relationship between genes, chromosomes and genomes. Two. Understand the gene structure of eucaryotic organisms, the characteristics of genome sequences, and the organization of repeated sequences and gene clusters. 3. Explain the main regulatory mechanism of gene expression. 4. Understand the basic principles of intracellular transport, cytoskeleton and cell message transmission of proteins. 5. Understand the mechanism of cell cycle, DNA replication and DNA damage repair, and understand their relationship with genosome stability and disease occurrence. 6. Recognize commonly used molecular biology experimental techniques and molecular diagnostic tools, and understand their principles, scope of application and result reading methods. 7. Establish a basic molecular immunology concept to understand the relationship between gene regulation and immune response.
entries.本課程旨在使學生掌握機構運動學之基本原理與分析技術，為後續如動力學、機械設計等相: This course aims to enable students to master the basic principles and analysis techniques of institutional kinematics, and lay the theoretical and practical foundation for subsequent courses such as dynamics and mechanical design.
entries.本課程旨在使學生深入理解植物基因轉殖的核心原理、關鍵技術與前沿進展，並培養其獨立: This course aims to enable students to deeply understand the core principles, key technologies and cutting-edge progress of plant gene transfer, and cultivate their ability to independently design and implement relevant research. After completing this course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程旨在使學生熟悉三維歐氏空間中曲線與曲面的基本理論，理解曲率、扭率、曲面上的: This course aims to familiarize students with the basic theory of curves and surfaces in three-dimensional Euclidean space, understand the core concepts such as curvature, torque, measurement on surfaces, Gausssian curvature, average curvature and geodesic lines, and master the basic relationship between the curvature and topological properties of surfaces.
entries.本課程旨在使學生熟悉跨文化管理（Cross-Cultural Managemen: This course aims to familiarize students with various theoretical views and practical issues of Cross-Cultural Management. The course adopts participatory learning and case teaching methods, and the learning will take the analysis of various management problems that may occur in cross-cultural organizations as the core. Students need to develop and analyze the key issues in each case through further research and discussion.
entries.本課程旨在使學生理解現代計算機系統的基本組織與設計原理，包括指令集架構、處理器、: This course aims to enable students to understand the basic organization and design principles of modern computer systems, including instruction set architecture, processor, pipeline, memory layer and input and output system. Students will be able to use performance indicators to analyze computer systems, compare the trade-offs of different architectural designs, and cultivate the ability to read, discuss and express the professional content of computer organizations in English.
entries.本課程旨在使學生系統性理解實證醫學（Evidence-Based Medicin: This course aims to enable students to systematically understand the core concepts and practical methods of Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM). Through the study of research design, literature search, critical reading, statistical result reading and evidence integration, students can raise the ability to ask answerable research questions, evaluate the quality and validity of biomedical literature, and integrate multi-party evidence to form logical judgments. At the same time, the course focuses on the application of empirical thinking in life science, biomedical research, translation medicine and biotechnology-related issues, and further improves students' academic discussion, critical thinking, and oral and written expression skills.
entries.本課程旨在使學生：: This course aims to enable students to:
entries.本課程旨在使研究所學生深入理解深度強化學習（Deep Reinforcement: This course aims to enable students of the institute to deeply understand the theoretical basis and application of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). Deep reinforcement learning combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Learning (Deep Learning, DL), so that the intelligent agent can independently learn decision-making strategies through interaction with the environment.
entries.本課程旨在全面探討離岸風電產業中的多元議題，涵蓋從能源概論、專案認證、地質與地球: This course aims to comprehensively explore various issues in the offshore wind power industry, covering all aspects from energy introduction, project certification, geological and geophysical survey to earthquake hazard analysis, as well as marine meteorological observation and model analysis, and explores environmental impact assessment and persistence issues. At the same time, it explores the aspects of wind field development from the perspective of stakeholders in different industries, such as developers, fan manufacturers, verifiers and environmental assessment consultants. The core focus of the course includes: students will learn and master the key knowledge of the geological characteristics of Taiwan's region, and further understand how these characteristics affect the design and operation of offshore wind power projects. Secondly, the course will explore the basic concepts of seismic hazard analysis and its practical application, especially for the design and safety assessment of offshore structures. In addition, the course will also deeply analyze sea meteorological observation technology and model analysis methods to ensure the stable operation of wind farms under various climatic conditions. Finally, the course will emphasize the comprehensive assessment of the environmental and social sustainable impact of offshore wind power projects, cultivate students with all-round ability to evaluate the development of wind farms, and contribute professional knowledge and insights to the sustainable development of the wind power industry in the future.
entries.本課程旨在創意性地探討並瞭解文化創意產業經營與管理。在文化經濟興盛的脈絡下，企圖: This course aims to creatively explore and understand the operation and management of cultural and creative industries. Under the vein of cultural and economic prosperity, we should not only identify the operation and control of industrialized goods, but also explore more in-depth and complex areas, such as the emergence of communication, innovation, creativity and structural power relations. The cultural industry, which is a key cultural creation characteristic, not only provides economic wealth, but also creates symbolic forms, develops innovative knowledge, builds identity, expresses vision, reflects value, promotes relationships, and can become a key cultural asset of human society. This course will introduce, explain and analyze the main theories of cultural industry development, and introduce and explore the main issues and key trends in contemporary local cultural industries and life industries (such as festival industries and tourism industries). This course will be developed along two axes: first, explore and clarify the central phenomenon and conceptual structure of "cultural industry" from different emerging social theoretical traditions. On the other hand, we should use the theory of social culture to understand the operation and meaning of contemporary local cultural industries and life industries in a more complete, richer and more realistic analysis of social relations and cultural processes. While this course has a relatively complete understanding of how to discuss the issue of "cultrual and creative industry" in today's social science, it also provides an overview of how to engage in research related to "cultrual and creative industry".
entries.本課程旨在協助 MBA 新生於正式學期開始前，建立紮實的管理學基礎，熟悉核心理論: This course aims to help MBA freshmen build a solid foundation in management, become familiar with core theories and practical cases, and cultivate the basic abilities required to enter the MBA course before the official semester begins. Through systematic learning and discussion, students will be able to adapt to subsequent advanced courses more quickly.
entries.本課程旨在協助修課同學達成下列目標：: This course aims to help students achieve the following goals:
entries.本課程旨在協助學員建立系統化的 PCB /IC載板產業知識體系。學員在修習完本課: This course aims to assist students to establish a systematic knowledge system of PCB/IC carrier board industry. After completing this course, students should be able to achieve the following goals:
entries.本課程旨在協助學生建立教育研究的基本概念與實務能力。完成本課程後，學生應能：: This course aims to assist students in building the basic concepts and practical skills of educational research. After completing this course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程旨在協助學生建立機率與統計推論的基礎能力，並熟悉管理與商業研究中常用的統計: This course aims to help students build the basic ability of probability and statistical inference, and be familiar with the statistical analysis methods commonly used in management and business research. The content of the course starts with random variables and probability distribution, and gradually introduces sampling distribution, estimation and confidence interval, hypothesis detection, statistical inference of single mother and two mother, and experimental design. Through the explanation of basic concepts, the analysis of example questions and practical application, students can understand the logic behind statistical methods and correctly interpret the results of statistical analysis.
entries.本課程旨在協助學生建立組織理論的基礎，理解組織在不同環境下的設計、管理與變革方式: This course aims to help students build the foundation of organizational theory, understand the design, management and change of organizations in different environments, and be able to apply relevant theories to real cases and contemporary organizational issues. Through classroom lectures, case analysis and academic paper discussion, students will cultivate the ability of critical thinking, analysis and reasoning and integration of views, while strengthening briefing and communication skills, and further improving their expression and decision-making ability in academic research and practical work.
entries.本課程旨在協助學生建立資訊管理領域所需之計算機科學基礎知識，並理解電腦系統、資料: This course aims to help students establish the basic knowledge of computer science required in the field of information management, and understand the core concepts of computer systems, data representation, hardware architecture, operating systems, networks, algorithms, databases, information systems, data science and artificial intelligence. Through lectures, case discussions, basic exercises and flexible learning activities, this course guides students to understand how computing technology supports organizational operations, digital services, data-driven decision-making and artificial intelligence applications. After completing this course, students should be able to master basic computational thinking, explain the operating logic of major computer technology, and be able to analyze the application, limitations and social impact of contemporary digital technology from the perspective of information management.
entries.本課程旨在協助學習者培養以下核心語言能力，以順利應對 DELF B1 等級的各項: This course aims to help learners develop the following core language skills in order to successfully cope with the evaluations of DELF B1 level:
entries.本課程旨在向資訊管理學系一年級大學生介紹程式語言的基本概念。: This course aims to introduce the basic concepts of programming language to first-year students in the Department of Information Management.
entries.本課程旨在在對客家語語法作專題式的深入導讀，使學生對客家語的句式及基本結構有所認: This course aims to provide an in-depth introduction to Hakka grammar in a special way, so that students can understand the sentence pattern and basic structure of Hakka, and understand the grammatical characteristics of Hakka in Taiwan and the characteristics of Hakka grammar in the Chinese dialect type through comparison.
entries.本課程旨在培育具備醫學與AI跨域整合能力的專業人才。透過探究臨床疾病、AI於醫學: This course aims to cultivate professionals with the ability of cross-domain integration of medicine and AI. By exploring clinical diseases and application cases of AI in medicine, guide students to think about the development direction and system structure of major clinical medical AI applications, and cultivate the literacy to propose future intelligent medical cross-domain innovative solutions.
entries.本課程旨在培育兼任研究助理之基礎研究能力，透過課程學習、研究資料蒐集、文獻整理、: This course aims to cultivate the basic research ability of part-time research assistants. Through course learning, research data collection, literature collation, topic analysis and participation in the research process, students can familiarize themselves with the basic methods and practical operation of academic research, and gradually build the ability to assist in the implementation of research plans.
entries.本課程旨在培養大一學生掌握法語發音技巧，並建立基礎口語表達能力。課程結合影音素材: This course aims to train freshmen to master French pronunciation skills and build basic oral expression skills. The course combines audio-visual materials, digital tools and artificial intelligence to assist learning to improve the diversity and interactivity of teaching, stimulate students' learning motivation, and cultivate independent learning ability and correct language learning attitude.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生中法語言轉換能力，並透過多元文化文本與翻譯實作，引導學生理解翻: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to convert Chinese and French languages, and guide students to understand that translation is not only the conversion of language forms, but also involves the adjustment of culture, situation and expression strategies through multicultural texts and translation practice. The course hopes to cultivate students' following abilities:
entries.本課程旨在培養學生以策略管理理論為核心，運用文本探勘方法分析美國上市公司 ear: This course aims to train students to take the theory of strategic management as the core and use text mining methods to analyze the earnings call of U.S. listed companies word for word. By reading relevant classics and the latest research literature, students will learn how to discover the relationship between strategic implications, investor cognition, and enterprise performance from the language of senior leaders of enterprises, and show the results in the form of research reports.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生們於 1. 新式節能、潔能與創能領域之興趣與素養。 2. 修課: This course aims to train students in 1. Interests and literacy in the fields of new energy saving, clean energy and energy creation. Two. Students will gain practical knowledge and experience in the fields of energy saving, clean energy and energy creation in this course. 3. This course is one of the energy technology practice course series, which is a guidance course related to thematic practice. 4. The special field is mainly in the fields of energy saving, clean energy and energy creation, including smart power grid, advanced energy storage and new clean energy photoelectric components, etc.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生具備精密機械系統設計所需之基礎工程知識與實務能力。課程內容涵蓋: This course aims to cultivate students with the basic engineering knowledge and practical ability required for the design of precision mechanical systems. The course content covers core mechanical theories such as statics and material mechanics, and includes the basic design principles, analysis methods, engineering calculations and selection criteria of machine components, emphasizing the application of basic mechanical analysis concepts in engineering design.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生奠定抽象思維與現代數學的基石。透過嚴謹的邏輯與集合論訓練，使學: This course aims to cultivate students to lay the foundation of abstract thinking and modern mathematics. Through rigorous logic and set theory training, students can master accurate mathematical language and be proficient in a variety of core proof techniques. The course focuses on guiding students to improve their ability from "numerical calculation" to "logical argumentation and structural analysis", so as to prepare for the subsequent study of advanced mathematics and theoretical computer science.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生對全面品質管理的系統性認識與實務應用能力。藉由品質大師理念、T: This course aims to cultivate students' systematic understanding of comprehensive quality management and practical application ability. Through core themes such as the concept of quality master, TQM principle, QC tools, statistical process control and six standard deviations, students are guided to establish a complete quality thinking, and can apply what they have learned to the actual work field to effectively solve enterprise quality problems.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生對資訊科技風險的識別與管理能力，內容涵蓋風險管理的基本概念、流: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to identify and manage information technology risks, covering the basic concepts, processes and practical operations of risk management. The core topics include risk identification, assessment, disposal and monitoring, and through case analysis of malicious attacks, social engineering, equipment failures and data leakage and other security incidents. Students will learn to use risk matrix and situational simulation tools to assess the impact of threats on information assets and propose appropriate risk control strategies.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生掌握智慧製造與智慧機器人中的虛實整合技術，建立從模擬環境、機器: This course aims to train students to master the virtual-real integration technology in intelligent manufacturing and intelligent robots, and establish the system integration ability from simulation environment, robot control to AI training. The course content covers core technologies such as Digital Twin, Virtual System (CPS), ROS2, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and Reinforcement Learning, and combines applications such as sensor integration, mobile robot, IoT data streaming and Web visualization. Students will learn how to build a virtual simulation environment, create robot models, design ROS2 communication architecture, and complete AI control training through PPO and other methods, and gradually establish a complete process from virtual simulation, AI decision-making to physical system integration. The course will eventually guide students to complete the application prototype of an intelligent system with the functions of sensing, control, data transmission, visualization and virtual and real linkage.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生掌握環境分析技術的理論基礎與實際應用，能夠熟悉現代化學分析方法: This course aims to train students to master the theoretical foundation and practical application of environmental analysis technology, and be familiar with modern chemical analysis methods and instruments for the detection and data analysis of chemicals in different substrates. Students will learn how to identify and quantify various pollutants in environmental samples, and apply the learned technology to environmental quality assessment and solve practical environmental problems. Through this course, students will improve their ability to engage in research and practical work in the field of environmental science.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生整合人工智慧與遙測技術的能力。學生將學習從地理空間資料前處理，: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to integrate artificial intelligence and telemetry technology. Students will learn the complete process of advanced deep learning tasks from geospatial data pre-processing to symant segmentation, object detection, change detection and so on. The course focuses on the practical application of drones and satellite images, so that students can use modern AI frameworks to solve complex geospatial problems.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生獨立思考和解決問題的能力，使其能運用試算表和代數建模為管理決策: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to think and solve problems independently, so that they can use trial tables and algebraic modeling to shape and solve management decision-making problems.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生能恰當使用文字將個人之想法、認知表達出來，以期對於日常人際之應: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to use words appropriately to express their personal ideas and cognitions, so as to benefit daily interpersonal response, promotion, workplace, etc. From the basic text use, rhetorical skills, structural layout and semantic logic, it will gradually progress. Finally, it will be combined with example analysis and student exercises to train students to have the corresponding basic Chinese writing ability according to the needs of various occasions. The course is divided into six major areas according to actual needs: letters, literature, planning, news, papers and self-narration.
