Finally, it will be combined with example analysis and student exercises to train students to have the corresponding basic Chinese writing ability according to the needs of various occasions. The course is divided into six major areas according to actual needs: official documents, literature, planning, news, papers and self-narration.
entries.本課程旨在培養學生運用 GIS、Microsoft Excel 及其他資訊分析工: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to use GIS, Microsoft Excel and other information analysis tools to integrate and analyze disaster prevention data. The course covers the collection, integration, analysis and visualization of disaster potential data, exposure data, socio-economic data and spatial data, and is applied to disaster risk assessment, disaster prevention planning and decision-making support. At the same time, the application of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in disaster prevention information analysis is introduced, and students' ability to solve practical problems in disaster prevention is improved through case analysis and special projects.
entries.本課程旨在培養機械系學生運用數位製造技術(如積層製造/3D列印)來創造具功能性的: This course aims to train students in the Department of Mechanical Engineering to use digital manufacturing technology (such as layer manufacturing/3D printing) to create functional products. Through computer-aided design, computer-aided manufacturing theory, additive manufacturing and other theoretical explanations and software and hardware practical training, students will learn how to use modern digital tools to design, process and assemble to stimulate creativity and improve problem-solving ability. Most students of the Department of Mechanical Engineering have learned 3D drawing skills in related courses such as engineering drawing or computer-aided drawing. However, most of the CAD models they draw only consider the appearance, and less consideration for manufacturability. This course will let students understand the importance of Design for Manufacturability through CAD and CAM practice. In the classroom, SoildWorks computer-aided design software will be used to design mechanical components, and then 3D printing technology will be used to make the designed components for functional verification, or SolidCAM computer-aided manufacturing software will be used to generate processing plans and tool paths to simulate the production process.
entries.本課程旨在培養研究生文獻探討與學術報告能力，利用專題講座及分組專題報告，加強研究: This course aims to cultivate the ability of postgraduate literature discussion and academic reporting, use special lectures and group special reports to strengthen the understanding of research topics and academic communication ability, and lay the foundation for follow-up research and thesis writing.
entries.本課程旨在培養研究生閱讀學術論文並建立獨立研究的能力。: This course aims to cultivate the ability of graduate students to read academic papers and establish independent research.
entries.本課程旨在將史丹佛大學「設計思考 (Design Thinking)」之方法論，: This course aims to systematically apply the methodology of Stanford University's "Design Thinking" to the career development and self-orientation of college students. The specific teaching objectives include:
This course aims to lead students to understand the global environment and various resources. It is divided into seven themes: 1. Marine geology and resources, 2. Ocean current system, 3. Earthquake (seismic hazards) and slope dynamic system, 4. Atmospheric composition and climate change, 5. Water resources and groundwater, 6. Minerals and geothermal, 7. Geology of Taiwan
entries.本課程旨在帶領學生跨越知識的邊界，探索存在、知識與倫理的核心命題。: This course aims to lead students across the boundaries of knowledge and explore the core propositions of existence, knowledge and ethics.
entries.本課程旨在幫助同學們:: This course aims to help students:
entries.本課程旨在幫助學生了解策略管理的基本理論與實務應用，培養學生在複雜商業環境中進行: This course aims to help students understand the basic theory and practical application of strategic management, cultivate students' ability to think strategically and make decisions in a complex business environment, and be able to analyze and explain the potential impact of different strategic choices.
entries.本課程旨在幫助學生掌握學術寫作技巧，了解學術論文寫作的基本知識。前半部分的課程著: This course aims to help students master academic writing skills and understand the basic knowledge of academic paper writing. The first half of the course focuses on the introduction of the language and writing style used in academic papers, and the second half is an in-depth introduction to the common writing framework in academic papers (preface-method-result-discussion).
entries.本課程旨在幫助學生理解國際電影合製的歷史、架構與策略，並特別聚焦於臺灣與亞洲、歐: This course aims to help students understand the history, structure and strategy of international film production, and focuses on the cooperation model between Taiwan and Asia, Europe and the United States. Through case studies, participation in film workshops and film exhibition marketing activities (if held during the semester), communication with industry professionals, and practical group planning, students will deeply explore the operation of film co-making at the creative, financial and institutional levels.
entries.本課程旨在建立學生安排與組織學術會議的能力，以及培養學生在專業學術場合中準備資料: This course aims to build students' ability to arrange and organize academic conferences, and cultivate students' basic ability to prepare materials and make oral reports in professional academic occasions.
entries.本課程旨在建立學生對微中子物理之基本理論、實驗方法與重要研究議題的系統性理解，使: This course aims to establish students' systematic understanding of the basic theories, experimental methods and important research topics of microneutron physics, so that students can master the key role of microneutrons in modern particle physics, astronomical physics and cosmology. Through the practice of this course, students are expected to achieve the following learning results and professional performance:
entries.本課程旨在建立學生對遙測科學的基礎認識，從電磁波與地表、大氣、海洋之交互作用出發: This course aims to establish students' basic understanding of telemetry science. Starting from the interaction between electromagnetic waves and the surface, atmosphere and ocean, it introduces the basic principles, data characteristics, image interpretation methods and practical applications of satellite telemetry. The course content will cover core technologies such as optics, thermal infrared, microwave and radar telemetry, and explain the application of different sensors in land, atmospheric, marine and environmental monitoring.
entries.本課程旨在建立學生紮實的物理學基礎，培養其必要的背景知識與分析能力，作為日後修習: This course aims to establish a solid foundation in physics for students, cultivate their necessary background knowledge and analytical ability, and prepare for advanced physics courses and research in related fields in the future.
entries.本課程旨在引導學生學習群表現理論的基本概念與方法，並透過閱讀、討論與上台報告，培: This course aims to guide students to learn the basic concepts and methods of group expression theory, and cultivate students' ability to clearly express mathematical thinking through reading, discussion and stage reports. At the same time, this course also hopes to train students' ability to actively sort out literature, think about problems and explore examples, and gradually develop the habit of independent learning and research. In the later stage of the course, students will be encouraged to choose relevant topics according to their personal interests, and further develop them into special results for college students related to the finite group performance theory.
entries.本課程旨在引導學生建立系統性法律思維。民法作為規範私法關係的核心根本，與日常生活: This course aims to guide students to establish systematic legal thinking. As the core foundation of regulating private law relations, civil law is closely related to daily life, commercial transactions and social interaction.
entries.本課程旨在引導學生理解性別、科技與社會之間的交織關係，並培養其運用資料分析工具進: This course aims to guide students to understand the intertwining relationship between gender, science and technology and society, and to cultivate their ability to use data analysis tools to explore gender issues. By combining theoretical discussion and practical training, students will be able to analyze the operating mechanism of gender in social structures such as labor, care, health and ethnic groups, further grasp the historical context and institutional conditions behind it, and at the same time explore how scientific and technological development (including big data and artificial intelligence) shapes and reshapes gender differences and inequality at different levels. The course also emphasizes the cultivation of data ability, so that students can use data analysis and visualization tools (such as Power BI) to transform abstract gender issues into concrete and interpretable data evidence, and develop critical thinking skills in the process to identify gender bias and power relationships implicit in data, algorithms and visual presentation. In the end, students will be able to integrate gender theory and data analysis methods, put forward research questions of social significance, and complete the presentation of results with depth of analysis and expressive ability.
entries.本課程旨在引導學生理解編譯器的基本原理、設計方法與實作流程。課程內容涵蓋詞彙分析: This course aims to guide students to understand the basic principles, design methods and practical processes of compilers. The course content covers core topics such as vocabulary analysis, grammar analysis, meaning analysis, intermediate code generation, code optimization and target code generation, and introduces regular expressions, finite state machines, grammar, analysis technology and symbol table management. Through theoretical lectures, example analysis and code implementation, students will learn how to convert high-level code languages into executable programs and analyze the functions and interrelationships of each stage. After completing the course, students should have the ability to design simple compilers, use relevant tools, debug and evaluate compilation results, and cultivate the ability of systematic thinking, program design and solving complex software problems as the basis for further learning of programming languages, operating systems and software engineering.
entries.本課程旨在引導學生透過實際參與校內外服務活動，培養社會關懷、公共責任、團隊合作與: This course aims to guide students to cultivate social care, public responsibility, teamwork and self-reflection ability by actually participating in on-campus and off-campus service activities. Students will understand the needs of the service object in the process of service, learn to communicate and cooperate with different groups, and link the service experience with personal growth, professional learning and civic responsibility. The course also encourages students to cultivate empathy, problem-solving ability and sustainable service spirit from practice.
entries.本課程旨在引導法文系高年級學生掌握格雷瑪斯（Algirdas Julien Gr: This course aims to guide senior students of the French Department to master the core methodology of Sémantique Structurale (Sémantique Structurale, 1969) of Greimas (Algirdas Julien Greimas, 1917−1992). Through theoretical explanation and text empirical evidence, students will learn to penetrate the surface syntax of natural language and extract the deep semantic axis (axe sémantique). The course focuses on three major ability cultivation: first, understand and practice the process of "text objectification", and master the analysis skills of setting aside subjective projection and external references; second, skillfully use basic concepts such as «sème» and «classème» to construct the s the symatic combination rules of the micro-universe («micro-univers»); third, distinguish between the three levels of language classes of descriptiveness, methodology and esthemology, establish a rigorous symatic science perspective, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent narrative and poetic analysis.
entries.本課程旨在引導管院大二的同學建構社會科學中科學性論述: This course aims to guide the sophomores of the Institute of Management to build scientific discussions in social sciences.
entries.本課程旨在引導管院大二的同學建構社會科學中科學性論述的基礎 -- 統計分析。面對: This course aims to guide the sophomores of the Academy to build the foundation of scientific discussion in social sciences - statistical analysis. In the face of the era of mixed information, how to transform the existing data at hand into usable information to assist in various decision-making and judgments in the face of many uncertainties, we need a set of tools and methods that can help us understand the connotation of information, and statistical analysis plays a proper role. At the beginning of last semester's course, we will introduce some forms and characteristics of actual data in contact with the real world, how to view and observe these data from a scientific perspective, and summarize the information and insights we need in decision-making. The course then lays out the concept of probability. What is a random variable? Master the relationship between information sets and conditional probability, common distribution patterns, categories of correlation analysis, basic concepts of statistical inspection and inference, etc.

In the face of the era of mixed information, how to transform the existing data at hand into usable information to assist in various decision-making and judgments in the face of many uncertainties, we need a set of tools and methods that can help us understand the connotation of information, and statistical analysis plays a proper role. I hope that through the construction of the statistical foundation of Zashi, students can master the tools and analysis methods needed in the field of management in the future when they are looking for a job in the business industry or want to continue their studies in the future.
entries.本課程旨在引導管院大二的同學建構社會科學中科學性論述的基礎統計分析。面對資訊紛沓: This course aims to guide the sophomores of the Academy to build a basic statistical analysis of scientific discussion in social science. In the face of the era of mixed information, how to transform the existing data at hand into usable information to assist in various decision-making and judgments in the face of many uncertainties, we need a set of tools and methods that can help us understand the connotation of information, and statistical analysis plays a proper role. At the beginning of this semester's course, we will introduce the types and characteristics of some actual data in contact with the real world, how to view and observe these data from a scientific perspective, and summarize the information and connotations we need in decision-making. The course then lays out the concept of probability and random variables. Discuss the relationship between information sets and conditional probability, common distribution patterns, categories of correlation analysis, statistical inspection and inference and other basic statistical concepts. In the course, different cases and examples are used to explain the intuitive meaning and operation contained in each statistical concept and model in combination with theory, and to assist students' understanding of statistics and statistical analysis. THROUGH THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE STATISTICAL FOUNDATION OF DATA SORTING, NARRATIVE STATISTICS AND PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL DISTRIBUTION, IT WILL LAY THE FOUNDATION FOR THE STATISTICS COURSES OF THE NEXT SEMESTER, AND WILL BE ABSTATED WITH THE ANALYSIS TOOLS AND METHODS NEEDED FOR BUSINESS MANAGEMENT FIELDS SUCH AS ECONOMICS, FINANCE OR MARKETING WHEN STUDENTS ARE LOOKING FOR A JOB IN THE BUSINESS INDUSTRY OR WANT TO CONTINUE THEIR FURTHER STUDY IN THE FUTURE.
entries.本課程旨在打破傳統手動編碼與研究的侷限，引導學生深入理解大型語言模型 (LLMs: This course aims to break the limitations of traditional manual coding and research, guide students to deeply understand the underlying principles of large language models (LLMs) and proxy systems (Agentic AI), and establish advanced research thinking. Through the combination of theory and practice, students will learn to use AI agents to explore literature, define research problems and explore gaps. At the same time, supplemented by systematic governance engineering to restrain AI hallucinations and ensure the reproducibility of experiments, so that students finally have the complete ability from research ideas, automated experimental development, to the completion of academic rigorous draft papers.
entries.本課程旨在拓展現有課程「非侵入性腦刺激的治療應用」與「非侵入性腦刺激技術導論」的: This course aims to expand the scope of the existing courses "Therapeutic Application of Non-invasive Brain Stimulation" and "Introduction to Non-invasive Brain Stimulation Technology".
entries.本課程旨在掌握中國詩詞文學批評史的理論演變，梳理先秦至清代的重要觀點和流派，建立: This course aims to master the theoretical evolution of the history of Chinese poetry and literature criticism, sort out the important views and schools from the pre-Qin Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty, and establish a complete historical context. Explore core concepts such as "bixing", "shenyun", "style", sexual spirit", "realm" and so on, and understand the connotation evolution of different eras. Through the study of literary criticism literature, cultivate the ability of postgraduate students to read texts carefully and interpret and apply theories.
entries.本課程旨在探索紀錄的歷史與多元形式，涵蓋電影、攝影與漫畫等不同媒介。: This course aims to explore the history and multiple forms of records, covering different media such as film, photography and comics.
entries.本課程旨在探討如何在有限資源下利用工程設計與製程改善達成品質目標。內容涵蓋田口品: This course aims to explore how to use engineering design and process improvement to achieve quality goals with limited resources. The content covers the principle of Tiankou quality engineering, the application of direct tables and parameter design, and is applied to product development. Teaching combines thesis discussion, case analysis and group practice to deepen students' quality concept and improve their practical ability to solve engineering problems.
entries.本課程旨在探討客家移民在臺灣移墾之歷史及其所面臨之問題。希望經過本課程，能使學生: This course aims to explore the history of Hakka immigrants' reclamation in Taiwan and the problems they face. It is hoped that through this course, students can have a clear understanding of the history of Hakka immigration and reclamation of Taiwan; and stimulate students' interest in studying the history of Hakka reclamation, and then cultivate students' basic ability to engage in Hakka academic research.
entries.本課程旨在探討荀子哲學。本課程一方面「自內觀之」，著重根據荀子文本掌握其哲學要旨: This course aims to explore Xunzi's philosophy. On the one hand, this course is "viewing from the inside", focusing on grasping the essence of Xunzi's philosophy according to the text. On the other hand, "from the appearance", it is intended to discuss various interpretations of Xunzi's philosophy with the students, and rethink the contemporary significance of Xunzi's philosophy.
entries.本課程旨在提供藝術史理論與方法之發展的宏觀視野，並且呈現近年的學術研究成果如何面: This course aims to provide a macro perspective on the development of the theory and method of art history, and present how the academic research results in recent years face the challenges of emerging topics such as archive fever, relational aesthetics, manipulation shift, anthropology, globalization, and earth theory. At the same time, it is also hoped that through the disassembly and discussion of theoretical texts, young researchers can think about the many possibilities of art history practice in contemporary times.
entries.本課程旨在提供進階經濟學內容，包含賽局理論與企業策略運用、全球經貿與產業發展趨勢: This course aims to provide advanced economics content, including game theory and enterprise strategy application, global economic and trade and industrial development trends, future global economic development and other topics, which is expected to help grasp economic trends and enterprise decision-making.
entries.本課程旨在提升修課同學的口語與文字表達能力。: This course aims to improve the oral and written expression skills of students.
entries.本課程旨在提升學生的聽力理解能力，課堂上會使用不同主題的音檔、影片，幫助學生理解: This course aims to improve students' listening comprehension ability. Audio files and videos of different themes will be used in the classroom to help students understand the vocabulary and sentences used in daily and work environments.
entries.本課程旨在提升研究生在資訊管理、科技與商業情境中的專業英語溝通能力，特別聚焦於管: This course aims to improve the professional English communication skills of graduate students in information management, science and technology and business situations, focusing on management communication strategies, oral presentations, written communication, technical and business information expression, cross-cultural interaction, and responding to questions and critical discussions. The course continues the design of the management communication course of this department with practical exercises as the core, and combines theories and cases related to management communication, so that students can choose appropriate communication strategies according to the audience, purpose, situation and medium. Through lectures, seminars, briefing drills, writing tasks, peer feedback and individual guidance, students will learn how to clearly introduce themselves and professional background, explain information technology and business issues, present research results and course projects, write technical/management reports and professional emails, and develop the ability to communicate effectively in the international academic and workplace environment. After completing this course, students should be able to express themselves professionally in a clear, decent and convincing way, and show good communication and judgment in different management and scientific and technological situations.
entries.本課程旨在教授學生如何在工程材料中實現節能與減碳。近幾十年來，社會在追求經濟成長: This course aims to teach students how to achieve energy saving and carbon reduction in engineering materials. In recent decades, society has been paying continuous attention to the improvement of the performance of engineering materials while pursuing economic growth and meeting the expanding industrial demand. In recent years, with the increasing problems of global warming and resource depletion, people pay more attention to the balance between material performance and environmental permanence. Energy conservation and carbon reduction in engineering materials are a key topic. This course will equip students with the basic concepts and knowledge needed to meet these challenges.
entries.本課程旨在教授微流體（Microfluidics）的基礎知識，包括理論背景與實際: This course aims to teach the basic knowledge of Microfluidics, including theoretical background and practical application.
entries.本課程旨在深入探索不同的組織理論，並培養博士班學生批判性思維和理論應用能力。透過: This course aims to deeply explore different organizational theories and cultivate the critical thinking and theoretical application ability of doctoral students. Through the study and analysis of classical and contemporary organizational theories, students will master how to use these theoretical frameworks in research to explain organizational phenomena and carry out original research.
entries.本課程旨在深入探討 SAP ERP S/4 HANA GUI/FIORI系統 。: This course aims to deeply explore the SAP ERP S/4 HANA GUI/FIORI system. Students will learn the core organizational structure configuration and more comprehensively master the core functions of each module (SAP FI/CO/WM/EAM/PS/CS) through the interactive stack assistance of logistics modules and code languages, including procurement, sales, accounts payable and cost center accounting, inventory management, project management and customer service. At the same time, this course combines SAP Learning Hub online e-learning resources, logistics resources and program language to guide students to take the SAP TS 410 financial module and SAP industry original factory professional certification.
entries.本課程旨在深入探討災害防救法令與體系，培養學員對於各類災害特性與應對策略的全方位: This course aims to deeply explore the disaster prevention and rescue laws and systems, and cultivate students' comprehensive understanding of the characteristics and response strategies of various disasters. First of all, students will learn how to classify disasters and deeply analyze the uniqueness of each disaster and its countermeasures. On this basis, the course will introduce the development process of the domestic disaster prevention and rescue system and the current laws and regulations, especially the impact of the Disaster Prevention and Rescue Law on the overall disaster prevention and rescue work. In addition, students will understand the basic disaster prevention and rescue plans and business plans at the national level, master the roles and responsibilities of government agencies at all levels in disaster management, and understand how local governments can formulate appropriate prevention and rescue plans according to local characteristics.
entries.本課程旨在為學生提供在微型電腦平台上開發軟體應用的實務知識與實作經驗。課程以 K: This course aims to provide students with practical knowledge and practical experience in developing software applications on microcomputer platforms. The course takes Kneo Pi (Kneron) as the core, integrating data interception, interface communication and multimedia processing. Students will also apply artificial intelligence model inference technology in actual situations, especially focusing on computer vision and intelligent system applications. This course emphasizes the ability of system integration, problem-solving, and the application of intelligent technology in the field of information management.
entries.本課程旨在為研究生提供應用數學的必要知識，這些知識可應用於力學、電學和應用科學的: This course aims to provide graduate students with the necessary knowledge of applied mathematics, which can be applied to all aspects of mechanics, electricity and applied science.
entries.本課程旨在瞭解如何完成成功的契約管理。: This course aims to learn how to achieve successful contract management.
entries.本課程旨在系統性介紹半導體記憶體與邏輯元件的基本原理、架構演進與微縮挑戰。內容涵: This course aims to systematically introduce the basic principles, architectural evolution and miniature challenges of semiconductor memory and logic components. The content covers from traditional SRAM, DRAM to flash memory, and then extends to emerging memory such as RRAM, PCM and FeFET/FeRAM, so that students can fully understand the operation modes, circuit design methods of different technologies, and the problems faced under reliability, variability and process reduction. At the same time, this course will assist students to gradually transition from basic physical cognition to circuit science application, and establish a complete concept from materials, components to systems. Through case discussion and technical comparison, students can not only master the characteristics and application fields of various types of memory, but also understand their key role in high-performance computing, artificial intelligence and data-intensive services. The course will also emphasize the importance of emerging technologies in enterprise research and development and industrial upgrading, so that students can link academic knowledge with practical needs. The ultimate goal is to cultivate students with the ability of interdisciplinary thinking and innovative problem solving, to face the challenges of rapid changes in the semiconductor industry in the future, and to provide a forward-looking professional foundation for artificial intelligence applications and enterprise needs.
entries.本課程旨在系統性梳理漢代思想演進脈絡，涵蓋黃老之學、天人感應、經學流派及出土文獻: This course aims to systematically sort out the evolution of thought in the Han Dynasty, covering the study of Huang Lao, the sense of heaven and man, the school of scriptures and the unearthed literature. By studying classics such as Huainanzi, Spring and Autumn Dew, and Baihutong, students are guided to delve into the integration of Confucianism, Taoism, the theology and rationalism of the Han Dynasty, and cultivate students' ability to read and think about literature, so as to grasp the foundational significance of Han Dynasty academics in China's political and cultural system.
entries.本課程旨在訓練學生文獻之搜集及閱讀、整理與報告之能力、選修者必須選擇一至數篇最新: This course aims to train students' ability to collect, read, sort out and report literature. Electives must select one or several newly published life science articles, carefully study, summarize and sort out before class, and make powerpoint files. They will personally take the stage in class to make oral reports and discussions to the whole class on the experimental background, purpose, experimental methods and experimental results of the articles. This course not only requires students to understand the content of the article, but also to be narrated, so that the listeners can understand. It is an all-round training course.
entries.本課程旨在訓練學生統整化學工程所學之知識，應用於整廠程序設計。學生將學習設計反應: This course aims to train students to unify the knowledge learned in chemical engineering and apply it to the process design of the whole plant. Students will learn units such as design reaction, separation and heat exchange, and be proficient in process simulation software (Aspen Plus®) for design, optimization and economic evaluation. In addition, the course will guide students to pay attention to industrial current affairs and global sustainable development trends, and integrate them into design thinking. Students will discuss the process setting problems on the theme of the competition of the Taiwan Institute of Chemical Engineers (TwIChE).
entries.本課程旨在講授蘇軾重要詩作，並介紹詩人生平、相關歷史背景。課程中將精讀蘇軾「熙寧: This course aims to teach Su Shi's important poems, and introduce the poet's life and relevant historical background. In the course, we will carefully read Su Shi's poems at various stages of "the pre-Xinning period", "Xining to Yuanfeng period", "Huangzhou period", "Yuanyu period" and "Linghai period" to fully understand Su Shi's poetic achievements and life course. In addition, it will also show his humorous and innocent temperament, self-interested attitude towards the world, and personality persistence through Dongpo poetry. Combining the above two, it is expected that students can have a specific and complete understanding of Su Shi and Su Shi's poems.
entries.本課程旨在讓同學修習完本課程後能 暸解(1) 土壤與地下水的基本特性、(2) 污: This course aims to enable students to understand (1) the basic characteristics of soil and groundwater, (2) the transmission and fate of pollutants in soil and groundwater, and (3) the techniques of investigation and identification, model simulation, and rectification and rehabilitation that can be used in the event of soil and groundwater pollution.
entries.本課程旨在讓學生建立機率與統計的理論基礎，並具備應用於實際問題的能力。學生修習後: This course aims to enable students to establish a theoretical foundation of probability and statistics, and have the ability to apply it to practical problems. After the study, students should be able to:
entries.本課程旨在讓學生熟悉「物聯網（Internet of Things, IoT）」: This course aims to familiarize students with the relevant concepts of "Internet of Things" and its basic applications. Students will learn how hardware and software are connected to each other, how components of the Internet of Things are connected to each other, and how to create an Internet of Things application system.
entries.本課程旨在讓學生瞭解光的基本原理與現象。授課內容包含有幾何光學與物理光學。在幾何: This course aims to let students understand the basic principles and phenomena of light. The lecture content includes geometric optics and physical optics. In the geometric optics part, the theory, calculation model and scope of application of light will be introduced on the basis of the linear propagation of light; in the physical optics part, the fluctuation physical phenomena of light, such as polarization characteristics, interference phenomena and detour phenomena, will be explored on the basis of electromagnetic theory.
entries.本課程旨在讓學生認識並了解人力資源管理在組織中的各項要素、基本原則與重要角色。本: This course aims to enable students to recognize and understand the elements, basic principles and important roles of human resources management in the organization. This course attaches importance to both theory and practice, and establishes a solid foundation for human resources management for students.
entries.本課程旨在讓課堂上的學生具備人工智慧(Artificial Intelligen: This course aims to equip students in the classroom with the basic knowledge and insight of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) and their Intelligent Systems. Topics will include: neural networks, machine learning methods, machine learning processes, applications of machine learning, etc.
entries.本課程旨在透過「專題導向學習 (Project-Based Learning)」: This course aims to guide students to transform artificial intelligence theory into engineering practical ability to solve real-world problems through Project-Based Learning and Weekly Interactive Progress Discussion.
entries.本課程旨在透過各指導老師的專業引領，培育學生整合電機領域理論與實務開發之能力。學: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to integrate theoretical and practical development in the field of electric motors through the professional guidance of instructors. Under the individual guidance of the teacher, students will complete the special research independently or collaboratively. After complete training in problem definition, system design and practical verification, they can strengthen students' engineering literacy, project management and achievement performance.

This course aims to cultivate students' ability to integrate theoretical and practical development in the field of electric motors through the professional guidance of instructors. Under the individual guidance of teachers, students will complete thematic research independently or collaboratively, and undergo complete training in problem definition, system design and practical verification, so as to strengthen students' engineering literacy, project management and achievement performance ability.
entries.本課程旨在透過基礎的數學方法，介紹李群與李代數的核心概念，並運用線性代數與微積分: This course aims to introduce the core concepts of Lie group and Lie algebra through basic mathematical methods, and use the basic knowledge of linear algebra and calculus to understand the algebraic structure and geometric meaning of matrix Lie group. The course will start from basic matrix operations and matrix group examples, and gradually explain the concepts of matrix index, Lie algebra, and the relationship between Lie group and Lie algebra. After studying this course, students should be able to grasp the basic properties of matrix Lie groups through specific examples, understand the link between algebraic structure and geometric intuition, and be able to express mathematical problem-solving ideas in a clear oral or video form.
entries.本課程旨在透過教師引導、學生實際操作以及討論互評，增進與培養學生的文字使用能力，: This course aims to enhance and cultivate students' ability to use words through teacher guidance, students' practical operation and discussion and mutual evaluation, so that students can master the skills of complete and accurate expression of cognition, so as to cope with daily interpersonal exchanges, school promotion, job search and other situations. According to actual needs, the course arrangement is divided into four units: "self-narration", "planning", "thesis" and "literature". The course method includes teachers' lectures, group discussion, practice, feedback and mutual evaluation, so as to train students' basic Chinese writing ability and flexibly respond to the needs of different occasions in life.
entries.本課程旨在透過深入閱讀討論與實際習作過程來引導學習者瞭解高等社會科學研究方法中有: This course aims to guide learners to understand the general basis of qualitative research in higher social science research methods through in-depth reading, discussion and practical practice. The overall course content mainly includes its historical evolution, epistemology and theoretical background, essence, form, and examples; at the same time, this course will clarify the strengths and limitations of qualitative research methods from the reading and discussion of literature and through analysis and examination of the design structure and implementation process of various qualitative research. In order to enable learners to gain experience in the specific design and field implementation of qualitative research, each student must practice the complete research process, from constructing problems, research questions, designing research, writing project books, to practicing different research methods, data analysis and writing presentation.
entries.本課程旨在透過邀請不同領域之專家學者、業界人士或研究人員至系上進行專題演講，拓展: This course aims to expand students' understanding of information engineering-related research and practical applications by inviting experts, scholars, industry people or researchers from different fields to give special lectures in the department. Students can learn about the latest technological developments, research trends, industrial needs and academic research methods by listening to speeches, participating in discussions and asking questions, and cultivate cross-field thinking, professional communication and independent learning ability.
entries.本課程旨在透過邀請產業界、政府部門及學術界之專家學者進行專題演講，協助碩博士生掌: This course aims to assist master's and doctoral students to grasp the latest development trends, practical issues and research frontiers in the field of enterprise management by inviting experts and scholars from the industry, government departments and academia to give special lectures. Through the sharing and discussion of multi-topics, cultivate students' ability to integrate theory and practice, expand their cross-field horizons, and improve their critical thinking, problem analysis, academic exchange and professional communication skills. At the same time, through interaction with the speaker, students are encouraged to explore research topics from actual management problems and establish a more complete understanding of future research and career development.
entries.本課程旨在透過邀請產業經濟與財經法律領域之學者、實務專家與政府官員進行專題演講，: This course aims to assist students to master the cutting-edge achievements of current academic research and understand the core issues and challenges in practical operation by inviting scholars, practical experts and government officials in the fields of industrial economy and financial law to give special lectures. entries.本課程旨在透過頂尖專家學者的專題分享，拓展學生在資訊與電機領域的專業廣度。藉由接: This course aims to expand the professional breadth of students in the field of information and electric motors through the special sharing of top experts and scholars. By contacting diverse cutting-edge science and technology and academic pulses, guide students to explore the development potential of different fields, and then discover and establish future research interests and development directions.
entries.本課程旨在配合時序流轉、節慶遞嬗，帶領學生閱讀與之相應的文學作品；所選文類，包含: This course aims to lead students to read the corresponding literary works in accordance with the flow of time and festivals. The selected literary categories include classical poems, words, prose, modern prose and novels, so that students can rediscover the beauty of Chinese language and writing, take the initiative to connect classical and modern life situations, and live in real life poetily.
entries.本課程是” 計算機概論 I”的實習課程. 本課程將提供學生練習及精進C++程式設: This course is an internship course of "Introduction to Computers I". This course will provide students with opportunities to practice and advance C++ programming. The main method of this course is to complete the specified program design exercises in class or after class, and use C++ language to practice. The exercises of this course will help students complete the programwork of "Introduction to Computers I". This course "will not" discuss a lot of programming theory, so it is strongly recommended that students who choose this course will also choose the "Introduction to Computer I" course. Students who take this course are expected to spend "a lot" of time thinking about problems, writing code, correcting code problems, and finding/reading relevant supplementary materials. This course is designed for freshmen in the Department of Electrical Engineering. Loading is heavy, and it will require relevant knowledge of other compulsory courses in the Department of Electrical Engineering. For students who are not in the Department of Electrical Engineering but want to take this course, please think carefully. At the same time, you also need to supplement the basic knowledge of motors used in this course. After completing this course, students' problem-solving and code-solving ability will be significantly improved. You will be expected to have the ability to write code to design small systems independently.
entries.本課程是「客家語文暨社會科學學系」大學部二年級的選修課，亦歡迎其他系所同學選修。: This course is an elective course for the second year of the Department of Hakka Chinese and Social Sciences, and students from other departments are also welcome to take it. This course will introduce the basic concepts of several major fields of linguistics (linguistics) (phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax syntax, etc.), and learn from them.
entries.本課程是一門專為管理學院學生設計。課程結合理論與實務，結合企業資源，以104人力: This course is specially designed for students of the School of Management. The course combines theory and practice, and combines enterprise resources. With the online career service of 104 Manpower Bank and the Giver service of the entity, it allows students to understand themselves, understand the workplace, cultivate their ability, practice in the workplace, job search skills to the enterprise invitation and matchmaking. Learning with the goal of internship or full-time job: assist students to identify their job search goals, confirm the appropriate job content, and cultivate a good work attitude and workplace ethics concept. Two. Co-creation curriculum between schools and enterprises: The curriculum will be jointly discussed by teachers, schools and 104 courses suitable for students, and at the end of the term, industry-academic project research will be carried out to practice the social responsibility of the university and the social responsibility of the enterprise. 4. Students who take the course and complete the course will have the priority to participate in the internship opportunity of 104 Manpower Bank as the intermediated enterprise of this course.
entries.本課程是一門深度學習研究所課程，理論與實務並重，一開始將完整介紹神經網路如何學習: This course is a deep learning research course, which is weighted in theory and practice. At the beginning, it will fully introduce how neural networks learn, and then bring it into deep learning. In terms of deep learning, various important applications and models will be introduced, including classification problems, image cutting problems, time series problems, etc., and with final topics, in order to cultivate students' ability to integrate theory and practice.

entries.本課程是歷史所研一生必修，目的在於幫助學生更進一步了解研究生生涯與未來可能的生涯: This course is a lifelong compulsory course of the History Institute. The purpose is to help students further understand the postgraduate career and possible career and career paths in the future, and provide students with diversified thinking, help students smoothly enter the research field and formally start writing their thesis. This course department sticks to the form of weekly classroom classes, hoping that students can understand the diverse style of history in various forms of listening, visiting, etc. at various times. The teacher is the tutor, and he can take into account the problems of students to solve the problems of postgraduate career. It is a course full of flexibility and diversified learning.
entries.本課程是為上學期學過36小時聽說華語課程的學生所設計的，旨在培養和積累現代標準華: This course is designed for students who have studied 36 hours of listening and speaking Chinese last semester. It aims to cultivate and accumulate basic communication skills in modern standard Chinese. In the course, students will develop their skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing (typing). However, the focus of this course will be on cultivating students' communication skills in oral and listening skills. Use speaking and listening to drive reading and writing. Students will be able to communicate with others orally in Chinese under certain circumstances.
entries.本課程是為半年制研究生設計的。我們從回顧測度理論開始，介紹 Borel-Cant: This course is designed for semi-annual graduate students. We start by reviewing the theory of measurement and introduce the Borel-Cantelli lemma, the law of large numbers, Martingle, etc. The purpose is to provide many important ideas and thoughts for people who use probability at work.
entries.本課程是為文學院學生開設的專屬程式相關課程，旨在引導學生深入了解生成式人工智慧（: This course is an exclusive program-related course for students of the College of Arts, which aims to guide students to gain an in-depth understanding of the basic theory, technical application and future development trend of Generative AI. The course content covers the basic principles of artificial intelligence and its historical evolution, focusing on the application of generative AI in text generation, image voice generation, language learning and other fields. Through practical operation, students will learn how to use Python code syntax and complete the theme production with the collaborative assistance of generative AI. The course will also introduce the cases of cross-field application of generative AI to literature, art, philosophy, history and other humanities disciplines, and cultivate students' innovative application ability in their respective professional fields.
entries.本課程是為每一位對人類學習行為和其背後大腦機制感興趣者所設計的，主要的目標在於1: This course is designed for everyone who is interested in human learning behavior and the brain mechanism behind it. The main goal is to 1) introduce the different aspects of human learning behavior, 2) explain the neural mechanism behind learning behavior, and 3) emphasize that cognitive behavior and brain function can be changed by learning. In the past, people understood learning behavior through observation and experimental methods. Although they accumulated a lot of important knowledge, there were still many mysteries to be solved. Although the brain and all cognitive behaviors were closely related, the understanding of the brain was relatively limited in the past, so there were also many plausible myths. Since the end of the 20th century, cognitive neuroscientists have combined the research methods of experimental psychology and emerging brain science instruments to greatly promote the study of the human brain, which has also helped to deeply grasp human learning behavior. These brain science achievements related to human learning behavior not only help us understand the mechanism of the operation of various cognitive functions, but also effectively improve the relevant knowledge in the interdisciplinary application of any category related to human behavior, which has an impact on education, disease treatment, behavior correction, health care, marketing and other fields. This course will introduce how to use scientific methods to study and understand human learning behavior, and explain the physiological mechanisms behind various cognitive behaviors. Students in different fields studying this course can not only increase their understanding of their own learning behaviors and related neural mechanisms, but also help to establish basic literacy in behavioral science and brain science, cultivate the ability to distinguish common myths and misconceptions, and will also impact professional considerations and ideas, and inspire thinking closer to human nature.
entries.本課程是為生命科學研究所博士生開設的課程，教授如何組織和展示自己的研究工作。一年: This course is for doctoral students of the Institute of Life Sciences to teach how to organize and display their research work. First-year students need to show their recently published works in the field of interest. For senior students, they need to review their work in their research field and show it to their classmates in a report of about 30 minutes. We also encourage them to display their works. Students who are not fully prepared for their speeches will be required to repeat their speeches at the second half of the semester.

First-year students need to show their recently published works in the field of interest. For senior students, they need to review their work in their research field and show it to their classmates in a report of about 30 minutes. We also encourage them to display their works. Students who are not fully prepared for their speeches will be required to repeat their speeches at the second half of the semester.

We also encourage them to display their works. Students who are not fully prepared for their speeches will be required to repeat their speeches at the second half of the semester.

This course is for master's students of the Institute of Life Sciences to teach how to organize and display their research work. Students need to show their recently published works in the field of interest, or need to review their work in their research field and show it to students in a report of about 25 minutes. We also encourage them to display their works. Students who are not fully prepared for their speeches will be required to repeat their speeches at the second half of the semester.
entries.本課程是研究所層級的自然語言處理課程，目標不是介紹 NLP 的全景，而是讓修課同: This course is a natural language processing course at the level of the research institute. The goal is not to introduce the panorama of NLP, but to equip the students with the ability to "do research with language models" and maintain appropriate doubts about their own experimental results.
entries.本課程是開給文學院學士班的同學。本學士班以四類專業課群：哲學思維與經典詮釋、知識: This course is for students in the bachelor's class of the College of Arts. This bachelor's class takes four types of professional course groups: philosophical thinking and classical interpretation, knowledge tradition and historical application, art and visual culture, and image and narrative as the base, breaking the restrictions of fixed academic fields. Through the free combination of major groups, students can plan the curriculum map of independent study and cultivate the comprehensive application ability of humanities.
entries.本課程有兩大目標，一是傳授具廣度的知識，使同學在未來工作或進修時，能具備日本美術: There are two major goals in this course. One is to teach a wide range of knowledge, so that students can have the foundation of Japanese art history in their future work or further study. This basic knowledge not only refers to important data, but also includes the exploration of the process of topic formation, which will be conducive to the application of art promotion activities or broaden the horizon of research.
entries.本課程有很多小組討論，同學如果請假、無故缺席會給同組同學帶來不便，故酌予扣分，說: There are many group discussions in this course. If students ask for leave or are absent for no reason, it will cause inconvenience to students in the same group, so points will be deducted as appropriate, as follows:
entries.本課程有系統性介紹如何觀察、描述於地表出露之岩石及岩體(沉積岩、火成岩及變質岩): This course systematically introduces how to observe and describe the geometric position and geological structure of rocks and rock bodies (sedimentary rocks, igneous rocks and metamorphic rocks) exposed on the surface, with special emphasis on field geological field visits and the reading and production of geological maps.
entries.本課程期以深入淺出的方式，讓同學具備賞析文學作品的能力，建立文學批評的方法，並培: In this course period, students have the ability to appreciate literary works, establish methods of literary criticism, and cultivate thinking skills in an in-depth and shallow way.
entries.本課程期望培養學生跨領域思維，提升其對實際產經與法制問題的理解力與批判能力，並鼓: This course hopes to cultivate students' interdisciplinary thinking, improve their understanding and critical ability of practical industry, economic and legal issues, and encourage them to further engage in relevant research or enter relevant workplace fields.
entries.本課程本學期開始因加入大學部腦與認知領域專長模組課程，將從基礎MATLAB教起，: This course starts this semester due to the addition of the specialized module course in the field of brain and cognition of the university department. It will start from the basic MATLAB teaching, and the basic MATLAB teaching will take about four weeks. Each electon student must make a special report at the end of the term.
entries.本課程本課程為提供營建管理專長涉及所有法律事務之入門介紹，其主要內容涵蓋公法、私: This course is to provide an introductory introduction to all legal affairs involved in construction management. Its main content covers the basic legal knowledge of public law and private law, analysis logic and management techniques applied to practical problems. This course adopts legal abstract concepts and examples, and achieves the purpose of learning through two-way discussion.
entries.本課程核心內容在於介紹剖風儀理論與實務相關知識，透過背景大氣、折射指數與雷達系統: The core content of this course is to introduce the theoretical and practical knowledge of the wind breaker. Through the introduction and explanation of the background atmosphere, refractive index and radar system, the atmospheric radar echo mechanism and related radar measurement atmospheric technology are derived in detail, so that students have complete theoretical knowledge of the wind breaker and practical signal analysis ability.
entries.本課程欲利用專案導向學習與其他多元方法，期提升學生對流體力學的興趣，並探索自己是: This course wants to use project-oriented learning and other diversified methods to improve students' interest in fluid mechanics and explore whether they are suitable for fluid mechanics-related workplaces. The course will enhance students' motivation to learn fluid mechanics-related disciplines through physical theory teaching, research and development work experience, food taste and workplace experience sharing, and also stimulate students to think about personal career planning and learning teamwork. This course is also designed for diversified evaluation, including the results of practical projects of groups. It is hoped that through different angles of fluid mechanics experience, it will ultimately assist in the promotion of science education.
entries.本課程欲藉由對近代以前亞洲美術作品的介紹和討論，培養學生對作品進行視覺分析，以及: Through the introduction and discussion of pre-modern Asian art works, this course is to cultivate students' ability to visually analyze the works and learn to master relevant research and discussion with a critical attitude. At the same time, through the curriculum design with the views of exchange history as the main axis, students are encouraged to jump out of the thinking framework of Taiwan/China and learn to think about various issues of art history and cultural history from the perspective of East Asia, Asia as a whole, and even the world.
entries.本課程沒有指定教材，建議參考以下資料（無需購買以下列出的書籍）。最後，歡迎您在選: There are no designated textbooks for this course. It is recommended to refer to the following materials (no need to buy the books listed below). Finally, you are welcome to discuss relevant matters with me before take this course.
entries.本課程涉及大量課後實作，推薦修習年級為大三以上（含）與研究所學生。課程偏重實作，: This course involves a large number of after-class practice, and the recommended grade is junior (inclusive) and research institute students. The course focuses on practical work, and interdisciplinary electives are also recommended.
entries.本課程涵蓋以下主題:: This course covers the following topics:
entries.本課程涵蓋四大核心教學法，每一個教學方法均透過四個步驟來達成：研究、釐清、應用與: This course covers four core teaching methods, and each teaching method is achieved through four steps: research, clarification, application and reflection. These four steps become the "Teaching Method Learning Quatetle", which is explained as follows:
entries.本課程涵蓋氣候極端事件與環境問題的相關主題，並探討如何利用GIS、遙測和人工智慧: This course covers topics related to extreme climate events and environmental issues, and explores how to use GIS, telemetry and artificial intelligence tools to assess and monitor them. The course will start with an introduction to telemetry and GIS, including a tutorial on the use of GIS software. The scientific research content of the course includes the monitoring and prediction of climate change, telemetry spectral index for hydrometeorological extreme events such as droughts and typhoons, ecological environment vulnerability, air quality, urban green space and urban heat island effect, and machine learning technology. Students will have the opportunity to participate in a research topic related to extreme climate events and environmental issues. Throughout the course, the analytical techniques used in the field of scientific research will be displayed for students to learn and apply to their own work. These technologies include the use of satellite images such as optics, microwave and radar to analyze new telemetry indexes of surface water resources, as well as machine learning and AI algorithms. Students will propose a research topic and use the knowledge and skills they have learned to show their research results at the end of the course.
entries.本課程涵蓋的數值方法包括解根，優化，線性方程組，函數及資料內差，線性迴歸，微分及: The numerical methods covered in this course include root solving, optimization, linear equations, function and data internal difference, linear regression, differentiation and integral methods.
entries.本課程涵蓋色彩科學原理及其應用: This course covers the principles of color science and its applications.
entries.本課程涵蓋衛星系統工程、推進、通訊、熱控與光學酬載等十四項核心領域。旨在引導學生: This course covers 14 core fields such as satellite system engineering, propulsion, communication, thermal control and optical load. It aims to guide students to master space mission design, system engineering planning, subsystem design analysis and integration testing, and cultivate professionals with satellite system design and practical operation ability through team division of labor to practice final topics.
entries.本課程涵蓋訓練與發展的核心主題，內容包括：訓練概論、策略性訓練、訓練需求分析、學: This course covers the core themes of training and development, including: training introduction, strategic training, training needs analysis, learning theory and curriculum design, training methods and techniques, training transfer, training effectiveness evaluation, etc. In the latter part of the course, teaching demonstration and practical drills will be carried out, and students' ability to design and evaluate training plans will be strengthened through comprehensive discussions, final exams and reports.
entries.本課程深入探討動力系統（Dynamic Systems）建模與識別（System: This course deeply explores the technology of Dynamic Systems modeling and Identification, focusing on understanding the physical principles and mathematical representations behind it. The content covers various methods of using First Principles and experimental data to establish dynamic system models, taking into account theory and practical application.
entries.本課程深入探討教育中的多元性、公平與融合議題。透過理論討論與實務應用，學生將分析: This course deeply explores the issues of diversity, fairness and integration in education. Through theoretical discussion and practical application, students will analyze the policies, historical development and global trends of integrating education. The course includes case analysis from Taiwan and other countries, focusing on how to integrate integrated practices into educational leadership, teacher training and community participation. After the course, students will have knowledge and strategies to create a more equitable learning environment.
entries.本課程準備對王陽明《傳習錄》的中、下卷的重要文獻，作當代的詮釋。也涉及陽明後學的: This course prepares for a contemporary interpretation of the important documents in the middle and lower volumes of Wang Yangming's Biography. It also involves the development of Yangming post-study, and I hope to have a systematic explanation of Yangming philosophy and its development. Based on my recent research experience, I also compared the righteousness of the two lines of Cheng Zhu and King Lu, in order to prove that the two lines are both reasonable teachings of Confucianism and morality. I hope that through the comparison of these two lines, I can revitalize the righteousness of Song and Ming Confucianism, and give the theory of morality and teaching methods that are suitable for modern people's lives.
entries.本課程為3學分，旨在深入介紹神經系統疾病與神經精神疾病之生物學機制。為了全面理解: This course is 3 credits, which aims to give an in-depth introduction to the biological mechanisms of neurological diseases and neuropsychiatric diseases. In order to fully understand the changes in brain structure and function in different developmental, neurodegenerative, neurological and mental diseases, this course will discuss the views of molecular, cellular and systemic levels.
entries.本課程為「跨領域社會參與學分學程」之導航課程。我們可以把課程內容想像為另一種版本: This course is a navigation course of "Interdisciplinary Social Participation Carts". We can think of the course content as another version of The Defender of the Eight-Foot Gate. In order to say this story well, we must understand the real social issues. The spirit of social participation is to inspire the enthusiasm of cross-domain learning and creative thinking through the process of paying attention to social issues, and to discover the meaning of learning through self-exploration while working in the real field and proposing solutions through teamwork. This course is a diversified form of teaching. In addition to classroom teaching, group discussions and off-campus visits will also be held under the leadership of sub-group teachers, and teachers will be invited to share examples. Some off-campus visits will be held on weekends and holidays, limited to once in the whole semester, and the specific time will be announced in class. The results of the semester will be presented in group topics selected by each student. The social issues to be carried out this semester will include judicial human rights, gender diversity, cross-border mobility, local creation, native industries and tribal education.
entries.本課程為「跨領域社會參與學分學程」工作坊系列第二階段，重點在完成社會實踐方案。延: This course is the second stage of the "Interdisciplinary Social Participation Cricipation" workshop series, which focuses on completing the social practice plan. Continuing the results of topic exploration and problem analysis in the early stage, students will integrate field data and action concepts, specify action goals, strategies and resource allocation, and examine feasibility and risks. Through method training, each team completed the preliminary results of a planning and practice plan in the workshop at the end of the period.
entries.本課程為「高資產與永續財富管理微學程」之整合實務課程（Capstone Cour: This course is an integrated practical course (Capstone Course) of "High Asset and Perpetual Wealth Management Micro Course". With high assets (HNWI) and Family Office wealth management and ESG/perpetual wealth as the core, it combines the theoretical structure and practical experience of financial institutions. Through the teaching of industry experts, real case analysis and team special competitions, it cultivates students' cross-field integration and long-term wealth decision-making ability.
entries.本課程為一學期, 目標為針對工學院大一學生教授基本且必要之普通化學概念: This course is for one semester, and the goal is to teach basic and necessary general chemical concepts to freshmen of the College of Engineering.
entries.本課程為一連續四學期的課程，在大一時我們著重於基礎實驗技術與觀念的養成(電子電路: This course is a course for four consecutive semesters. In the freshman year, we focus on the cultivation of basic experimental technologies and concepts (electronic circuits, program writing, automatic control, data retrieval and mechanical design and processing). When students enter their sophomore year, we design the curriculum in a task-oriented form to cultivate students' ability to plan and execute and provide opportunities to integrate the ideas and skills they have learned before. Our goal is to enable students to cultivate their self-confidence through various fears and difficulties in the process of conquering. At the same time, in the next two years of college, students have made psychological and technical preparations for their dedicated research.
entries.本課程為一門研究所層級的課程，全面介紹 深度強化學習（Deep Reinforc: This course is a research institute-level course, which comprehensively introduces the theoretical basis and practical application of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). Deep reinforcement learning combines machine learning, control theory and artificial intelligence, so that intelligent agents can learn the best strategies for continuous decision-making through interaction with the environment and the reward mechanism.
entries.本課程為中文系「思想義理」類型課程，以老子與莊子哲學為核心。課程採主題式選讀方式: This course is a "thought and righteousness" type course of the Chinese Department, with Laozi and Zhuangzi's philosophy as the core. The course adopts thematic reading method, in-depth reading of representative chapters, focusing on understanding how ideas are formed and how to respond to problems, and especially exploring the dialogue and meaning of the exchange between that time and today.
entries.本課程為中文系研究生之專業基礎課程，分別從學術理念與實務操作，具體引導學生認識學: This course is a professional basic course for graduate students of the Chinese Department. From the academic concept and practical operation, it specifically guides students to understand the meaning and value of academic research and have the ability to write plans and research papers. These include the collection and application of data, method perspective and innovation, academic ethical norms, thesis conception, revision and formation and other academic categories. The objectives are as follows:
entries.本課程為二學分的選修課程。: This course is a two-terict elective course.
entries.本課程為企業與組織管理的入門課程，管理學院各科系皆有提供本課程。雖然本課程會依各: This course is an introductory course on enterprise and organizational management, and all departments of the School of Management offer this course. Although the focus of this course will be slightly different according to the professional differences of each department, the structure and learning objectives are the same. Please refer to the 'Course Learning Objectives' section below this table. The course content of this course mainly focuses on the introduction of basic functions within the enterprise and the global business environment. Therefore, the scope of the course covers entrepreneurial characteristics, enterprise organization, business ethics, global economic system, enterprise leadership and teamwork, and basic functions within the enterprise, such as information technology, human resources, marketing management, production management, etc.
entries.本課程為個別指導之獨立研究，進度對應競賽時程與里程碑，安排如下：: This course is an independent study under individual guidance. The progress corresponds to the schedule and milestones of the competition, and the arrangement is as follows:
entries.本課程為全英語授課，講課以英語為主，也鼓勵學生在課堂活動中使用英語溝通。: This course is taught in English. The lectures are mainly in English, and students are also encouraged to use English to communicate in classroom activities.
entries.本課程為初級課程，銜接上學期課程，修完本課程後，學生應能:: This course is a primary course, which is connected to the last semester's course. After completing this course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程為國際政治經濟學基礎課程，將介紹國際政治經濟學的基礎主題。課程第一部分將介: This course is a basic course of international political economy, which will introduce the basic topics of international political economy. The first part of the course will introduce the disciplinary theory of international political economy and free trade that constitutes the modern international political and economic environment, so as to provide basic knowledge of entering international political economy. First of all, we will introduce the three major views of international political science and the two major schools, as well as important scholars of different schools, then discuss the origin of global trade, and explain the mercantarian policies of modern European countries and the conditions for turning to free trade.
entries.本課程為圖論的入門導論，旨在引導學生掌握圖論的基本概念、經典定理及其證明方法。課: This course is an introductory introduction to graphic theory, which aims to guide students to master the basic concepts of graphic theory, classical theorems and their proof methods. The course content is from shallow to deep. First, it introduces the basic definition and structure of the diagram (path, connectivity, tree), then introduces the algebraic point of view to explore the linear space related to the diagram, and finally discusses the factor decomposition and matching problems of the diagram. This course not only focuses on the derivation of mathematical theory, but also explores the practical combination applications such as tournament scheduling.
entries.本課程為地球科學系二年級必修課程，主要內容包括結晶幾何學、礦物物理、礦物化學、以: This course is a compulsory course for the second year of the Department of Earth Sciences. The main contents include crystallization geometry, mineral physics, mineral chemistry, and mineral photonetry.
entries.本課程為培養學生專業的英語演講與簡報能力而設計。課程循序漸進的帶領學生練習並熟悉: This course is designed to cultivate students' professional English speech and presentation skills. The course gradually leads students to practice and familiarize themselves with the necessary elements of English speech. The important topics of the course include: the organization and design of speech content, voice and intonation training, the effective use of multimedia assistance, the application of body language, etc. Another important goal of this course is to help students prepare for their academic or professional career after graduation. Science and technology-related briefings are the focus of the course. Students will have a lot of speech practice opportunities and learn how to evaluate their performance with their peers.
entries.本課程為基礎課程，修完本課程，學生應能:: This course is a basic course. After completing this course, students should be able to:
entries.本課程為學年課，屬中文系「詞章」領域之必修科目。旨在歷時地講授中國古典詩，並指導: This course is a school year course, which is a compulsory course in the field of "words and chapters" of the Chinese Department. It aims to teach Chinese classical poetry over time and guide the work, hoping that students can combine their actual creative experience, better understand the characteristics of poets' poems of all generations, master the methods of appreciating poetry, and have a clear concept of the history of the development of poetry, so as to deeply understand the characteristics and aesthetic interests of Chinese classical poetry.
entries.本課程為客家語文碩士班和客家社會及政策碩士班的共同必修課，對客家語言,社會文化,: This course is a common compulsory course for the Hakka Chinese Master's Class and the Hakka Social and Policy Master's Course. It provides a bird's-eye view introduction and research guidance on Hakka language, social culture, political and economic aspects.
entries.本課程為密集六天上課，必須全程參加才能通過。: This course is an intensive six-day class, and you must attend the whole process to pass.
entries.本課程為工作坊系列第二階段，聚焦於根據社會實踐企劃案，進行所定議題之社會實踐。: This course is the second stage of the workshop series, focusing on the social practice of the specified topic according to the social practice plan.
entries.本課程為工程數學、自動控制及動力學等各學科的整合運用，期望以日常使用的車輛為平台: This course is an integrated application of various disciplines such as engineering mathematics, automatic control and dynamics. It is expected to cultivate students' ability to apply mechanical theory to practical problems with daily vehicles as a platform. In the course, each important dynamic model will train students to write Python or Matlab code for simulation analysis to cultivate the following abilities:
entries.本課程為引導學生踏入研究世界的入門課程，旨在透過本系相關專業領域的引介，帶領學生: This course is an introductory course to guide students to the world of research. It aims to lead students to understand the appearance of academic research, understand the concerns of different fields and research orientations through the introduction of relevant professional fields in the department, and then clarify their research interests.
entries.本課程為教育部教學實踐研究計畫補助課程，修課同學無論參與計畫與否，均不會影響其學: This course is a subsidized course for the Teaching Practice Research Plan of the Ministry of Education. Whether students participate in the program or not, their semester grades will not be affected.
entries.本課程為期 16 週，採「基礎技術訓練」與「產業問題導向專題實作」兩階段進行。前: This course lasts for 16 weeks and is conducted in two stages: "Basic Technical Training" and "Industrial Problem-oriented Special Practice". Arrange two skill training cycles of "3 weeks of learning + 1 week of testing" in the first 8 weeks, focusing on building students' ability to use simulation tools, operate physical equipment and carry out basic integration. In the last 8 weeks, the PBL special topic will be launched. Students need to analyze problems, define goals, design systems, practice verification and display results according to actual industrial problems.
entries.本課程為期一學期。: This course lasts for one semester.
entries.本課程為物理系學生學習實驗物理的連貫四學期之自趨探索式基礎入門課程，其目的為透過: This course is a self-exploratory basic introductory course for students of the Department of Physics to study experimental physics for four semesters. The purpose is to exercise the body, mind, Taoism and art through systematic curriculum design, exploration and practice, and to build the basic methodology, engineering theory and technology, physical and mental regulation methods required for experimental physics research, so that they can be simplified, inherit the first and innovate, explore and innovate, and become a free citizen.
entries.本課程為獨立研究，以參與國立中央大學「2026 校務研究競賽——AI 校務治理實: This course is an independent research, with the participation in the "2026 School Research Competition - AI School Governance Practice Competition" of National Central University as the main axis, and guides students to actually apply AI and big data methods to school governance topics. Through one-on-one guidance and team work, students will be able to: (1) understand the core concepts of school research (IR), data governance and research ethics, and master the role and limitations of generative AI in school governance; (2) define answerable and influential research questions for one of the seven themes of the competition (school AI transformation, resilience and sustainable governance, intelligent learning guidance, intelligent research and development support, intelligent school research, Zhongda brand management, borderless campus services); (3) use Python/R, machine learning, large-scale language model (LLM) and AI-assisted analysis tools to complete data pre-processing, modeling, visualization and insight extraction; (4) Adhering to the spirit of "speech and empirical decision-making with evidence", put forward governance strategies and administrative suggestions that are both important, innovative, empirical and feasible; (5) Produce results reports, briefs and posters that meet the specifications of the competition, and complete the
entries.本課程為環境研究專業科目的入門課程，著重於廣泛與普遍的說明多項環境問題、成因與解: This course is an introductory course for environmental research. It focuses on a broad and universal explanation of many environmental problems, their causes and solutions, such as the depletion of energy and resources, air pollution, water pollution, waste treatment, ozone layer holes, global climate change, etc. It cultivates students' comprehensive concepts and guides students to understand the relationship between environment and human life and the importance of environmental protection.
entries.本課程為碩博班層級的認知心理學課程，著重於認知心理學在教育上的重要研究議題及發現: This course is a cognitive psychology course at the master's level, focusing on the important research topics and discoveries of cognitive psychology in education. In the course, the teacher will take the students to read the existing research results of cognitive psychology in education, including theories, research methods and research findings. At the same time, the teacher expects students to put forward your views and criticisms on the chapter reading. Students need to think carefully and be mentally prepared: spend a lot of time reading, summaries and experiences every week. The course is expected to let students understand the research results of cognitive psychology and how to apply them in the field of education; and how to feedback the theory of cognitive psychology in the field of education. It is better for students to have studied general psychology, experimental research method and cognitive psychology in the university department first. If the students do not have relevant background knowledge, please read the reference textbook by yourself first.
entries.本課程為統計科學之入門課程。從機率模型出發並輔以數學工具以及統計軟體R，本課程之: This course is an introductory course in statistical science. Starting from the probability model and supplemented by mathematical tools and statistical software R, the goal of this course is to enable students to have basic statistical knowledge and learn to deal with problems with statistical thinking.
entries.本課程為經濟學的入門課程，旨在引發同學對經濟學這門學問的學習興趣，並讓同學體認到: This course is an introductory course in economics, which aims to arouse students' interest in economics and make students realive that economics is a very practical science. This course is divided into two parts: "Individual Economics" and "General Economics". "Individual Economics" mainly explores how the decision-making of the household department and manufacturers and how their decision-making affects various market prices. "Total Economics" mainly explores how overall economic variables such as income level, general price level, interest rate and exchange rate are determined, and how the government's fiscal and monetary policies affect these economic variables. The course content of the last semester of this course is mainly individual economics, covering demand, supply, consumer behavior, market, international trade, manufacturer behavior and industrial organization. The course content of the next semester is mainly based on overall economics, covering national income, prices, unemployment rate, financial fundamental analysis tools, monetary system, international finance, government finance and monetary policy effect, and economic cycle and other issues.
entries.本課程為經濟系的總整課程，其教學目標在於協助認真修課的同學能符合管院「學習目標（: This course is a general course of the Department of Economics. Its teaching goal is to assist students who take the course seriously to meet the requirements of the "learning goals" of the management college. Students must take the stage for an "oral report" (the number of PPT pages is 28 to 32, of which at least 4 pages are diagrams or tables of numerical data), and rewrite the report topic into a final report (2,400 ~ 3,000 words) after the oral report. The theme of this report must be one of the three learning objectives: international outlook, sustainable development and management knowledge. In addition, two copies of the learning experience report (600 ~ 1,000 words) are required. The learning experience needs to be written for the report theme of other students, and it must be two learning goals other than the learning goals of the final report.
entries.本課程為財金系大二必修課程，本課程可讓同學了解基本財務管理理論與知識，可協助企業: This course is a compulsory course for the sophomore of the Department of Finance and Finance. This course can help students understand the basic financial management theory and knowledge, and can assist enterprises in analyzing the three major decisions faced by business development: investment decision-making, financing decision-making and dividend policy, so that students can understand how to evaluate these three major decisions and what evaluation tools are available. Students who have completed this course have the ability to evaluate the three major decision-making skills of company financial management.
entries.本課程為資管系碩士在職專班一門〇學分之必修課，課程目標在於透過本系各個不同研究專: This course is a compulsory course of 10 credits for the master's in-service special class of the Department of Asset Management. The goal of the course is to let students understand contemporary information management topics and enhance the understanding and interaction between teachers and students through full-time teachers in different research areas of the department.
entries.本課程為跨領域課程，鼓勵跨系的學習架構與內容需要重新思考調整設計，依據領域主題，: This course is a cross-field course. It encourages cross-departmental learning structure and content to rethink and adjust the design. According to the field theme, plan appropriate cross-departmental engineering problems, connect the compulsory courses of relevant departments with real engineering problems, and strengthen relevant practical courses to make the coherence between subjects clearer.
