It is divided into 7 thematic course groups, and each course group is guided by the teacher in charge to guide students to learn across domains.
entries.本課程為電機工程領域的核心必修課程，承接電路學I之基礎，教學方針旨在引導學生自直: This course is a core compulsory course in the field of electrical engineering. It undertakes the foundation of circuit science I. The teaching policy aims to guide students to cross from DC time domain analysis to more complex AC frequency domain category. The specific goal is to cultivate students with the following abilities:
entries.本課程為面向經濟系學生的資料分析，並將使用全英語授課。隨著近年生成式AI的發展，: This course is a data analysis for students of the Department of Economics, and will be taught in all English. With the development of generative AI in recent years, the learning method of data analysis has been transferred to the model. The purpose of this course is to let students know how to use modern methods (Python, API, cloud computing, machine learning) to conduct practical data analysis. This course will not delve too much into the details of mathematics or measurement. At the end of the semester, the student union will produce a data analysis report of their own selected topics, which can be used as materials for internship interviews and research institute applications as appropriate.
entries.本課程為高度實作導向之專題課，修課學生必須具備一定程度的 Python 與 MA: This course is a highly practice-oriented special course, and students must have a certain degree of Python and MATLAB programming ability. Students need to be able to write scripts independently, visualize data, and understand object-oriented concepts or matrix operations. Basic grammar will not be taught separately in class.
entries.本課程無指定教科書。授課教師將根據各單元主題提供學術閱讀資料、個案研究與相關文章: There is no designated textbook for this course. The teacher will provide academic reading materials, case studies and related articles according to the topics of each unit. Classroom handouts and presentations (PPT) will be prepared by teachers in advance and provided to students.
entries.本課程無指定教科書，採用自編講義。主要引導學生閱讀 NLP、嵌入式系統與邊緣運算: There are no designated textbooks for this course, and self-compiled handouts are used. It mainly guides students to read the core papers of top international conferences (such as IEEE, ACL, EMNLP, ISCA) in the field of NLP, embedded systems and edge computing (Edge AI).
entries.本課程無教科書，講義於課前以電子郵件傳送給修課學生。: There is no textbook for this course, and the handouts are sent to the students by email before class.
entries.本課程特別強調愛因斯坦1905年原始論文的完整架構，不僅介紹狹義相對論的運動學，: This course emphasizes the complete structure of Einstein's original paper in 1905. It not only introduces the kinematics of special relativity, but also deeply explores its application and unification in electromagnetism.
entries.本課程由兩個部分構成：台灣雖然與歐美社會有著不同的發展脈絡，但由於本土的障礙研究: This course consists of two parts: although Taiwan has a different development vein from that of European and American society, because the local research on obstacles not only started late, but the relevant obstacle welfare system also takes Europe and the United States as the main reference object. Therefore, first of all, the views of obstacle research in Europe and the United States will be introduced; secondly, it will be explored from the specific life situations faced by people with disabilities, such as employment, transportation, and sex, to present the views of Taiwanese society on people with disabilities. In addition, this course will cooperate with the Taoyuan Branch of the Xinlu Foundation to invite the children of Xinlu Academy to the campus of CUNG for integrated education.
entries.本課程由哲學所、法政所、經濟系共同開設經濟分析、哲學批判、政治學分析三個領域課程: This course is jointly opened by the Institute of Philosophy, the Institute of Law and Politics and the Department of Economics in three fields: economic analysis, philosophical criticism and political analysis. It plans a five-week individual course and a one-week integrated course, which are taught by three professors.
entries.本課程由大氣系全體老師共同授課，每週將分別由一位大氣系老師介紹其研究主題，發展現: This course is taught by all the teachers of the Department of Atmosphere. Every week, a teacher of the Department of Atmosphere will introduce its research topics, development status and challenges.
entries.本課程由許多「學習單元」組成，每一個「學習單元」包含以下四個步驟：: This course consists of many "learning units", and each "learning unit" includes the following four steps:
entries.本課程由講座和文章簡報組成, 學生必須為選定的期刊文章做口頭報告。: This course consists of lectures and article presentations, and students must make oral reports for selected journal articles.
entries.本課程的主要目標是介紹經濟預測方法, 學習基本的時間序列計量模型, 以及如何分析: The main objective of this course is to introduce economic forecasting methods, learn basic time series measurement models, and how to analyze data and apply them to business and economic issues. The basic skills that students will learn from this course include:
entries.本課程的主要目標是培養研究取向，並使學生熟悉研究方法的基本原理。特別是，本課程旨: The main goal of this course is to cultivate research orientation and familiarize students with the basic principles of research methods. In particular, this course aims to guide students to understand the basic concepts used in research, as well as scientific social research methods and ways. The course content covers the discussion of sampling techniques, research design and analysis methods. Other course objectives include:
entries.本課程的主要目的在於掌握智慧微電網管理結合電動車整合及其應用領域的最新發展趨勢，: The main purpose of this course is to master the latest development trend of smart microgrid management combined with the integration of electric vehicles and its application fields, and to identify potential research directions and key technologies to promote insights and innovative development in various fields from smart homes to smart cities, as well as industrial, commercial and consumer applications. We hope that this course can serve as an important reference for students at the level of the research institute, especially to help cultivate the professionals needed in the fields of emerging clean energy and transportation electrification in Taiwan.
entries.本課程的主體架構於下列五大軸下：: The main structure of this course is under the following five axes:
entries.本課程的前半段將介紹IDL的基本語法，讓學生先掌握一些IDL指令的實施方式，為後: The first half of this course will introduce the basic grammar of IDL, so that students can first master the implementation of some IDL instructions, and lay the foundation for space data processing and drawing in the second half. The second half of this course allows students to actually process space data and draw the data into graphics to increase students' actual code writing experience and understanding of space data. Students need to report on stage on the plan book, progress and final results of the special production in order to train students' production briefing, oral expression and improvisational ability, which are necessary conditions for future success in the workplace or academic unit.
entries.本課程的宗旨在提供學生一個進行跨領域討論的環境，讓來自不同領域的教師與學生就從哲: The purpose of this course is to provide students with an environment for cross-field discussions, so that teachers and students from different fields can have dialogues on topics from philosophy to natural and social sciences, and engineering.
entries.本課程的宗旨在於增進初學者的法文字彙，提昇其理解與分析能力，加強基本的文法觀念。: The purpose of this course is to improve the grammar vocabulary of beginners, improve their understanding and analysis ability, and strengthen the basic grammar concept.
entries.本課程的教學目標是對傳統漢字的豐富文化意涵加以推廣，讓它的使用者深刻體認到漢字在: The teaching goal of this course is to promote the rich cultural connotation of traditional Chinese characters, so that its users can deeply realize the unlimited development potential of Chinese characters in cultural creativity and cultural communication.
entries.本課程的教學目標為引導想踏進人工智慧相關領域的初學者們的學習方向。其中將從深度學: The teaching goal of this course is to guide the learning direction of beginners who want to step into the field of artificial intelligence. Starting from the establishment of the basic structural concepts and mathematical methods of the deep learning model, it will experience the guidance of python-related code, such as the most basic code structure and writing concept, the use of NumPy and Pandas, and the understanding and application of deep learning-related suites. Then guide learners step by step how to use colab to write and develop models, and understand the model specifications and data processing principles under the architecture of deep learning models, and finally establish basic deep learning models such as Multilayer Perceptron, convolutional neural networks, AutoEncoder, U-net and ResNet, and apply them to problems such as digital identification, regression problems and more complex image identification and segmentation.
entries.本課程的教學目標，在於系統性地介紹民法的理論結構，引導學生由淺入深、循序漸進地體: The teaching goal of this course is to systematically introduce the theoretical structure of civil law and guide students to experience the depth and practical value of civil law from shallow to deep and gradually.
entries.本課程的目標包含讓學生了解數位遊戲式學習研究領域的發展, 以及探討數位遊戲式學習: The goal of this course includes letting students understand the development of digital game learning research and exploring the relevant design principles of digital game learning. Students need to work into a digital game learning system in groups. (This course cooperates with the teaching practice research plan of the Ministry of Education to conduct relevant teaching research, and students will be invited to participate in the research.)
entries.本課程的目標是希望學生更好地理解穿戴式裝置在健康促進的最新技術。因此，修習本課程: The goal of this course is to help students better understand the latest technology of wearable devices in health promotion. Therefore, the background of master's students in this course can be wearable technology, biomedical experts or computer science and electronics engineers, or students who want to obtain novel research ideas and wearable technology training.
entries.本課程的目標是希望學生習得圖形識別的基本理論並具備實作的能力。: The goal of this course is to hope that students will learn the basic theory of graphic recognition and have the ability to practice.
entries.本課程的目標是提供圖挖掘和圖最佳化問題的廣泛介紹，包括基礎概念、方法、應用等。: The goal of this course is to provide a broad introduction to graphic mining and graphic optimization, including basic concepts, methods, applications, etc.
entries.本課程的目標是理解過渡金屬化學的基本概念和原理，包括過渡金屬元素的性質、電子結構: The goal of this course is to understand the basic concepts and principles of transition metal chemistry, including the properties, electronic structure, reaction mechanism and catalysis of transition metal elements. In addition, students will learn the application of transition metal chemistry in synthesis, reaction, catalysis, materials science and biological inorganic chemistry, and understand relevant technologies and applications.
entries.本課程的目標為利用一系列的實作課程與期末專題從基礎感測原理、電子電路、嵌入式系統: The goal of this course is to use a series of practical courses and final topics from basic sensing principles, electronic circuits, embedded systems, to the integrated application of the Internet of Things, so that non-information department students can have interdisciplinary knowledge and technology, and extend to the application field of intelligent energy saving.
entries.本課程的目的是介紹生物的基本原理，並瞭解人類跟其他生物之間的關係與責任，進而保護: The purpose of this course is to introduce the basic principles of living things and understand the relationship and responsibilities between human beings and other living things, so as to protect the living things on earth so that they can be sustainable and protected from human destruction.
entries.本課程的目的是培養學生掌握資訊與通訊科技，並以團隊合作方式去完成一個具體有用的資: The purpose of this course is to train students to master information and communication technology, and to complete a specific and useful information system in a teamwork way to meet the needs of modern enterprise management or personal information application.
entries.本課程的目的是教學生如何將已學過的數學和物理知識應用在進行真正的科學研究: The purpose of this course is to teach students how to apply the mathematical and physical knowledge they have learned to conduct real scientific research.
entries.本課程的設計係秉持下列幾項原則：: The design of this course adheres to the following principles:
entries.本課程的設計目的在於讓學生理解當代數位傳播對於大腦、思考、人類行為、社會影響、文: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the process of contemporary digital communication on the brain, thinking, human behavior, social impact, cultural cognition and construction; to understand the change and development of self under the influence of digital technology and community media, and how to affect their cognition, reading behavior, community interaction, information production and use; to understand various industries and phenomena such as marketing, content production, robots, fake news, implicit marketing, Internet celebrity, online military, wind direction, etc. under the influence of contemporary digital technology and community media; to learn how to use correct digital tools to prevent the harm of fake news, to judge facts and conduct fact search; to learn how to criticize and supervise the media; to learn how to participate in and practice civic discussions and democratic practice, and to achieve the cultivation and cultivation of digital communication literacy.
entries.本課程的設計目的，在於理解當代數位傳播對於大腦、思考、人類行為、社會影響、文化認: The design purpose of this course is to understand the process of contemporary digital communication on the brain, thinking, human behavior, social impact, cultural cognition and construction; to understand the change and development of oneself under the influence of digital technology and community media, and how it affects one's cognition, reading behavior, community interaction, information production and use; to understand various industries and phenomena such as marketing, content production, robots, fake news, indential marketing, Internet celebrities, online army, and wind direction under the influence of contemporary digital technology and community media; to learn how to check digital tools to prevent the harm of fake news, to interpret facts and conduct fact inquiries; to critically learn how to supervise the media; to learn how to participate in and practice citizen discussion and democratic practice, and to achieve the cultivation and cultivation of digital communication literacy.
entries.本課程的設計針對非管理本科EMBA學員所設計，期能為後續研習相關專業功能領域奠定: The design of this course is designed for non-management undergraduate EMBA students, which can lay a good foundation for the subsequent study of relevant professional functional fields.
entries.本課程的評量尺規：: The evaluation ruler of this course:
entries.本課程的進行，大致可區分為三部分。由於本課程假設同學均為首次接觸公共行政，因此第: The course can be roughly divided into three parts. Since this course assumes that students are in contact with public administration for the first time, we hope that students can read the designated text before class in the first part; in the actual classroom, it is divided into two parts: the first part is mainly taught by teachers; the second part is classroom discussion and participation in activities.
entries.本課程目標包括: (1)了解物聯網（Internet of Things, Io: The objectives of this course include: (1) understanding the components of the Internet of Things (IoT); (2) understanding the impact of the Internet of Things on society; (3) understanding the basic composition of embedded systems; (4) understanding basic network standards and hardware equipment; (5) understanding the architecture of the Internet of Things system from the perspective of software and hardware; (6) writing basic code for Internet of Things devices; (7) creating a simple Internet of Things system combined with cloud services.
entries.本課程目標包括：: The objectives of this course include:
entries.本課程目標在於使學習者理解勞資關係之基本理念與企業在人力資源管理上如何處理員工關: The goal of this course is to enable learners to understand the basic concept of labor relations and how enterprises deal with employee relations and the strategic choice of labor relations in human resources management. Contemporary management emphasizes the concept of sustainable operation of enterprises, and SDG has become the main axis of enterprise management. However, the management of Chinese enterprises has always neglected the importance of employees or labor relations, so it has faced serious challenges in human resources management today. Especially in the post-epidemic labor market, facing more uncertainty in the international market, including geopolitics, economic and trade competition, and the threat of war in different regions, makes enterprises need to ensure the stability of human resources under international competition. Therefore, the core of how to make employees and enterprises develop together and jointly create the competitiveness of enterprises lies in how to stabilize labor-management relations. This course tries to help learners master the key through theoretical and practical teaching, so that the foundation of students' self-labor relationship theory extends to the latest development of the interactive relationship, background environment and system between employers and their managers and employees in the organization, so as to improve the professional ability to engage in labor relations management, and has established a sustainable enterprise based on the culture of trust.
entries.本課程目標在於傳授基本的有機化學，第一章結構與鍵結開始，引領大二的同學認識基本的: The goal of this course is to teach basic organic chemistry. The first chapter begins with structure and bonding, leading sophomores to understand basic knowledge about organic compounds, so that they can be used flexibly in cooperative organic experiments. It is hoped that this basic course can give students a deeper understanding of the properties and reactivity of chemicals and organic solvents commonly used in experiments (a total of 16 weeks).
entries.本課程目標在於利用通訊實驗，協助學生驗證理論課程講授內容之理論，以期能相輔相成，: The goal of this course is to use communication experiments to assist students in verifying the theory of the theoretical course teaching content, so as to complement each other and cultivate students' ability to analyze data.
entries.本課程目標在於增進中文學術聽解和口語表達能力。學習內容包括一般及特定話題之詞語、: The goal of this course is to improve the ability of Chinese academic listening and oral expression. The learning content includes the usage of words, sentence patterns, steps and speech of general and specific topics. During the study period, class activities include listening, group and individual drills, group activities, online self-study and tutoring. Individual oral presentations are required at the end of the term.
entries.本課程目標在於幫助學生建立 Bayesian causal inference: The goal of this course is to help students establish the overall concept of Bayesian causal inference, understand its core concepts under the potential result structure, identify hypotheses and inference logic, and further master the advantages, limitations and practical challenges of the Bayesian method in causal inference; at the same time, it introduces its theoretical interpretation in neuroscience, as well as the development of modern methods in high-dimensional and non-parametric situations. Through this course, students will be able to systematically understand the important problems and research directions of Bayesian causal inference from the three levels of theory, method to application.
entries.本課程目標在於教授基礎的有機化學，第一章結構與鍵結開始，引領大二的同學認識基本的: The goal of this course is to teach basic organic chemistry. The first chapter begins with structure and bonding, leading sophomore students to understand the basic knowledge about organic compounds, so that they can be used flexibly in cooperative organic experiments. It is hoped that this basic course can give students a deeper understanding of the properties and reactivity of chemicals and organic solvents commonly used in experiments (16 weeks in total).
entries.本課程目標在藉由專題製作，讓同學整合過去企管學士(BBA)學位所要求課程中所學的: The goal of this course is to integrate the business management knowledge and information technology learned in the courses required by the Bachelor of Enterprise Management (BBA) degree in the past, and carry out the analysis, design and development of an information system to solve or improve real-world problems or meet the information needs of specific users through special production.
entries.本課程目標如下：: The objectives of this course are as follows:
entries.本課程目標是以PBL(問題導向)的方式，藉由海洋史的主題，學習歷史學的研究課題與: The goal of this course is to learn the research topics and research methods of history (history, historians, historical works, historical materials, historical interpretations, historical disputes, historical memory, digital historiography, AI and history, field investigation, global vision, public history) in a PBL (problem-oriented) way. It guides students to have a basic understanding of history, focusing on how to think about problems like a historian, collect information, read texts, judge historical materials, learn digital humanities learning and report writing, so as.
entries.本課程目標是培訓學生了解物聯網核心技術中的底層感測及區域網路技術；物聯網中層核心: The goal of this course is to train students to understand the underlying sensing and regional network technology in the core technology of the Internet of Things; the middle core network technology of the Internet of Things; the upper service platform technology and related international standards, and to cultivate students' practical development ability in the Internet of Things with experimental internship courses. The course will be through a series of practical technology courses to familiarize students with the operation of Internet of Things development equipment, and then apply the theory to the actual field, and introduce Problem-Based Learning (PBL) teaching methods to train students to learn independently. In the second part of this course, the PBL problem-oriented teaching method will be introduced to guide students to focus on specific and real problems, think and adopt appropriate solutions through practical problems and situations in life. Students show the results of teamwork in the final special competition through group discussion. Through this teaching method, students' creativity and practical ability can be enhanced. After completing this course, students will have the knowledge of Internet of Things architecture and related technologies, the ability to develop Internet of Things applications on Internet of Things devices, and the independent learning ability brought to students by the PBL teaching method.
entries.本課程目標是希望修課同學能在上課過程中，培養出以數學及科學方法解決工程問題的能力: The goal of this course is to hope that students can cultivate the ability to solve engineering problems with mathematical and scientific methods during the class, so as to improve the learning efficiency of civil engineering-related professional subjects.
entries.本課程目標是教授分析化學的基本原理，以及如何運用分析化學原理於日常生活或化學相關: The goal of this course is to teach the basic principles of analytical chemistry and how to apply the principles of analytical chemistry to daily life or chemistry-related fields, especially in life sciences and environmental sciences. Students can get ideal results as long as they read the key content of the textbook and do examples and exercises diligently.
entries.本課程目標有以下：: The objectives of this course are as follows:
entries.本課程目標為介紹新興替代科技如何應用於生醫研究與藥物開發，: The goal of this course is to introduce how emerging alternative technologies can be applied to biomedical research and drug development.
entries.本課程目標為介紹薄膜成長之相關基本物理原理及薄膜成長技術，此外並將嘗試介紹薄膜技: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic physical principles and technology of thin film growth. In addition, it will try to introduce the application of thin film technology in the industry. In addition to guiding students to have a preliminary concept of thin film physics and growth technology, it also allows students to understand its application in the industry.
entries.本課程目標為以人機互動領域方式，利用最新資訊科技來提升領域績效，因此問題需要針對: The goal of this course is to use the latest information technology to improve the performance of the field in the field of human-computer interaction. Therefore, the questions need to be aimed at specific fields. This course focuses on the field of information education and learning. This part contains the basic part of the traditional human-computer interaction course.
entries.本課程目標為使學生具備化學動力學中基礎到進階的核心概念。這些知識的掌握能幫助學生: The goal of this course is to equip students with the basic to advanced core concepts of chemical dynamics. Mastering this knowledge can help students optimize the reaction conditions in the experiment, understand the reaction mechanism, and go deep into building mathematical models and predicting the reaction results. These skills are crucial for the research of various sub-fields in chemistry. After studying this course, students will have a better foundation when carrying out special research projects. In addition, the knowledge of dynamics can also provide research guidance and direction for future process otimization and product development in the chemical industry.
entries.本課程目標為使學生習得有效管理工程專案不同階段及控制成本所需之知識和技能。進而培: The goal of this course is to enable students to acquire the knowledge and skills needed to effectively manage different stages of engineering projects and control costs. Then cultivate professionals who can effectively plan, estimate, budget, monitor and control the cost of the project, ensure that the project is completed on time and according to the budget, while maintaining the quality of the project and complying with relevant regulations and standards. Specific learning objectives include understanding the basic concepts and principles of cost management; learning to estimate various costs of construction projects, including labor, materials, equipment, labor, etc.; how to formulate effective budget items, fund allocation and time schedules for construction projects; monitoring the difference between the actual cost and budget of construction projects, and how to take appropriate measures to control and adjust costs; introducing risk assessment and emphasizing the role of cost management in the whole construction project management process; helping students apply what they have learned to practical situations and solving practical problems by analyzing construction project cases.
entries.本課程目標為向授課學生教授電離層資料同化的相關基礎知識。在學習資料同化方法的同時: The goal of this course is to teach students the basic knowledge of ionosphere data assimilation. While learning data assimilation methods, we also understand the relevant ionosphere patterns and increase the understanding of satellite data characteristics. And learn from computer and prepare special research reports, be familiar with code drawing, and learn to organize scientific research projects.
entries.本課程目標為學習線性代數的基本數學概念與運算技巧。: The goal of this course is to learn the basic mathematical concepts and calculation skills of linear algebra.
entries.本課程目標為讓學生習得地下水水流與汙染傳輸數值方法。: The goal of this course is to let students learn the numerical methods of groundwater flow and pollution transmission.
entries.本課程目標規劃為「讓同學們廣泛認識台灣的公益社會福利團體」，藉由邀請多家台灣的公: The goal of this course is to "let students widely know about Taiwan's public welfare social welfare organizations". By inviting a number of Taiwan's public welfare organizations to the school to give speeches, they will introduce the service content, founding origin, business model, etc. of their institutions, so that students can have an in-depth understanding of the professional service groups in the society. Through classroom questions and speaker interaction, as well as observing the questions asked by peers, we can understand the division of labor and differences between different institutions in serving society, and through the comparison between peers, students can transform their thinking about how to turn ideas into reality, and then make substantial contributions to society. Finally, through mid-term and end-of-term feedback and discussion, the ideas and thoughts shared by classroom speakers are transformed into their own perception of social service. Cultivate care for society, understand public issues, and understand the situation and needs of different groups in society.
entries.本課程目標：學習晶圓鍵合(wafer bonding)基礎理論及技術，進而在製造: The goal of this course: to learn the basic theory and technology of wafer bonding, and then make innovative applications in the field of manufacturing.
entries.本課程目的主要介紹應用在新興記憶儲存架構的記憶與儲存技術(例如：非揮發性記憶體、: The purpose of this course is mainly to introduce the memory and storage technologies applied to emerging memory storage architectures (for example: non-volatile memory, open-channel flash memory, stacked hard disk). Next, we will discuss the design challenges encountered by memory management, cache management and storage system management in these emerging memory storage architectures in these emerging memory storage architectures.
entries.本課程目的在協助學生建立薪酬管理的系統性知識與策略性思維，理解薪酬制度在吸引、激: The purpose of this course is to assist students to establish systematic knowledge and strategic thinking of remuneration management, and to understand the key role of the remuneration system in attracting, motivating and retaining talents. The course covers the core concepts of remuneration design, including internal consistency, external competitiveness, performance linkage, welfare system and compliance with laws and regulations, and explores the latest trends of remuneration fairness, transparency and all-round remuneration.
entries.本課程目的在培養台灣新一代的公司法學以及企業組織法學人材. 藉由系統性的學習,: The purpose of this course is to cultivate a new generation of corporate law and corporate organization legal talents in Taiwan. Through systematic learning, students can effectively grasp the whole process of the beginning, development and dissolution of various enterprise organizations (such as sole proprietorships, various partnerships and various types of companies, etc.). And focus on the research and discussion on the key role of various enterprise organizations in the modern social industrial economy in the 21st century.
entries.本課程目的在於介紹數據科學，教導學生如何從資料收集、管理、統整分析至最終的圖表呈: The purpose of this course is to introduce data science and teach students how to go from data collection, management, consolidation analysis to final chart presentation. In addition to the basic statistical analysis instructions, the course will also introduce a variety of machine learning algorithms and lead students to use R and Python to analyze biomedical data.
entries.本課程目的在於使學生了解統計方法於各領域實務應用之情形，課程中透過分組實作與案例: The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the practical application of statistical methods in various fields. In the course, students' ability and experience in processing and analyzing real data are cultivated through group practice and case analysis.
entries.本課程目的在於建立博士班學生的個體經濟理論基礎。前半段主題為消費者理論，內容包括: The purpose of this course is to establish the theoretical foundation of individual economy for doctoral students. The theme of the first half is consumer theory, including preferences, consumer choice, classical demand theory and aggregate demand. The second half discusses the theory of production and the choice of uncertainty.
entries.本課程立意以「表演藝術」作為社會實踐與人文批判的教學策略，透過業界專業師資的引進: This course intends to take "performing arts" as the teaching strategy of social practice and humanistic criticism. Through the introduction of professional teachers in the industry, it tries to establish a practical teaching system for performing arts to guide students in the practice of artistic creation.
entries.本課程簡介當代的語言研究，不僅幫助學習者破解關於語言的迷思，學習者可以認識在資訊: This course introduces contemporary language research, which not only helps learners solve the myths about language, but also understands the application and influence of language technology under the cooperation of information science, brain science and linguistics. The teaching of this course can be divided into two parts:
entries.本課程結合國家太空中心（TASA）發展願景與第一線從業人員之實務經驗，帶領學生探: This course combines the development vision of the National Space Center (TASA) and the practical experience of front-line practitioners to lead students to explore global space science and technology trends and forward-looking applications. It is expected to cultivate students' practical ability to connect with the needs of the space industry across fields, understand market dynamics and social promotion and communication through themes such as "space industry and science and technology application", "industry trends and social communication" and "practitical topics and group discussions".
entries.本課程結合地理資訊系統的空間資料分析技術，以及永續發展與跨領域相關議題。使學生透: This course combines the spatial data analysis technology of geographic information system, as well as sustainable development and cross-field related issues. Students can integrate spatial information of different scales through geographic information tools, including government open data and scientific research data, establish a spatial database, and conduct data analysis, digitization and display through a perfect process, so as to complete an independent topic. The course includes computer practical content, including GIS geographic information system and SQL language. The relevant technology can be applied to green energy planning, environmental governance, resource exploration, urban planning and other fields.
entries.本課程結合理論與實務，兼顧政策脈絡與技術發展，協助學生具備在未來數位國安環境中，: This course combines theory and practice, takes into account the policy context and technological development, and assists students to have the comprehensive ability to actively identify, respond to and manage information risks in the future digital national security environment, and become the capital security talents needed by society and the country.
entries.本課程結合英語專題探究與數位故事創作，透過有趣、互動且貼近生活的主題，引導學生以: This course combines English thematic exploration and digital story creation to guide students to explore their concerns and interests in English through interesting, interactive and close-to-life themes. The course emphasizes the application of practical English and advanced expression ability. Students will learn how to think about topics, collect and sort out information, conduct research and interviews, establish a story structure, and use multi-modal methods such as text, images, sound and video to present special results.
entries.本課程結束時，你將能夠：: At the end of this course, you will be able to:
entries.本課程經由課堂講授以及實習操作學習進階的GIS理論及分析方法。具備針對實務或研究: This course learns advanced GIS theory and analysis methods through classroom teaching and internship operation. Have a GIS analysis technology that can develop potential or even feasible for practical or research plans. This course will use GIS software for teaching, and students will learn how to use GIS software to process and analyze spatial data.
entries.本課程聚焦十五世紀起至十八世紀末歐洲藝術史，配合本季近代藝術特展及相關學術活動，: This course focuses on the history of European art from the 15th century to the end of the 18th century. In conjunction with this season's special exhibition of modern art and related academic activities, it explores the formation and development of modern European art from the aspects of historical stages, geographical differences and cross-cultural exchanges. The course is divided into four themes: "Modern Art History: Staged, Regionalization and Issues of the Times", "Art and Social History of the Renaissance", "Type Theory of Modern Painting" and "Erusian Cultural Encounter and Cross-Cultural Display". It explores the art history topics of major European schools (Italy, Spain, France, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc.) during this period, as well as the case studies of representative artists (Botticelli, Caravaggio, Velázquez, Zurbarán, Rubens, Vermeer, Watteau, Fragonard, Chardin, and Reynolds). It also expands international important modern art exhibitions and the legacy of modern art in contemporary works of art.
entries.本課程聚焦於 1980 年代至今繪畫的美學流變與文化意涵。在科技進展與全球化的脈: This course focuses on the aesthetic rheological and cultural connotation of painting from the 1980s to the present. Under the vein of scientific and technological progress and globalization, explore how painting faces the challenges of new media, fields and mechanisms, and analyzes its role in contemporary art and digital wave. With the impact of modernism and conceptual art, painting no longer seems to be at the core of artistic practice and discussion, but in fact, it still develops in parallel with a variety of appearances and contemporary visual culture. Contemporary painting is no longer a single, closed and purely autonomous medium, and can no longer include its heterogeneous production methods with standard definitions or concepts; it often crosses the established framework and links with non-traditional materials, technology, space and audiences, and thus participates in daily life and social actions. Through the case analysis of East Asia and the West, this course will explore how contemporary painting practice deals with individual life experience and responds to complex social and cultural issues. The main topics of the course include: humanism and reproduction of tradition of painting, spiritual and philosophical thinking of painting, morphology of painting and subjectivity, relationship between painting and historical narrative, competition and dialogue between painting and photography and new media, as well as the expansion field and display circulation of painting.
entries.本課程聚焦於分析化學於產業排放與溫室氣體監測之應用，強調從「量測技術」延伸至「產: This course focuses on analyzing the application of chemistry in industrial emissions and greenhouse gas monitoring, and emphasizes the integration ability from "measurement technology" to "industrial practice and net zero management".
entries.本課程聚焦於智慧製造技術在 PCB / IC載板產業的實務落地應用。邀請多位來自: This course focuses on the practical application of intelligent manufacturing technology in the PCB/IC carrier board industry. Invite many teachers from the industry to conduct practical sharing and guide students to gain an in-depth understanding of the whole picture of smart factories from strategic planning to technology implementation.
entries.本課程聚焦於社會當中的關鍵風險議題，並結合大數據等科技應用，引導學生從多元視角剖: This course focuses on key risk issues in society, and combines big data and other scientific and technological applications to guide students to analyze the causes of these risks from multiple perspectives, and learn how to effectively manage and respond to these risks.
entries.本課程聚焦於近期各類生物醫學影像技術之研究發表，透過精讀與討論最新文獻，深入了解: This course focuses on the recent research and publication of various biomedical imaging technologies. Through careful reading and discussion of the latest literature, we can deeply understand the principle, application and role of imaging technology in basic research and clinical diagnosis. Students will cultivate critical reading skills and improve scientific expression and discussion skills. 1) Understand the latest development of various biomedical imaging technologies, 2) cultivate the ability to read and analyze international journal papers, 3) improve students' ability to publish and discuss research in public, 4) explore the application of imaging technology in disease diagnosis, treatment evaluation and translation medicine.
entries.本課程聚焦法國思想家莫里斯·布朗肖（Maurice Blanchot）的「他者」: This course focuses on the "other" philosophy of Maurice Blanchot, a French thinker. Unlike traditional ethics, which regards others as objects of understanding, Brownshaw argues that others are "absolute external" and "unreachable strangeness". However, this kind of unrecognizable other will cause the possibility of understanding, which will lead to the cancellation of the presence of others? Or, create the actual presence of others? This double trickery will be the core topic discussed in this course.
entries.本課程聚焦策略管理幾個重要議題，包含外在環境分析、內部能力分析及企業各層級管理意: This course focuses on several important topics of strategic management, including external environment analysis, internal capability analysis and management implications at all levels of the enterprise. The knowledge covered is necessary for enterprise operation and management. Through the analysis and discussion of different cases, you can gain an in-depth understanding of various strategic concepts and apply them to business practice in the workplace.
entries.本課程致力於營造一個富有啟發性且具挑戰性的學習環境。學生將學習如何設計與實作程式: This course is committed to creating an inspiring and challenging learning environment. Students will learn how to design and practice code to solve practical problems, and lay the foundation for further learning of program design and software development in the future.
entries.本課程與 \"ME5205/SA5022 智慧製造實作與專題(I)\" 採用共同: This course and "ME5205/SA5022 Intelligent Manufacturing Practice and Special Topic (I)" adopt a common practical topic and practical field; but the implementation mode starts from problem-oriented learning and design thinking respectively. It is recommended that students choose ME5205 or SA5022 at the same time.
entries.本課程著重古典詞作的欣賞和分析，以深入淺出的方式，結合生活情感經驗，探索人性的真: This course focuses on the appreciation and analysis of classical words. In an in-depth and shallow way, combined with life and emotional experience, it explores the real level of human nature, so that students can resonate and understand from the bottom of their hearts, which can further arouse students' interest in learning. Only by crossing the barriers of words can we be truly moved. In addition to clarifying the cultural background and historical context of the words of the Northern Song Dynasty, it is also expected that students can also develop the care and consciousness of life, and think about the meaning of personal life, in order to establish a mature outlook on life.
entries.本課程著重在作業主題的網路搜尋及報告，所以採取每週分組輪流上台報告，不進行期中及: This course focuses on the online search and reporting of homework topics, so the weekly groups take turns to report on the stage, and the mid-term and final written exams are not conducted. The results of the semester are mainly based on the content of the rotating reports, as well as the discussion and attendance in the usual classes.
entries.本課程著重於聽力與口說的訓練。期望修課學生能用基本生詞和語法自我介紹，並能中文進: This course focuses on listening and speaking training. It is expected that students can introduce themselves with basic new words and grammar, and can conduct basic daily conversations in Chinese.
entries.本課程藉演講與實作，修課學生必須完成每週實習以及作業，包含文獻閱讀與GIS實作。: In this course, through speech and practice, students must complete weekly internships and homework, including literature reading and GIS practice. There will be a classroom test and a semester plan in the course. The plan must be reported orally and submitted in writing before the end of the term.
entries.本課程藉由實際案例的分享，從軟體工程的歷史、過程的演進、專案的流程規劃、系統需求: Through the sharing of actual cases, this course allows students to understand the difficulties of software development and learn how to design high-quality and efficient software from the history of software engineering, the evolution of the process, the process planning of the project, system requirements, risk management, software design architecture, unit and automated testing, etc.
entries.本課程藉由課程講授、討論、與統計軟體(SPSS、AMOS、JASP)操作，介紹一: This course introduces some basic concepts of data analysis methods and models through the teaching, discussion and operation of statistical software (SPSS, AMOS, JASP). The content of the course is based on the principle of students' graduation thesis.
entries.本課程藉由論文的研讀、批判與反思，來達成以下目標：: This course achieves the following goals through the study, criticism and reflection of the thesis:
entries.本課程藉由邀請多家台灣的公益團體蒞校進行演講，介紹他們機構的服務內容、創立緣起、: This course invites a number of Taiwanese public welfare organizations to give speeches in the school, introducing the service content, founding origin, business model, etc. of their institutions, so that students can have an in-depth understanding of professional service groups in the society. By listening to the speech, students can understand how professional social welfare groups in society turn ideas into reality and make substantial contributions to society. In addition, through the interaction with the lecturer in the student curriculum, students can actually reflect on and understand a social welfare institution, which is expected to give students a deeper understanding of the content and nature of service learning.
entries.本課程要求同學於課餘時間自行分組排練，以下表格所列時間，包含上課以及額外開放修課: This course requires students to rehearse in groups in their spare time. The time listed in the following table includes the rehearsal period of classes and additional open courses for students to use the black box theater, and the time of stage performances, etc., and are regarded as formal classes.
entries.本課程規劃學生參與各項講座與活動，並定期於學校進行環境清潔，藉此培養學生的責任感: This course plans students to participate in various lectures and activities, and regularly clean the environment in the school, so as to cultivate students' sense of responsibility and public service spirit, and at the same time improve students' awareness of attention and participation in public space maintenance.
entries.本課程討論恆星內部結構以及外層大氣。課程首先簡單介紹恆星的物理量及觀測手段，然後: This course discusses the internal structure and outer atmosphere of stars. The course first briefly introduces the physical quantities and observation methods of stars, and then discusses radiation transfer, emission, absorption and other phenomena related to the action of electromagnetic waves and matter, radiation transfer equations, gas state equations, spectral line formation, static equilibrium inside stars, material distribution, thermonuclear reactions, etc.
entries.本課程討論的內容包括板塊動力學和地殼形變。主要以講授為主，課程中則以專題研討的方: The contents of this course include plate dynamics and crustal deformation. It is mainly based on lectures, and the course is interspersed with special seminars. We will discuss different topics of geodynamics.
entries.本課程討論與講授並重，一則由修課同學報告指定進度的教材，再由其他修課同學提出質詢: Discussion and teaching in this course are as important as teaching. On the one hand, the course students report the textbooks of the designated progress, then other students ask questions and conduct classroom discussions, and finally the teacher in charge of the course will comment. The course requirements are as follows: (1) The content of the textbook shall be reported by the designated students every week, and the principle of reading one or two Chinese literature or an English academic book chapter every week. The responsible students must write an abstract for each paper and send it to the teacher and each student before class; (2) Write 150-200 words of after-class experience in the LMS course discussion area of the course, so that students can summarize the classroom discussion, gain concrete ideas, and strengthen mutual communication and reflection; (3) Write an academic report on the basis of various theoretical concepts taught in the classroom, or group homework, and submit it at the end of the semester.
entries.本課程討論與講授並重，課程要求如下：: This course is as important as discussion and teaching. The course requirements are as follows:
entries.本課程討論資產傳承與稅務規劃，高資產人士認為還年輕或身體健康，或考慮到家庭狀況、: This course discusses asset inheritance and tax planning. High-worth people think that they are still young or healthy, or postpone planning in consideration of family conditions, distribution issues, etc. However, if you are not prepared in advance, you may encounter some common situations in practice:
entries.本課程設計希望透過「服務」，能讓學生察覺日常生活中的在地問題，並且運用科學知識鏈: This course design hopes that through "service", students can perceive local problems in daily life, and use scientific knowledge to link local services, deeply understand the public issues around them, and then start to improve and solve problems.
entries.本課程設計得讓學生自行尋找專題指導教授，針對特定主題進行研究與實作，使學生瞭解相: This course is designed to allow students to find special guidance professors by themselves, conduct research and practice on specific topics, so that students can understand relevant subject knowledge and special research methods and steps, and at the same time cultivate students' ability to practice information systems.
entries.本課程設計旨在運用經濟理論與方法來協助管理階層解決經營決策問題。: This course is designed to use economic theories and methods to assist managers in solving business decision-making problems.
entries.本課程設計為全學年西班牙文的上學期之3學分，採取英、西文雙語教材、上學期以中文授: This course is designed for 3 credits in the last semester of Spanish for the whole academic year. It adopts English and Spanish bilingual textbooks, teaches in Chinese in the last semester, and matches the Chinese textbooks provided by teachers in the classroom. Last semester, I was introduced to pronunciation theory and studied with thematic chapters of the course book.
entries.本課程設計理念以「環境即教育」為核心，透過系所空間的日常維護，引導學生實踐公民素: The design concept of this course takes "environment is education" as the core, and guides students to practice civic literacy through the daily maintenance of the department space.
entries.本課程課堂演講與練習中所使用之投影片、講義或課程規定、作業、參考資料皆會以PDF: The videos, handouts or course regulations, homework and reference materials used in the classroom speeches and exercises of this course will be online in PDF file format, and you can download and use them by yourself. Please refer to the teaching auxiliary website for the website.
entries.本課程講授內容主要分為二部分，第一部分先對篆文以前的字體：殷商甲骨文、兩周金文、: The teaching content of this course is mainly divided into two parts. The first part first studies the characters before the seal text: Yin Shang oracle writing, two Zhou Jinwen, Warring States simple silk, seal, currency, stone carving and other ancient characters, so that students can have a preliminary understanding of the historical content, font structure, writing style, etc. of ancient characters at various stages. In the second part, by mastering ancient writings, we will deeply discuss the social culture after the two weeks of Yin and Shang, so as to understand the source of Chinese culture. This course hopes to convey the relevant knowledge of mastering ancient texts in both methodology and underground materials, and at the same time help students lay the foundation for studying and governing traditional literature.
entries.本課程講授現代分子醫學知識, 著重基礎知識與臨床醫學應用原理, 增強學生對醫學相: This course teaches modern molecular medicine, focusing on basic knowledge and clinical medical application principles, and enhances students' understanding of medical-related fields.
entries.本課程講義、單篇論文及其他相關資料。: Handouts, single papers and other relevant materials of this course.
entries.本課程講述為主，並播放本人針對權力分立、基本權保障、正當法律程序的錄製影本，供同: This course is mainly about the story, and broadcasts my own recorded film on the separation of powers, the guarantee of fundamental rights and the legitimate legal process for students to watch, and the students will discuss in groups of three and write group reports.
entries.本課程講述金融衍生性商品定價所需的數學模型與評價理論。首先介紹離散的二項樹模型，: This course describes the mathematical models and evaluation theories required for the pricing of financial derivative goods. First, introduce the discrete binary tree model, and then expand to the continuous random dynamic model. In combination with the theory of stochastic calculus and no arbitrage, we will discuss asset pricing and risk management methods under the risk-neutral measure.
entries.本課程透過C程式語言帶領學生熟悉程式設計，並且逐步培養學生的邏輯思考與問題解決能: This course leads students to become familiar with program design through C program language, and gradually cultivates students' logical thinking and problem-solving ability, laying a good foundation for future advanced courses and practical applications.
entries.本課程透過有系統的基本詞彙、會話練習和聽說讀寫作等語文活動，發展學生自學客家話的: This course develops students' ability and interest in self-studying Hakka language through systematic basic vocabulary, conversation exercises, listening, speaking, reading and writing, and leads students to read short articles in Hakka language to experience the rich and unique culture of the Hakka family.
entries.本課程透過有系統的拼音、基本詞彙、句子、情境會話等練習，發展學生自學客家話的能力: This course develops students' ability and interest in self-studying Hakka dialect through systematic pinyin, basic vocabulary, sentences, situational conversation and other exercises, and allows students to appreciate the rich and unique culture and way of thinking of Hakka culture through the relevant content of Hakka culture.
entries.本課程透過英文電影、影集、訪談及多元影音教材，引導學生接觸真實英語情境，培養中級: This course guides students to contact real English situations and cultivate intermediate English listening comprehension ability through English movies, photo albums, interviews and multiple audio-visual textbooks. Students will learn to identify common English expressions in daily life, be familiar with different accents, speed of speech and dialogue content in context, and strengthen their mastery of key information, reasoning ability and note-taking skills through listening strategy training.
entries.本課程適合已修習微積分與線性代數的同學(被擋修的同學可索取密碼卡)，並可作為進一: This course is suitable for students who have studied calculus and linear algebra (students who have been blocked can request password cards), and can be used as a theoretical basis for further study of differential geometry, general relativity, image processing, and manifold learning and other topics.
entries.本課程適合研究生，針對研究方向，進行論文涉獵與閱讀、理論推導、實驗操作。: This course is suitable for graduate students to carry out thesis hunting and reading, theoretical derivation and experimental operation according to the research direction.
entries.本課程選介數部法國二十世紀小說，引導學生閱讀作品原本，並熟悉小說批評方法，進而培: This course selects several French novels of the 20th century, guides students to read the original works, and is familiar with the criticism method of novels, so as to cultivate the ability to appreciate literary works and discuss topics.
entries.本課程選讀五四新文學以降至1949年間具代表性之作家作品，透過精讀文學經典，提升: This course selects the works of representative writers from the May Fourth New Literature to 1949. Through the careful reading of literary classics, it improves the aesthetic perception of appreciation and takes a look at the development of modern Chinese literature. On the one hand, understand the relationship between the writer's life and creation, explore the realistic context of the construction text, and on the other hand, appreciate the text in depth, in order to enhance logical thinking and language expression ability while enjoying the artistic ingenuity of the work.
entries.本課程邀請不同領域的學術及業界專家，透過演講分享最新研究趨勢及成果。引導學生了解: This course invites academic and industry experts in different fields to share the latest research trends and results through speeches. Guide students to understand the trend of statistical research in various fields, broaden their academic horizons and inspire different research directions.
entries.本課程邀請來自產業界、政府機關及學術研究單位之專業講師進行專題演講，內容涵蓋機械: This course invites professional lecturers from industry, government agencies and academic research units to give special lectures, covering the latest development trends of mechanical engineering-related industries, intelligent manufacturing, automation technology, artificial intelligence application, sustainable energy, green manufacturing, product research and development and engineering practice and other important topics. Through the lecturer's sharing of practical experience, industry cases and the current situation of technological development, students can understand the application mode and future development direction of mechanical engineering in different industries.
entries.本課程邀請各領域專家進行專題演講與心得分享，以擴展參與學生專業知識與涵養。: This course invites experts in various fields to give special speeches and share experiences to expand the professional knowledge and cultivation of participating students.
entries.本課程邀請國內外學者發表其最新研究。: This course invites scholars at home and abroad to present their latest research.
entries.本課程重在課程、教學與評量的設計，強調融合知識、技能與情意的教學，協助培訓師培生: This course focuses on the design of curriculum, teaching and evaluation, emphasizing the teaching that integrates knowledge, skills and emotions, and assists trainers in cultivating the professional ability of teaching methods in Chinese textbooks. This course will guide teacher training students to carry out literacy-oriented course design, evaluation and regulation formulation and practice, and the demonstration of reading strategies of different types of styles, and invite on-site professional Chinese liberal arts teachers and experts and scholars in related fields to carry out community cooperation, course observation and discussion, so as to meet the future teaching trend, so as to give teachers and students with sufficient ability and correct attitude to face the changes in the teaching site of the new curriculum.
entries.本課程重視學生自身的閱讀、思考、判斷與論述能力。學生得依作業性質適度使用生成式: This course focuses on students' own reading, thinking, judgment and discussion skills. Students can moderately use generative AI as a learning or writing aid according to the nature of the homework, but they should not replace their own reading, thinking and argumentation with the content generated by AI. Where the homework requires students to put forward personal understanding, analysis or reflection, the relevant content should be completed by the students themselves. If the use of generative AI has a substantial impact on the content of the work, its use should be properly explained in accordance with relevant academic norms. All cited literature and related materials should be checked by the students themselves, and the students are responsible for the correctness of their contents.
entries.本課程重點將著重於作業研究中隨機存貨理論、等候線理論、非線性規劃以及數值運算。藉: This course will focus on random inventory theory, waiting line theory, nonlinear planning and numerical operation in operation research. By combining theoretical derivation with computer numerical calculation in this course, it is expected that students can use the theory taught in the course with the writing of computer programs to understand how to apply homework research to solve practical problems.
entries.本課程針對EMBA學生所設計，透過實務公司個案來協助學生瞭解財務會計體系之運作及: This course is designed for EMBA students to help students understand the operation of the financial accounting system and the impact of various operations, investment and financing activities of enterprises on financial statements and the financial reporting environment through practical company cases. This course will introduce the development of corporate governance, ESG information disclosure and its relationship with financial reporting. This course also introduces the strategic cost system and the performance evaluation system. The goal is to equip students with the knowledge of analyzing the internal management effectiveness and external business performance of the enterprise.
entries.本課程針對具有生醫背景的碩士與博士研究生設計，旨在培養學生進階的文獻閱讀、批判性: This course is designed for master's and doctoral students with a medical background, aiming to cultivate students' advanced literature reading, critical thinking and scientific communication skills. The course invites industry, government, academic and research experts from the field of biomedicine to give speeches every week. Through experts sharing the latest research results and application development, students will learn how to combine academic theory with practical applications.
entries.本課程開課目的是培養修課學生了解管制藥品與藥物濫用現況，透過臨床、民間團體、法務: The purpose of this course is to train students to understand the current situation of drug control and drug abuse. After studying through the professional fields of clinical, civil society, legal correction organs, translation medicine and psychological counseling, they actually participate in the propaganda and medical research of local local governments and school organs to solve addiction and drug addiction, and reflect on the direction of their future learning in the professional field in the process of learning. This course will first learn the correct knowledge of the correct drug use and drug abuse, combine the visit of the investigation bureau or the association and the pharmaceutical factory, and then conduct the practical operation in groups in a practical way, so as to achieve the ability of independent thinking, mutual assistance and cooperation, and cultivate the humanistic literacy of service and care. All courses of static courses, visit itineraries, related volunteer learning and social service learning practice in the whole process of this course will be assisted in applying - college students' study passport (including basic service learning courses, off-campus services, life intelligence learning and humanities and arts learning)
entries.本課程除分別探討相關思考框架，介紹相關制度，也會安排個案企業組織參訪，並且及請政: In addition to exploring the relevant thinking framework and introducing the relevant system separately, this course will also arrange for individual enterprise organizations to visit, and invite government authorities and experts to give special lectures to integrate them into practical analysis.
entries.本課程除提供做為一位機械工程師所應具備之電子學知識外，同時也是踏入「電路設計」工: In addition to providing the knowledge of electronics that a mechanical engineer should have, this course is also a basic advanced course to step into the work of "circuit design". This course is planned for one semester, covering the basic and advanced applications of electronic circuits.
entries.本課程除課堂講授外，亦包含分組實作與專題報告。修課學生將依課程進度分組完成當週實: In addition to classroom lectures, this course also includes group practice and special reports. Students will complete the weekly internship goals in groups according to the course progress, and learn basic telemetry data processing, image reading and applied analysis methods. At the end of the semester, each group needs to complete an oral report and a written thematic report to integrate what they have learned in the classroom and show their understanding of the application of telemetry data. Irregular classroom tests will be arranged during the school period to check students' mastery of basic concepts and course content.
entries.本課程需要細讀古文，並進行文本分析與申論寫作，較適合「願意思考、討論、敢於課堂發: This course requires careful reading of ancient texts, text analysis and thesis writing, which is more suitable for students who are "willing to think, discuss and dare to speak in class".
entries.本課程預計全班修課同學每人擇定一個公共政策個案進行研討，個案主題將於第一週公布，: In this course, it is expected that each student in the class will choose a public policy case to discuss. The topic of the case will be announced in the first week, and a two-week oral semester report will be made on this case. The whole class will learn, observe, discuss and stir up, and finally form a written semester report to be submitted before the final exam.
entries.本課程預計將包含下列主題：: This course is expected to include the following topics:
entries.本課程預計邀請唐獎獲獎或提名人等國際永續學者進行演講，分享國際最新永續議題新知。: This course is expected to invite international sustainable scholars such as Tang Award winners or nominees to give speeches and share new knowledge on the latest international permanent issues. This course is also a compulsory course for students in the decarbonization course. It is mainly guided by the supervising professors to guide students to read academic papers in various related fields, and to train students' ability to read professional papers and professional briefings.
entries.本課程預計邀請永續學者進行演講，分享國際最新永續議題新知。本課程為綠能學程學生必: This course is expected to invite permanent scholars to give speeches and share the latest international permanent issues and new knowledge. This course is a compulsory course for students of green energy courses. It is mainly guided by guiding professors to guide students to read academic papers in various related fields, and to train students' ability to read professional papers and professional briefings.
entries.本課程預計邀請相關專業的專家與學者，進行經驗分享。本課程為學生必修課程，主要由各: This course is expected to invite experts and scholars from relevant majors to share experiences. This course is a compulsory course for students. It is mainly guided by instructors to guide students to read academic papers in various related fields, and to train students' ability to read professional papers and professional presentation.
entries.本課程首先介紹基本概念，包括勞動權的意義及政府角色；接著介紹勞動保護制度概況，包: This course first introduces the basic concepts, including the meaning of labor rights and the role of the government; then introduces the overview of the labor protection system, including labor inspection, occupational disaster compensation, maternal protection (gender work equality), etc.; in addition, important labor policy issues are selected for in-depth discussion, including overwork, platform economy, green work and ESG issues, foreign migration, family care and long-term care arrangements.
entries.本課程首先回顧基準的理性預期均衡模型。在此類模型中，交易者為價格接受者，且擁有不: This course first reviews the rational expectation equilibrium model of the benchmark. In this model, traders are price recipients, have different information, and can submit demand functions at each transaction point. On this basis, this course will introduce the modern market microstructure theory, including the order-driven market and the quotation-driven market. The course focuses on explaining how information is reflected in prices, how different trading mechanisms affect market liquidity and price efficiency, and how informed traders, liquidity traders and market creators interact under different market structures.
entries.本課程鼓勵學生結合理論與實務，為未來投入植物生技產業或學術研究奠定扎實基礎。: This course encourages students to combine theory and practice to lay a solid foundation for future investment in the plant biotechnology industry or academic research.
entries.本課程，主要的目標在培養師資生具備於生生用平板的教室內，進行教學能力。: The main goal of this course is to cultivate the teaching ability of teachers and students in the classroom with students' tablets.
entries.本週乃至之後連續兩週將焦點放在兩兩國家間的外交折衝，其目的均在抗衡德國的擴張。為: This week and for the next two consecutive weeks, the focus will be on the diplomatic divide between the two countries, the aim of which is to counterbalance Germany's expansion. In order to curb Germany's expansion outside the continent, Britain and France began a series of consultations and colonial cooperation to fight against Germany together.
entries.本週正式進行小組組隊（3~4人一組），討論如何將個人的創意整合成一個具商業價值的: This week, group teams (3-4 people per group) will be officially held to discuss how to integrate personal ideas into a "group project" with commercial value. Learn Branching Strategy, Pull Request (PR) and Team Code Review processes.
entries.本門課是文學院學士班課程，亦為「藝術史跨域實踐」領域專長模組之基礎課程。欲修本門: This course is a bachelor's course of the College of Arts, and it is also the basic course of the specialized module in the field of "cross-domain practice of art history". If you want to take this course, please be sure to attend the first class to understand the content and requirements of the course. If you want to get a password card, please email the teacher (cchsieh@ncu.edu.tw) first.
entries.本門課目標為使學生了解異相催化的基本知識，其中包含反應進行時的表面化學、動力學、: The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the basic knowledge of heterophase catalysis, which includes surface chemistry, kinetics, and related techniques for the synthesis of heterophase catalysis and surface determination during the reaction. After understanding the basic concepts, students will learn how heterophase catalysis can be applied to the research and development of permanent carbon reduction technologies, such as the conversion of biomass and carbon dioxide.
entries.本門課程旨在教授學生矩陣理論的基礎知識，同時介紹在無線通訊以及訊號處理領域中經常: This course aims to teach students the basic knowledge of matrix theory and introduce matrix analysis techniques that are often used in the fields of wireless communication and signal processing.
entries.本門課除了可以為同學建立轉型正義的先備知識外，同時也會舉辦版畫身體工作坊、演講、: In addition to the preparation knowledge for students to establish transformation and justice, this course will also hold printmaking body workshops, speeches, visits and other activities, so that students can be inspired by knowledge translation, and implement the results of knowledge translation, which will be exhibited at the end of the term.

In addition, carcinogens, drugs, pollutants, ultraviolet rays, X-rays, electromagnetic waves and other foreign substances will also lead to the production of free radicals. And people's emotional tension, such as anger, tension, etc., will also produce free radicals. In this course, we combine classroom lectures and literature discussions to lead students to understand the physical process of marine dynamic mechanism and large-scale sea gas coupling.
entries.海洋與大氣、生物圈和岩石圈的交互作用下，幾乎所有元素在其循環中的某個階段都會經過: Under the interaction between the ocean and the atmosphere, the biosphere and the lithosphere, almost all elements pass through the ocean at some stage in their cycle. This course will introduce the main effects that occur in the ocean and how these effects affect the chemical properties of the ocean. Students will understand the reasons for controlling the distribution of chemicals in seawater, how long different elements stay in the ocean on average, how marine chemical reactions affect each other with biological, geological and physical effects in the ocean, and how the chemical properties of the ocean affect the future of the earth. It is recommended that students have background knowledge of general chemistry and introduction to oceanography.

This week, starting from the classic case of H.M., a patient with amnesia, we will introduce the role of hippocampus in the formation and solidification of new memory, and distinguish between shund amnesia and retrograde amnesia. entries.熱帶氣象是過去二十年大氣科學領域中進展最快的一門次領域科學，本課程將以全新的視角: Tropical meteorology is the fastest progressing sub-field science in the field of atmospheric science in the past two decades. This course will introduce important weather and climate phenomena in the tropics and the latest research progress from a new perspective. The course content includes: (1) tropical meteorology overview, (2) telemetry, (3) global circulation, (4) tropical variation, (5) water vapor and rainfall distribution, (6) vertical transmission, (7) comprehensive and medium-scale systems, (8) tropical cyclones, and (9) observation analysis and forecasting.
entries.熱管理已成為電子設備的開發技術瓶頸，隨著電子產品朝向高性能化、高速度化及輕薄化發: Thermal management has become a bottleneck in the development of electronic equipment. With the development of electronic products towards high performance, high speed and lightness, the thermal power density is getting higher and higher. According to statistics, more than half of the failure of electronic products is affected by heat. This course cultivates students with the necessary knowledge and skills of mechanical engineers in thermal management, which can apply these skills to the design analysis of thermal management of electronic components and equipment, and enable students to understand the differences and limitations between theoretical models and real systems, and learn the ability of problem analysis, system integration, experimental operation and engineering improvement. Through practical thematic production and system construction training, students' ability in engineering practical application, teamwork and independent problem solving can be improved, so as to strengthen their foundation for relevant research or engineering practice in the future.

entries.科技可說是現代文明的象徵，改善生活條件、提供諸多便利與創造經濟福祉，更被視為國家: Science and technology can be said to be a symbol of modern civilization. Improving living conditions, providing many conveniences and creating economic well-being are regarded as elements of national competitiveness. It has become a project that many countries rely on to cultivate and strengthen, and has also become one of the research topics of public policy. Science and technology policies are different from general public policies. They include scientific development and technology application. They seek how to combine the pursuit of truth and knowledge with the pursuit of novelty and use, and give full play to the influence of science and technology. The role played by the country in the process of scientific and technological development can be understood from the national theory of political science, as an understanding of the actions that the country can take for the development of science and technology, and the process of public policy from promotion, planning, formulation and legitimization, implementation and evaluation. The course will also introduce the national/regional innovation system, how the central and local governments can use policy tools to cultivate and establish industry-government-academia-research cooperation systems and settlements with scientific and technological content that can generate economic benefits, and give examples of the policy tools used and driving related effects. The development of China's science and technology policy has its own vein. From the early ministerial meetings to the first national science and technology conference in 1978, the opening of the four-year national science and technology conference, many measures in previous sessions have influenced the present and created a unique Taiwan model. These decision-making conditions, environment and achievements will be explained in the course. In addition, this course also attaches importance to cultivating students' understanding of the institutional foundation of science and technology policies, national roles and innovation systems through theoretical discussion and practical analysis, and the ability to apply theory to practical policy analysis, and finally take policy evaluation and industry case reports as integration training.

entries.第三學期後半起至寒假，學生須進行下學期自行設計實驗專題的準備，在多項給予的大方向: From the second half of the third semester to the winter vacation, students must prepare for their own design of experimental topics in the next semester, choose one of the following general directions, complete literature survey, topic setting, system design, feasibility assessment and other work, and make an oral report of the experimental plan at the beginning of the fourth semester. The experimental topic must be an innovative research topic in the field of physics, and the preliminary results must be completed within limited funds and more than a dozen weeks. In the classroom teaching part of the fourth semester, each or two students will select several experimental papers related to the experimental topic from the best physics journals such as Physical Review Letter or Nature, Science, etc. for oral reports. It is expected that students will not only understand how modern experimental technologies are systematically integrated, but also understand the different directions of modern physics research through the report. At the end of the term, each group made an academic wall report on the results of their experimental topics and presented it at the physics annual meeting.

After the winter vacation of the first semester, self-study of code writing will be carried out. After the start of the school year, digital electronic circuit design and measurement, digital interface control, analog-digit and digital-analogy conversion, digital data analysis, computer simulation, simple machine factory operation, 3D printing and other exercises are systematically carried out. Each group will complete the design, construction and testing of the complete innovative system of the group's unique combination of analogy and digital system software and hardware components in the next six weeks. And participate in the physics junior conference held by the department at the end of the term. All kinds of two-wheeled cars, metal detectors, electronic musical instruments, digital writing machines, four-axis helicopters, voice analyzers, etc. are all examples of student works in the past. During the summer vacation at the end of the second semester, each group of students set up an important contemporary experimental system or technical topic to conduct an in-depth literature survey, and give a 40-minute oral English report in the third semester.

Students were required to choose their own topics, conduct in-depth literature research during the summer vacation, and conduct a 40-minute English oral report and discussion in each group in the third semester. The experimental part is to carry out operation exercises such as milling machines, lathes, drilling machines, sawing machines, 3D printing and other tools in deeper machinery factories. Then the students design various compound pendulums with additional drives, combine the previously learned analog ratios and digital electronic systems, program control and numerical simulation, mechanical tool operation, carry out the construction, measurement, data analysis and numerical simulation of the complex pendulum and measurement system, and compare them with the theoretical prediction and numerical simulation results to construct a complex nonlinear dynamic behavior model of the complex pendulum.

entries.策略係統合企業內相關資源之整體性指導原則，和企業功能性之管理有極大的分野。本課程: The strategy is to integrate the overall guiding principle of relevant resources in the enterprise, and there is a great difference between the management of enterprise functionality. This course teaches the process of strategy management, including strategy analysis, strategy formation and strategy execution; that is, how organizations can surpass competitors' thinking and means through goal setting and a series of closely combined actions and resource allocation. This course includes two levels: the basic concept of strategic thinking, how to compete in a specific field (competitive strategy) and how to choose a field (growth strategy).
