entries.米德‧昆德拉在其名著《生命不可承受之輕》這樣談到了「媚俗」（Kitsch）:媚俗: In his famous book The Unbearable Lightness of Life, Mide Kundra talked about "Kitsch" as follows: the feelings caused by vulgarity are something that the public can share. Vulgarity can be derived from some basic impressions engraved in people's memory: an ungrateful daughter, a neglected father, a child running on the grass, a betrayed motherland, and the first love. The vulgarity causes two closely connected tears. The first kind of tears said: How nice it is to see the children running on the grass! The second kind of tears said: How nice it is to be with all human beings and be moved by the children running on the grass! The second kind of tears makes vulgarity more vulgar. ( Translated by Han Shaogong, written by Mid Kundra, 1991: 277) In recent years, many emerging educational issues have emerged in the contemporary world and Taiwan, such as the so-called youth (young) grand tour (and travel education); remote hometown, native and primary school education; learning community; new return to peasant movement, global ecological village movement and education; mindfulness education... These educational "topics", through various media or education, have more or less become educational "topics" that many people have vaguely heard about, or read in newspapers and magazines, or have already known. It is indeed a good thing to be sensitive to the emerging educational phenomenon and have some dialogues with people on emerging educational issues in social life. However, as a (future) researcher of education, you can't just let these educational "topics" become "topics" after tea and dinner. Or, let talking about educational issues become a fashionable "coquettish". For example, experimental education in Taiwan is one of the hottest emerging educational topics in recent years. Many parents who are rich and loud but dot on their children and do not understand the true spirit of experimental education at all. They criticize that Taiwan's education reform is chaotic enough all day long, and say, "No matter how much money it costs, I must send my child to Cixin Waltford School like many far-sighted parents, so that he can grow up freely, learn happily, and grow up to his own life." It is a slogan and fashion, but they don't know that Cixin Waltford School is public and private, and the tuition fee is no longer necessary, and parents and children are required to conduct long-term and detailed interviews and evaluations with the school for admission. In fact, the implicit things behind the emerging educational issues are extremely complex and urgently need to be deeply combed by educational researchers. Because these emerging issues of education, under a certain time and space vein in the world, burst out, spread, land somewhere, and cultivate in the local soil. Moreover, these emerging educational topics will encounter, dialogue, converge, reject, blend and transform with many different elements of life and the world in the transition of time and space. In this process, similar educational issues may be repeated, and different emerging issues may differ (sensitive readers can feel that we are using the philosophical terms of French post-structural scholar Gille Deleuze). Therefore, as a (future) researcher of education, you must "examine" the "topic" of appearances. Examination means "in-depth reading", that is, the "insight" of intellectuals on these educational issues. "Insight" means deeply combing out the theoretical and ideological foundations "behind" these educational issues, not just the understanding of nouns and appearances. For example, the educational connotation of the "Zhuangyou" that has emerged in recent years is not only to encourage Xinxin students to "run away" to various parts of Taiwan or overseas to understand the world. The magnificent tour" makes us want to go back to Germany's famous Nobel Prize in Literature? The Wanderer's Song by Hermann Hesse. However, what is the meaning of life and education in the suffering and drifting way of Shidada? In fact, if we go back to the more fundamental concept of education, what is education? What is learning? Michel Serres, an academician of the French Academy, from "Pedagogy" (la p? Dagogie) is the oldest Greek character to analyze that education and learning are all a drifting journey, a journey to explore the world outward and find one's life inward at the same time. In the same way, rural education, and J. Rawls' concept of justice is closely related. Furthermore, if we reconsider whether there is a factor of cultural hegemony hidden behind the so-called "countryside education", this will lead us to read the theory of cultural capital and class reform, such as Pierre Bourdieu. And how to break through this cultural hegemony? The dialogue of critical pedagogy and the theory of liberation classroom provide us with a good starting point. The learning community sweeping Taiwan seems to have a strange learning "scenery" in Taiwan's school classrooms. However, is such a scenery mixed with "cooperative learning", so that the "beautiful scenery" that the learning community that leaves wants to outline is getting farther and farther? This allows us to re-explore the deeper meaning of "learning community", such as the world-famous English-famous educational scholar R. A. Martusewicz's Seeking Passage: Post-Structuralism Pedagogy Ethics, which explores the educational ethics of Interbeing, can also be returned to Paul Ric, a famous French hermeneutics master? Ur's "Like Others" (Soi-m? Me comme un autre), to explore the problem of interpretation cycle between people. The New Return to the Peasants Movement, the Global Ecological Village Movement and Education, such as the reaction of critical theory to capitalism, the criticism of the modern education model of contemporary factory production by critical pedagogy, and the awakening of the consciousness of the actor's practice (conscientiza?? O), what's more, is the protection of the mother of the earth - Gaia, the pursuit of whole-person education and spiritual education... Of course, in the end, we can reflect again: is the text we choose and the theory we read still another degree of vulgarity? Therefore, when using various theoretical perspectives to examine these educational issues, it is necessary to maintain a "humble" research attitude at all times, because any one or more rake combing methods and patterns are only a certain way/glasses/angle of understanding the world, which is the same term used by French postmodern scholar J.-F, Lyotard, which is a partial/small narrative born under a certain space-time vein (petit r? Cit). This is also one of the most core educational purposes of this course. This course will change according to the pulse and changes of the times, as well as the composition characteristics and research directions of the students. The principle is to select three educational topics each time. Each educational topic is a unit. First, students collect and share information from newspapers and magazines on a certain educational topic, and extract key issues from it. Then use three weeks to conduct individual and group analytical and critical reading and analysis of several key Chinese and foreign texts. For the so-called "individual and group analytical and critical reading and analysis", please refer to the course requirements below the course allocation ratio. In addition, short films will be added in a timely manner for various educational issues, so that students can have the opportunity to examine and analyze the theories and concepts they have learned from the perspective of an educational researcher for the content of these short films.

entries.群是用來研究對稱性的重要工具，例如：正n邊形在旋轉與翻轉中依舊保持其結構。在這裡: Groups are important tools for studying symmetry. For example, positive n-sided shapes still maintain their structure in rotation and flipping. Here, rotation and flip are regarded as two different actions, and the operation of keeping the positive n-fold unchanged is generated by these two actions. We can mark each corner of the positive n-sided shape, and when we rotate or flip, we get a new marking order. Each possible order of marks can be regarded as a point on the graph, and if the point is connected to the point, it means that the two marks have a rotational or flipping relationship, and the graph is called Cayley graphs. In the deep learning network, there is a method that can be used to predict the distance between points on the graph, and we will use this tool to predict the distance between two different points in Cayley graphs. In addition, there are several different ways to describe the complexity of a group in group theory. We will test whether these complexitys are related to the success rate of point-to-point prediction used by deep learning networks through experiments.

entries.老莊思想產生於春秋戰國秩序崩解、價值競逐的時代。在此歷史背景下，人們重新思考語言: Lao Zhuang Thought originated in the era of the collapse of order and value competition during the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. Against this historical background, people rethink the issues of language, order, politics, nature and freedom. Starting from these core issues, this course will read the important chapters of Tao Te Ching and Zhuangzi, understand how Laozi and Zhuangzi faced the difficulties of the times, and think about whether the views they put forward are still explanatory and critical today. The course will also introduce contemporary texts (comics, movies) and cultural issues, and discuss how different eras think about similar problems through the comparison of ancient and modern times. We should not only know what Laozi and Zhuangzi said, but also understand why he said so, who he was responding to, what his thoughts had solved, and what tension he had left.

Over the years, southern Fujian, Hakka, foreign provinces, aborigines and new immigrants have lived in peace on this land. The Hakka family is the second largest ethnic group in Taiwan, accounting for about one-fifth of the population in Taiwan. The Hakka family was influenced by the living environment in the early days. After migrating to Taiwan, they also retained a considerable number of ethnic groups, including unique language, culture and industrial economic models. This course intends to guide students to get a glimpse of the origin, culture, language, literature, social policy and industrial economy of Hakka through teachers' lectures, group discussions and final group reports. It is hoped that after studying this course, students can have a deeper understanding and experience of Hakka culture.

Through application examples, the important material electrochemical systems in today's materials science, such as electrochemical deposition of metals and alloys (metal bonding materials), oxides and semiconductors (inorganic non-metallic materials), corrosion and protection (material surfaces), eigenective conductive polymers (organic covalent bonding materials) and nanoelectrochemistry (composite materials) are discussed in detail. entries.訊號與系統 (Signals and Systems)是一個具有高度運用價值的基: Signals and Systems is a basic discipline with high application value. Its application level is very wide. It is a fairly practical theoretical discipline in science and technology courses, and it also plays a critical role in the analysis of biological systems. However, it often has a certain degree of abstract characteristics because of the lack of real and direct physical corresponding images when learning. This course focuses on the basic processing skills of digital and analog signals, and integrates the concepts of signals and systems of continuous time and discrete time. It calculates the mathematical relationship between the time domain and the frequency domain through Fourier transform, and studies the design principle of the filtering device of digital and analog systems, the sampling principle, the cross-frequency modulation method between biomedical signals, and common biomedical signal processing techniques such as electrocardiograms, brain waves, blood pressure waves, and electromyography.

entries.詮釋學作為當代西方哲學之顯學，乃以高達美經典巨著《真理與方法》為關鍵，其不但繼承: As a manifestation of contemporary Western philosophy, hermeneutics is the key to the classic "Truth and Method" of the United States. It not only inherits and transforms Western traditional hermeneutics, modern hermeneutics, especially Heidegger's hermeneutic philosophy, but also opens and leads to the so-called hermeneutical conflict between Habermas's communication theory and critical hermeneutics, even the Ruger hermeneuteutology of the legal system, and even the deconstructive hermeneutics of postmodern Deshida. This course will re-understand and carry out the philosophical interpretation in Gundam's "Truth and Method" from a brand-new systematic philosophy, and open up a systematic hermeneutic philosophy to suggest a solution to the above-mentioned hermeneutic conflicts and even an integrated way of various interpretations.

entries.課程目標\tThis course is devoted to introduc: Course Objective This course is devoted to introduce fundamental statistical concepts and methods to college level students in the School of Management. Statistics are used in a variety of contexts ranging from scientific experiments to political advertisements and beyond. This statistics course introduces the basic concepts of statistical analysis, with a focus on both univariate (single-variable) and bivariate (two-variable) data. The course starts with an introductory examination and display of data. Analysis of univariate/bivariate data by way of measures of central tendency (such as the mean or average), dispersion (such as the variance), asymmetry, and associations for both qualitative and quantitative data is presented. We then move to the probability theory and statistics terms. The relationship of probability to statistics is also discussed, providing students with the tools they need to understand how ``chance'' plays a role in statistical analysis. Statistical distributions, with a focus on the normal distribution and its uses, are also considered next, followed by an introduction to various sampling theory and statistical testing. Some fundamental tests without parametric assumptions will be addressed. We continue to explore the conditional models from linear regression model via OLS, and analysis of variance. The student is provided with enough theory and sufficient practice to conduct statistical analyses for real life cases. This course is designed for anyone who desires to learn how statistics can produce better decisions and insights from the growing amount of data generated in modern business.

This advanced data model is mainly based on the entity relationship model, which is used to model the system requirements of the previous stage, including basic structure, attributes, entity type, relationship type, and related restrictions. Then introduce the associative database system, including the basic structure - association, limitation, and operator (operation mode). Next, it introduces how to convert an applied entity relational relationship model into an associative database model. After that, it introduces the operation mode of the associative database - correlation algebra, and finally, the high-level language of the associative database SQL.

entries.這門課程在於讓同學了解自1815年結束拿破崙戰爭的維也納會議後，至1914年第一: This course is to let students understand the horizontal and horizontal affairs of European countries in the field of diplomacy from the Vienna Conference after the end of the Napoleonic War in 1815 to the First World War in 1914. The diplomatic actions carried out on the European continent during this period had a significant impact on the subsequent development of international relations. Even the interaction of these countries has formed the "realism" school in contemporary international relations theory, as well as many theories, such as "balance of power", "alliance politics", "hegemony between maritime power and land power", etc. In addition, there are several points worth noting in this history: (1) This period was an important process before the decline and even collapse of several European empires, such as the Austro-Hungarian Empire, the Ottoman Empire and the Russian Empire. The rise and fall of the empire was originally an important topic of academic research, and the big and small events that occurred between 1815 and 1914 accelerated the disintegration of the empire to some extent. What's the reason? It's worth our understanding. ( II) In modern civilization, the changes on land are quite small, but the political organizations established by human beings on the land have experienced many changes. That is to say, on the European continent, which originated from the concept of "nation-state", there are many changes in countries and the corresponding re-division of territories and borders. The geographical location of the land remains unchanged, but the ownership of the land changes; the countries that covet the land also change over time. If we want to understand the problems of today's world, there is a feasible way to understand the previous history. Similarly, once we understand history, we can compare it with the real world and find out the reasons for change and change. For example, from 1853 to 1856, the Russian Empire (now Russia) fought for Crimea with the Ottoman Turkish Empire (now Turkey), the Second French Empire (today's France), the British Empire (today's Britain) and the Kingdom of Sardinia (now Italy). In 2014, Russia launched a war in Crimea. The protagonists of these two wars are Russia, and the similarities and differences between motives and purposes is a way for us to understand the world. Although the development of the world has been very different from the time limit from 1815 to 1914, the struggle between the European continent in the past 100 years is still full of legacy and revelations for today's world. Students who take this course will learn a practical comparison method (MSSD/MDSD) and need to compare today's Taiwan with Europe in the past to make personal oral and written reports, which will help improve their understanding of the world.

The application topic can also be extended to issues such as quantitative easing (QE), rare disasters and the effect of the zero-interest rate lower monetary policy. entries.這門課程的目的是探討日常生活中與記憶相關的問題，結合記憶與大腦的理論及實驗，解釋: The purpose of this course is to explore problems related to memory in daily life, combine the theory and experiments of memory and the brain, and explain the phenomena and challenges of learning and memory in classroom and social situations. Memory is the core of our identity. It shapes our thoughts, actions and future development. It is not only about the past, but also about how we deal with the current situation and our ability to plan for the future. Hundreds of years of psychological science research and decades of cognitive neuroscience research have greatly advanced our understanding of the theory and neural mechanisms of how memory works. However, many business courses on memory enhancement on the market lack a solid evidence basis, and few theoretical courses on campus can really be used to guide or solve memory problems in daily life. Therefore, this course aims to build a bridge between theory and real-life situations in the laboratory, and explore the practical problems of how memory formation and extraction can be applied to daily life. In addition to teaching, the course will also guide students to identify the real problems they face and explore possible solutions together, so as to apply theory to practical situations and enhance their understanding and practical ability of memory mechanisms.

entries.過去 50 年來，同位素地球化學已發展成為地球科學領域中的一項基礎學科，並使得地: In the past 50 years, isotope geochemistry has developed into a basic discipline in the field of earth science, and has gradually transformed geology from a discipline based on qualitative observation to a modern quantitative science. This course will introduce the basic principles of isotope geochemistry and explore its diverse applications in understanding the earth and its evolution. This course first introduces the basic principles of geological chronology and its application, and then explores how radiogenic isotopes provide important information about the origin and evolution of the earth. After that, we will explore the application of stable isotope geochemistry in different fields such as paleoclimatology, paleontology, archeology, deposit etology and magma evolution. The course will also focus on the expansion of the geochemical research scope of stable isotopes, gradually expanding from the traditional light elements such as hydrogen, carbon and oxygen to the isotopes of other metal elements in the periodic table. Finally, this course will introduce the geochemistry of inert gas isotopes and explain how isotope changes caused by nuclear reactions and chemical reactions can provide a unique perspective for understanding the origin and evolution of the earth.

In different situations, people's historical memories of the past are sometimes deliberately forgotten and sometimes reshaped; these historical filtering methods deeply shape the appearance and meaning of the place, and affect the relationship between people. entries.遺傳學是研究生物體的遺傳和變異的科學。而現代遺傳學，其目的之一是尋求了解遺傳的整: Genetics is the science of studying the inheritance and mutation of objects. One of the purposes of modern genetics is to seek to understand the mechanism of the whole process of inheritance. Some genetic units obey simple statistical laws, and these genetic units are now called genes. Genes are located on DNA, and DNA is composed of four different types of nuclei? The stranded molecules composed of acid, the nucleotide sequence on DNA is the genetic information of the organism, which can be translated by cells to synthesize proteins. Although heredity plays an important role in determining the appearance and behavior of organisms, this process is the result of the joint action of inheritance and the environment experienced by organisms. This course hopes that students can learn to understand the interaction between genes and between genes and the environment.

entries.－介紹風險社會學的核心概念，包括風險的定義、類型、以及風險如何在全球化背景下擴散: - Introduce the core concepts of risk sociology, including the definition and type of risk, and how risk spreads in the context of globalization.
entries.－介紹風險評估、管理和社會韌性等治理工具和策略。: - Introduce governance tools and strategies such as risk assessment, management and social resilience.
entries.－分析全球風險的特性，以及國際合作在應對全球風險中的重要性。: - Analyze the characteristics of global risks and the importance of international cooperation in dealing with global risks.
entries.－分析台灣社會所面臨的特殊風險，例如天然災害、產業轉型等。: - Analyze the special risks faced by Taiwan society, such as natural disasters, industrial transformation, etc.
entries.－分析這些風險的成因、影響、以及相互關聯性。: - Analyze the causes, impacts and interrelationships of these risks.
entries.－分析風險的社會建構過程，以及不同社會群體如何感知和應對風險。: - Analyze the social construction process of risks, and how different social groups perceive and respond to risks.
entries.－學會介紹家庭成員和自我介紹（國籍、年齡、職業、興趣等）；: - Learn to introduce family members and introduce yourself (nationality, age, occupation, interests, etc.);
entries.－學會使用越南語在一般生活情境、如問路、搭車、購物、去市場買食材、餐廳點餐等。: - Learn to use Vietnamese in general life situations, such as asking for ways, hitchhiking, shopping, going to the market to buy ingredients, ordering food in restaurants, etc.
entries.－學會越南拼音方法：29字母、聲調、母音、子音、韻音、看字讀音；: - Learn Vietnamese Pinyin methods: 29 letters, tones, vowels, consonants, rhymes, word reading;
entries.－學會越南數字及應用數字問時間、日期、物品的數量、購物價格等；: - Learn Vietnamese numbers and apply numbers to ask time, date, quantity of items, shopping price, etc.;
entries.－學會越南稱謂及應用在出次見面、互相認識、打招呼；: - Learn Vietnamese titles and applications when meeting, getting to know each other, and greeting each other;
entries.－學生初步認識越南的社經文化，例如：越南簡要的歷史、各大城市、食、衣、住、行的文: - Students have a preliminary understanding of Vietnam's social and economic culture, such as: a brief history of Vietnam, major cities, cultural customs of food, clothing, accommodation and travel;

entries.－探討政府、企業、非政府組織和公民社會在風險治理中的角色和責任。: - Explore the roles and responsibilities of governments, enterprises, non-governmental organizations and civil society in risk management.
